title: Senior Client Advisor
description:
Company:

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Marsh Commercial team at Marsh. This role will be based in Chichester. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

We have a fantastic opportunity to join our dynamic Marsh Commercial team in Chichester as a Senior Client Advisor. This is a client-facing role, ideal for someone with proven experience supporting or leading the full renewal process across commercial insurance programmes, managing placement strategy, and delivering exceptional service to clients.

What can you expect?

  • The opportunity to join a growing, highly successful team supporting a diverse portfolio of commercial clients with tailored insurance solutions
  • A client-facing role where you will build trusted relationships with clients, insurers and colleagues across Marsh
  • The chance to contribute to market-leading service delivery, placing clients at the centre of everything we do
  • Excellent training, development and progression opportunities within a business committed to developing talent
  • The opportunity to work for a respected global brand with deep market expertise and broad capability

What can you expect to do?

  • Act as a lead advisory colleague on a medium-sized, less complex book of business
  • Support Client Executives with renewal and placement strategy for commercial insurance programmes
  • Manage mid-term changes to risk and respond to client requirements throughout the policy cycle
  • Request, review and interpret underwriting information on behalf of clients
  • Prepare and submit accurate market presentations and slips in consultation with Client Executives and the Placement Team
  • Use Marsh’s online trading systems to collate, negotiate and evaluate renewal terms with existing and prospective insurers
  • Work closely with Placement, Advisory Leaders and Client Executives to deliver the best outcomes for clients
  • Produce and/or request insurer documentation and ensure accuracy across all client deliverables
  • Review and comment on indemnity and insurance clauses where required
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a key day-to-day point of contact for service needs
  • Maintain high standards across client delivery, including monitoring service, documentation and invoicing
  • Stay close to market developments and contribute to Marsh’s collective knowledge and expertise

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience working on the full renewal process for commercial insurance programmes
  • Strong client-facing experience and confidence in building credible, trusted relationships
  • Excellent organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and enquiries simultaneously
  • A solid understanding of clients’ businesses, their insurance programmes, business issues and service requirements
  • The ability to work collaboratively with client teams, placement colleagues and insurers to deliver high-quality outcomes

What makes you stand out

  • A proactive, dynamic approach with strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • The ability to remain calm under pressure and work flexibly when required
  • Cert CII qualified, with progress towards ACII desirable

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, civil partnership status, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments in accordance with applicable law to any candidate with a disability to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. If you have a disability that may require reasonable adjustments, please contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Product Manager - Wealth Management
description:
About Our Company


We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

The Product Manager role, within the Wealth Management business group, will be responsible for managing business/product critical processes, reports and audits. This role will also represent the wealth management products group as a subject matter expert and liaison with project initiatives.

The Product Manager role, within the Wealth Management Solutions – Product and Platform Solutions Development team, serves as a subject matter expert for the advisory platform, supporting initiatives that enhance the advisor and client experience across the advisory platform. This role partners across the organization to enhance advisory solutions, resolve complex issues, and maintain a strong compliance environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a business lead and/or subject matter expert on projects of varying scale across product lines; representing advisory products on cross-organizational projects and initiatives.
  • Support the development and enhancement of the advisor and client experience across the advisory platform.
  • Ensure a strong compliance environment through regular review of policies, procedures, reports, and controls; identify required changes and support implementation.
  • Provide quantitative and qualitative research and analysis to identify opportunities, evaluate industry trends and competitor offerings, and make recommendations related to product enhancements, platform changes, and new offerings.
  • Partner with Technology, Service, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Training, and external vendors to develop and improve advisory products, programs, and platform capabilities.
  • Develop and enhance programs and platform features that support asset growth, net flows, advisor adoption, client engagement, revenue generation, and firm profitability.
  • Lead product efforts that support advisor acquisition, broaden platform usage, and grow client assets under management.
  • Lead resolution of complex and non-routine advisor and client issues by working across internal teams, vendors, and partner organizations.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with business partners, stakeholders, and third-party providers.
  • Lead the transition of product development initiatives into ongoing product management, including process, procedure, and documentation development.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years financial services experience
  • Excellent strategic and analytical skills to solve complex problems and identify new product solutions
  • Knowledge and experience working with Ameriprise product suite
  • Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory environment
  • Proven organizational skills, including managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and high level of personal accountability
  • Active Series 7 or the ability to obtain within 120 days


Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management experience
  • Experience working with Ameriprise project methodologies (JIRA, Agile)
  • Experience with advisory products, platforms, and wealth management solutions.
  • Understanding of Ameriprise business units, field organization, and operational processes.
  • Working knowledge of Ameriprise systems and tools (including BETA Host, Thomson One/Refinitiv)
  • Data analysis experience

In-Office Collaboration

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.


Visa Sponsorship

Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $73,500 - $129,100 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances.

title: Sr.Principal Software Engineer
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Sr Principal Software Engineer – Genesys Cloud AI & Industry Solutions


Role Overview

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer and employee experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data, and AI to deliver personalized experiences, automate complex business processes, and improve operational efficiency.

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer with deep, hands-on Genesys Cloud experience to design and build the next generation of AI-powered applications and industry solutions on the Genesys Cloud platform.


This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines deep Genesys Cloud engineering expertise with hands-on experience building advanced conversational or agentic AI applications using Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, or similar platforms.


The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing applications and integrations on Genesys Cloud and understands how to combine Genesys Cloud APIs, Architect, AI capabilities, experience orchestration, data, and enterprise systems to create production-grade solutions.


A major focus of this role will be translating industry-specific business processes and customer challenges into reusable AI solutions. You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector.


You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build production-grade applications and industry solutions on Genesys Cloud, leveraging Genesys Cloud APIs, SDKs, events, integrations, AI capabilities, and platform services.
  • Develop AI-powered customer and employee applications using Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent capabilities, Copilot, Architect, knowledge, and Experience Orchestration.
  • Translate industry-specific business processes and use cases into scalable AI applications, combining Genesys Cloud capabilities with enterprise systems, data, knowledge, AI models, and agentic technologies.
  • Build reusable industry solution accelerators, Digital Teammates, AI agents, workflows, and application components that can be configured and deployed across multiple customers within an industry.
  • Develop industry solutions addressing complex business challenges across financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and public sector environments.
  • Design sophisticated Genesys Architect flows and orchestration patterns across voice, digital, AI, workflows, data, and enterprise applications.
  • Build integrations using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, Data Actions, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and external APIs.
  • Integrate Genesys Cloud with industry and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, AWS, CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, healthcare, financial services, and workflow platforms.
  • Build agentic applications and multi-agent workflows where AI agents can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools and APIs, execute business processes, and collaborate with human employees.
  • Apply modern conversational and agentic AI patterns learned from platforms such as Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, and similar technologies to build differentiated solutions on Genesys Cloud.
  • Design AI applications that combine LLMs, enterprise knowledge, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, business rules, and enterprise systems of record.
  • Create reusable solution patterns that encapsulate industry workflows, business rules, integrations, AI capabilities, and best practices, accelerating time to value for customers.
  • Work with industry experts, customers, Product, and Engineering teams to identify high-value use cases and convert them into repeatable, productized solutions.
  • Build prototypes and MVPs using emerging Genesys Cloud AI and other AI technologies and rapidly convert successful concepts into scalable, production-ready industry applications.
  • Design applications for enterprise-scale requirements including security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, compliance, and governance.
  • Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, and mentorship while remaining a hands-on builder and contributor.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of software engineering, application development, or solution architecture experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud experience, including designing, developing, integrating, and deploying applications on the platform.
  • Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud architecture, APIs, Architect, routing, conversations, integrations, Data Actions, and event-driven capabilities.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies.
  • Experience building AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or agentic applications using enterprise AI platforms and modern AI technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and agentic workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience building reusable enterprise or industry solutions, rather than only one-off customer implementations.
  • Experience translating complex industry business processes and use cases into technical architectures and production applications.
  • Experience building applications using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, event streams, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with enterprise applications such as CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, and workflow platforms.
  • Experience translating AI capabilities into production-grade applications and reusable solutions, including integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, workflows, and business applications.
  • Experience taking solutions from prototype/MVP through production deployment and operation.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in architecture, design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and implementation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent, Copilot, Predictive Engagement, knowledge capabilities, and Experience Orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience building production AI applications using Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore.ai, or similar enterprise conversational and agentic AI platforms.
  • Experience developing custom applications and reusable solutions using the Genesys Cloud Developer Platform and APIs.
  • Experience with Genesys Cloud CX voice and digital channels, including routing, Architect flows, bots, messaging, and agent experiences.
  • Experience designing AI agents that combine conversational intelligence, reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, and business-process execution.
  • Experience building agentic AI applications that integrate LLMs with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, CRM/ITSM platforms, workflow engines, and other systems of record.
  • Experience designing or developing industry-specific AI applications and reusable solution accelerators for financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, telecommunications, travel and hospitality, or public sector.
  • Understanding of industry-specific business processes, regulatory requirements, data models, and enterprise application ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.
  • Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ecosystems.
  • Experience taking AI applications from prototype through enterprise production, including security, scalability, observability, governance, and reliability.
  • Experience working in innovation teams, rapid prototyping environments, or customer co-creation programs.

What Success Looks Like


Success in this role means being able to take an industry business problem or use case and rapidly turn it into a working, production-quality AI application built on Genesys Cloud.


More importantly, the goal is not simply to solve the problem for one customer. You will identify the common business process, integrations, AI capabilities, and orchestration patterns and turn them into a reusable industry solution that can be deployed across many customers.


You should be equally comfortable understanding an industry business process, discussing architecture, working with Genesys Cloud APIs, designing an Architect flow, writing application code, integrating enterprise systems, connecting AI models and agents, implementing tool/API calling, debugging interactions, and demonstrating the finished solution to customers and executives.


You should also be able to bring experience and architectural patterns from leading conversational and agentic AI platforms and apply those concepts effectively within the Genesys Cloud ecosystem.


This is not a traditional high-level architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer who knows Genesys Cloud deeply and can combine its AI, orchestration, API, and integration capabilities with modern agentic AI technologies to build the next generation of AI-powered industry solutions.


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
  • Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
  • We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.

Get notified about relevant opportunities.


Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.


Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.


About Genesys:

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit

title: Lead VBC Quality Consultant
description:
Position Purpose:
The Lead VBC Quality Consultant serves as the strategic quality advisor for an assigned portfolio of Value-Based Care organizations. The role analyzes performance, identifies opportunities, develops quality improvement strategies, and partners with provider organizations to improve Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and other quality outcomes. The consultant serves as the primary quality liaison between internal teams and external provider partners and is accountable for coordinating execution, monitoring results, and escalating barriers.

Key Details: Value-Based Care experience and Medicare Quality experience highly preferred.

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 8–10 VBC organizations and serve as the primary national quality contact for assigned accounts.

  • Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly quality priorities based on contract goals, performance trends, population needs, and identified performance risk.

  • Develop partner-specific quality strategies, action plans, milestones, and accountability mechanisms; monitor execution and intervene when progress is off track.

  • Track performance against Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, medication adherence, clinical quality, member experience, and applicable VBC quality goals.

  • Analyze provider-, measure-, and member-level data to identify performance drivers, care-gap opportunities, emerging risks, and variation across markets or provider groups.

  • Translate complex findings into focused initiatives that improve gap closure, medication adherence, preventive care, chronic condition management, and member experience.

  • Assess intervention effectiveness, recommend course corrections, and share scalable best practices across the VBC portfolio.

  • Support performance forecasting, executive reporting, and prioritization of high-impact measures and populations.

  • Partner with Market Quality, Network, Provider Engagement, Analytics, Pharmacy, Risk Adjustment, Clinical Operations, Data/EMR teams, and leadership to align strategy and execution.

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional workgroups that address performance barriers, data issues, provider workflow needs, and enterprise quality priorities.

  • Bring provider insights and recurring barriers back to internal teams to inform national strategy, resource allocation, and process improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Complies with all policies and standards.



Education/Experience:

Bachelor's Degree Nursing, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience. required


Master's Degree preferred
: 5+ years experience in Medicare quality improvement, Medicare Stars, HEDIS, population health, or closely related work. required

Demonstrated experience analyzing healthcare performance data and converting findings into actionable strategies. required

Strong knowledge of CMS Medicare Stars and NCQA HEDIS specifications and performance improvement methods. required

Experience in interpreting and utilizing clinical data analytics, outcomes measurement in healthcare and use of that data to drive change utilizing programs like Excel, Power BI and, PowerPoint. required

Experience leading external stakeholder meetings and independently managing multiple complex accounts or initiatives. preferred





Licenses/Certifications:
RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure Current or prior RN, LPN/LVN, PA, PharmD, or other relevant clinical licensure; clinical background is highly valued but not required. preferred

title: Intern - I&A
description:
Job Description Summary

The position will play a pivotal role in transforming data into high-quality, actionable insights that influence strategic business decisions at a global scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with cross-functional global stakeholders, contribute to key business deliverables, and apply advanced analytics and modelling in real-world healthcare challenges. Expect to be part of a fast-paced, innovative environment with freedom to experiment, learn, and grow.


Job Description

  • Be 100% hands-on in delivering high-impact analytics and insights across core business areas—including monthly business reviews, decision boards, KPI performance assessment, impact measurement using advanced analytics and daily ad hoc analyses that drive global decisions.
  • Collaborate directly with global stakeholders, especially with teams based in the US, gaining real-world exposure to the US pharma market, patient behavior analytics, and commercial strategy
  • Work on advanced analytics and modelling techniques, including predictive models, optimization frameworks, and AI/ML-driven solutions to support strategic brand, access, and patient support decisions
  • Dive deep into patient-level analytical ready datasets (ARDs) and base tables to uncover trends, answer complex business questions, and deliver end-to-end insight storytelling—from data to decision

title: Sr. Staff Cyber Security Architect
description:
Job Description Summary

This position will work on highly complex projects that require in-depth domain knowledge in two or more specialized areas. They are responsible for driving the design and implementation efforts related to architecture, scalability, availability and performance alignment w/ the product roadmap with a focus on application development & automation. They may interact w/ functional leaders to support these technical initiatives.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Drive significant endpoint security technology initiatives across multiple layers of architecture, including Linux, Kubernetes, Application, and Cloud platforms.
  • Partner with product management, product owners and architects to identify & prioritize security features across the system.
  • Work to design implement projects to transform products within the portfolio through automation orchestration opportunities.
  • A focus on automation & orchestration and furthering the integration of Cyber Security & Risk management into the native development workflow.
  • Contribute to the development of infrastructure platforms that are service-oriented with reusable components that can be orchestrated together into different methods for different businesses
  • Participate in the research and evaluation of emerging technology, industry and market trends to assist in project development and/or operational support actives.

Technical Qualification

  • Deep experience in Linux and Kubernetes security, including OS hardening, container security, RBAC, workload isolation, secure boot and runtime protection.
  • Strong expertise in Identity, PKI and Zero Trust, including OAuth2/OIDC, certificates, TLS/mTLS, key management, workload identity and technologies such as Keycloak/OpenPKI/Vault.
  • Strong knowledge of software supply-chain security, including SBOM, CVE/VEX management, SAST/SCA, container scanning, artifact signing, software provenance and tools such as Trivy, Black Duck, Cosign/Sigstore and GitLab security tooling.
  • Experience designing DevSecOps and Security-as-Code, integrating automated security controls into CI/CD using tools such as GitLab CI, OPA/Rego, Kyverno, Helm and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong security architecture and threat-modeling capability using techniques such as STRIDE, attack-surface analysis, trust-boundary analysis and secure-design patterns.
  • Experience with network, API and communication security, including network segmentation, API gateways, secure remote connectivity, TLS/mTLS and Zero Trust networking.
  • Experience with runtime security, audit logging and security monitoring, preferably across Kubernetes and distributed edge systems.
  • Ability to architect security across edge, customer datacenter and cloud deployments.
  • Strong understanding of medical-device cybersecurity and secure product development, including FDA cybersecurity expectations, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, NIST SSDF and related risk-management practices.

Education Qualification


  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with significant experience in Cybersecurity domain with a minimum of 14 years of experience.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on the ability to effectively influence others
  • A team-focused mentality with the proven ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • An ability to communicate complex and technical issues to diverse audiences, orally and in writing, in an easily-understood, authoritative, and actionable manner.
  • Hands-on architecture mindset, capable of building reusable security capabilities into the Compute Platform rather than relying only on governance, reviews and compliance processes.

title: Registered Echo Technician
description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.

We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Job Title

Registered Echo Technician

Location

Vero Beach

Facility

Indian River Hospital

Department

Heart Failure-Heart Vascular & Thoracic Institute

Job Code

D0331F

Shift

Days + Call

Schedule

8:00am-4:30pm

Job Summary

Job Details

*This position is eligible for a sign-on bonus of up to $5,000*

Join our team at Cleveland Clinic Indian River Hospital and experience world-class healthcare at its best. Cleveland Clinic Indian River has been recognized as one of the top regional hospitals in South Florida. Indian River Hospital is in sunny Florida’s Treasure Coast where it is committed to providing optimal family-centric and community-focused care. At Indian River Hospital, you will be part of a collaborative, compassionate, and innovative team of caregivers. You will work with state-of-the-art technology and will build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

Echocardiograph (Echo) Technicians are an extremely specific kind of diagnostic medical sonographer dealing with the heart. Echo Technicians use ultrasound devices and other imaging tools that use sound waves to create images of the heart. They inspect the chambers and walls of the heart as well as the valves. An echocardiogram can be administered externally on a patient's chest but can also be conducted by placing a tube down a patient's esophagus to get closer to the heart internally. By joining the Indian River team as a Registered Echo Technician, you will oversee the quality assessment not only of the equipment but also our caregivers, which in turn helps aid to a positive patient experience. This role will provide you with plenty of hands-on learning and can act as a steppingstone to other careers within the field at Cleveland Clinic.

A caregiver in this position works days from 8:00AM – 4:30PM, with on-call requirements.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Perform echocardiograms, stress tests, stress echoes and Dobutamine stress echo.

  • Assist cardiologist with transesophageal echocardiograms.

  • Consult with cardiologists for interpretation of test results.

  • Maintain records of testing documentation.

  • Provide daily account of patient's charge requisition with appropriate ICD9 codes.

  • Provide training and acts as a resource for echocardiogram students, residents and physicians.

  • Provide testing for add-on emergency patients.

  • Always maintain complete and up-to-date documentation and files, including products and service quotes.

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Graduate from a two-year Cardiovascular Technologist program

  • Active Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) registry status from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography (ARDMS) OR Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) from the Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI)

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross

  • Strong interpersonal skills to interact effectively with patients, families, physicians and other caregivers

  • Ability to empathize with patients and families

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Five years of experience in echo and vascular ultrasound

Physical Requirements:

  • Interact with patients, families, physicians and other health care workers.

  • Good hand coordination for positioning of probe and equipment.

  • Good vision to analyze computer screens and VCR recordings to diagnose test results.

  • Use good judgment in stressful emergency situations.

  • Adequate mathematics skills to maintain accurate record and report.

  • Physical Duties: Moderate lifting and positioning of patients.

  • Moderate pushing and pulling of equipment.

  • Working Conditions: 100% air-conditioned.

  • Moderate risk of exposure to blood or air-borne pathogens

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows Standard Precautions using personal protective equipment as required for procedures.

title: Associate Director, Clinical AI Translation & Solutions
description:
Job Title: Director, AI Research


Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn complex clinical workflows into safe, measurable AI systems that accelerate trials and meaningfully improve patient outcomes? This role sits at the heart of how we design, conduct, monitor, and analyze clinical studies—translating real-world operations into AI solutions that scale across the enterprise and deliver tangible business value.

You will work side-by-side with clinical professionals and engineers to observe how work truly happens, identify where AI can safely help, and translate that understanding into working software. Do you thrive on building hands-on prototypes, making disciplined scope decisions, and staying accountable through evaluation, deployment, adoption, and iteration? Your initial focus will include agentic workflows for clinical operations, with the expectation that reusable patterns will extend across Clinical Development.

Accountabilities:

  • Portfolio Ownership: Own a portfolio of clinical AI workflows from discovery through deployment, adoption, and measurable benefit realization, ensuring early wins become platform capabilities.
  • Workflow Discovery and Design: Observe CRAs, site-monitoring leaders, clinical operations, and medical stakeholders to convert pain points into product requirements, data contracts, acceptance criteria, and evaluation plans.
  • Hands-on Prototyping and Delivery: Build and iterate prototypes in Python; contribute production code, review pull requests, inspect logs, reproduce failures, and collaborate with engineers to resolve them.
  • Agentic Workflow Design: Combine language models, deterministic services, enterprise tools, and human review with clear evidence provenance, uncertainty handling, and fail-safe behavior.
  • Scope and Release Discipline: Separate demonstrations from production releases and distinguish non-GxP workflows from regulated use, making transparent risk and lifecycle trade-offs.
  • Outcome Measurement: Define outcome measures spanning technical performance, clinical usefulness, workflow quality, user adoption, cycle time, and operational impact.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Testing: Lead testing with clinical experts and translate feedback into prioritized, testable product changes that increase trust and adoption.
  • Data Access and Governance: Partner with data-product owners and platform teams to establish reliable access to clinical systems, documents, and structured data while protecting privacy and integrity.
  • Compliance by Design: Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Security, and R&D IT to embed GCP, GxP, validation, auditability, and lifecycle requirements from the outset.
  • Reuse and Build/Buy Decisions: Promote reuse of enterprise platforms, data products, agent components, and evaluation assets; identify when to build, buy, partner, or adapt.
  • Communication and Influence: Communicate product decisions, evidence, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, clinical leaders, and executives.
  • Mentorship and Standards: Mentor scientists and engineers and raise the team’s standard for product thinking, technical execution, and clinical partnership.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline; or an MD, master’s degree, or equivalent experience supported by a strong computational track record.
  • 4 to 7 years of post-PhD (or equivalent) experience delivering applied AI/ML or data products, including experience in healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or another high-consequence domain.
  • Current, hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with experience using version control, tests, APIs, data pipelines, and modern cloud or containerized development environments.
  • Experience building or deploying LLM-based or agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, and human review.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into a bounded product, working prototype, measurable acceptance criteria, and delivery plan.
  • Ability to lead workflow-discovery and design sessions with clinical professionals and communicate credibly without oversimplifying clinical, operational, or regulatory constraints.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems using both technical metrics and expert judgment, including cases where ground truth is noisy, incomplete, or context dependent.
  • Strong understanding of trustworthy AI practices, and how to design provenance, access control, and uncertainty handling directly into a working system.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across engineering, scientific, clinical, quality, and executive audiences.
  • Evidence of leading cross-functional delivery through influence, including prioritization, conflict resolution, and shipping decisions under ambiguity.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Direct experience with clinical trial conduct, site monitoring, risk-based monitoring, medical monitoring, clinical data review, or trial technology in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or health-system environment.
  • Working knowledge of GCP and GxP computerized-system validation, and how to scope a feature for regulated versus non-regulated use before it is built.
  • Experience with clinical systems and data such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, safety systems, EHR, monitoring reports, or clinical data platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable product capabilities across multiple therapeutic areas, studies, or business units.
  • Familiarity with observability, LLMOps/MLOps, and production monitoring for deployed AI systems, and how evaluation results feed release decisions.
  • Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or a record of shipping technically differentiated AI products.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $144,648.8 to $216,973.2 USD. Our positions may be eligible for various incentives, including short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles, and commissions for sales roles. Benefits may include qualified retirement programs, paid time off—including vacation, holidays, and leave—as well as health, dental, and vision coverage, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.


AstraZeneca is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing a workplace free from discrimination. AstraZeneca is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Accommodation is available upon request for all aspects of the recruitment, assessment, and selection process. Requests may be made by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com.


Why AstraZeneca:

Join a technology-powered organization where your AI leadership directly shapes how life-changing medicines reach patients. Here, unexpected combinations of experts come together to tackle problems end to end—data foundations, AI models, platforms, and business applications—so your work moves from idea to enterprise scale. You will be empowered to take ownership, explore bold approaches, and push boundaries through hands-on experimentation, including hackathons and large-scale data challenges. We blend ambition with support: kindness matters as much as rigor; learning, coaching, and feedback are part of our daily rhythm; and every contribution is tied to a purpose bigger than any single team. This is a place to build trustworthy AI in partnership with clinicians and engineers, using cutting-edge tools while keeping patient impact front and center.


Call to Action:

If you are ready to lead hands-on, high-consequence AI that clinicians trust and engineers love—while creating reusable capabilities that move an entire enterprise—step forward and shape what’s next!

title: Analista Técnico de reaseguros
description:
Company:

Marsh

Description:

ANALISTA TÉCNICO DE REASEGUROS

Estamos buscando una persona talentosa para unirse a nuestro equipo de Operaciones en Marsh RE FAC en Marsh. Este rol estará basado en Bogotá, Colombia. Es un rol híbrido que requiere trabajar al menos tres días a la semana en la oficina.

El/La Analista Técnico(a) de Reaseguros (FAC) ejecuta el soporte técnico–operativo del negocio de reaseguros facultativos (colocación y administración), asegurando calidad, oportunidad y consistencia en la preparación de información, emisión de documentación técnica, control de registros y cumplimiento de lineamientos internos, regulatorios y contractuales. Actúa como enlace técnico entre el equipo comercial, aseguradoras/reaseguradores y áreas internas, y contribuye a la mejora continua del proceso.

Contaremos contigo para:

  • Analizar a detalle múltiples fuentes de información de manera manual para entender la colocación de un negocio de reaseguro y asegurar que se cuenta con toda la documentación necesaria para ingresar a sistema los cálculos presentados; en caso de faltantes, identificar con claridad qué documentos o información se requieren e instruir al área comercial para su obtención.
  • Consolidar, depurar y analizar información de cartera/exposiciones para procesos de renovación y nuevas colocaciones.
  • Dar seguimiento al ciclo documental completo: colocación, confirmaciones, notas de cobertura, wordings/clauses, endosos y evidencias de aceptación.
  • Garantizar la elaboración/procesamiento oportuno y preciso de borradores de notas de cobertura y endosos.
  • Validar consistencia de términos y condiciones vs. aprobaciones internas y ofertas del mercado (sumas, comisiones, cláusulas, territorialidad, vigencias).
  • Registrar en sistema las colocaciones de reaseguro y mantener actualizados los registros del sistema informático, asegurando trazabilidad y control.
  • Gestionar y realizar seguimiento de documentación vigente y pendiente (incluyendo documentación compleja y confidencial), priorizando el cierre oportuno de pendientes.
  • Garantizar la elaboración/procesamiento oportuno y preciso de: facturas y documentación relacionada con pólizas; cotizaciones y placing slips; cálculos de primas y ajustes.
  • Gestionar requerimientos técnicos con reaseguradores/retrocesionarios (información adicional, aclaraciones, ajustes de wording) y coordinar con stakeholders internos y externos según se requiera.
  • Aplicar checklists de calidad y controles operativos (completitud documental, métricas de tiempos, auditoría interna) y cumplir estrictamente con las prácticas, políticas y procedimientos de Calidad de la Compañía.
  • Gestionar y priorizar tu propia carga de trabajo para cumplir con objetivos individuales de SLA, KPI y Calidad; el horario es de lunes a viernes 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. No se trabajan festivos.
  • Mantener una comprensión básica de los aspectos clave del reaseguro relevante y de la legislación relacionada (conciencia del cliente).
  • Trabajar con diferentes stakeholders en la compañía para identificar oportunidades de mejora continua, proponiendo estandarización de plantillas, automatizaciones y mejoras de proceso.
  • Desarrollar y mantener relaciones de trabajo sólidas con partes interesadas internas y externas; mantener conocimiento del negocio del cliente y de sus necesidades de seguros.

Lo que necesitas tener:

  • Formación profesional (con experiencia relevante) en Ingeniería Industrial, Derecho, Contabilidad, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.
  • 3 años de experiencia en equipos técnicos de reaseguros o seguros.
  • Conocimiento sólido en reaseguros (idealmente en procesos técnicos/operativos de colocación y administración).
  • Paquete Office con énfasis en:Excel intermedio: manejo y análisis de bases de datos, tablas dinámicas, cruces de información (no se requiere macros, pero sí muy buen dominio).
  • Perfil muy numérico y analítico orientado al análisis detallado de documentación (más análisis “caso a caso” que manejo de bases de datos masivas).
  • Inglés básico o intermedio (deseable): capacidad para redactar correos y analizar información en inglés.

Lo que te hace destacar:

  • Alta atención al detalle y enfoque en calidad en entornos con documentación sensible/confidencial.
  • Fortaleza para identificar inconsistencias, faltantes y riesgos en documentación/términos, y proponer acciones correctivas con claridad.
  • Interés por estandarizar y mejorar procesos (plantillas, automatizaciones y controles).

Por qué unirte a nuestro equipo:

• Te ayudamos a ser tu mejor versión a través de oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, trabajo interesante y líderes que te apoyan.
• Fomentamos una cultura vibrante e inclusiva donde puedes trabajar con colegas talentosos para crear nuevas soluciones y tener impacto en colegas, clientes y comunidades.
• Nuestra escala nos permite ofrecer una variedad de oportunidades de carrera, así como beneficios y recompensas para mejorar tu bienestar.

Competencias / comportamientos clave para el rol (a evaluar durante el proceso):

  • Atención al cliente y actitud de servicio.
  • Capacidad analítica y de organización.
  • Gestión del tiempo y priorización.
  • Proactividad, sentido de urgencia y buena comunicación.
  • Trabajo en equipo enfocado a resultados y colaboración con otros departamentos.
  • Capacidad para resolver problemas y tomar decisiones rápidas y efectivas.
  • Adaptación al cambio.
  • Análisis al detalle (consistencia documental y numérica).

title: Intake Clerk
description:
Position Summary:

Arranges for the efficient and orderly admission of inpatients, and outpatients to our Partial Hospitalization and Intensive outpatient programs. Ensures that the patient information is collected and that patients are aware of hospital policies and procedures. Interviews incoming patient or representatives and enters information required for admission into computer database. Distributes appropriate information to ancillary departments. Participates in performance improvement and continuous quality improvement (CQI) activities.

Position Responsibilities:

Clinical / Technical Skills (40% of performance review)

  • Responsible for accepting admissions for hospital services.
  • Coordinating referrals and admissions from a physician’s office, local Emergency Rooms and other community referrals and pre-admitting these patients.
  • Responsible for preregistering patients for scheduled admissions and outpatient programs and checking insurance eligibility.
  • Responsible for interviewing patients or their representative for obtaining personal information or verifying information already on file, including emergency numbers and insurance information.
  • Responsible for obtaining signatures on Conditions of Admission, all other admission forms/consent and initiating the advance directive process. Communicates with Nursing Services when no advance directive is available.
  • Responsible for starting Q15 checks on all patients.
  • Provides information to the patient/representative about the complaint process, patient rights, HIPAA and visiting hours. Distributes hospital specific literature.
  • Responsible for insuring that a patient’s valuables are taken home by a family member or secured in the safe.
  • Communicates appropriately and clearly to supervisor, nurse managers, co-workers and physicians.
  • Consults other departments as appropriate to provide for an interdisciplinary approach to the patient’s needs.

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
IT Operations Manager

The IT Operations Manager is responsible for the smooth functioning of all IT, AV and security systems at Lakehouse Resort and St. Mark Golf, a 150-room independent resort in San Marcos with two golf courses, restaurants and extensive event venues. Because the resort does not use a third-party IT service provider or outside AV/event production company, this is a hands-on, systems- and events-heavy role: the IT Operations Manager is the on-property owner of all technology and the technical lead for every event. This role oversees a team of 1-2 IT personnel responsible for carrying out all IT and AV duties as determined by Corporate IT and in line with company standards.

THE DUTIES OF THE IT OPERATIONS MANAGER INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO, THE FOLLOWING:

· Own the day-to-day operation of all resort technology across the hotel, both golf courses, clubhouses, restaurants, and event venues; with no third-party managed service provider, the department is the first and final line of support

· Manage and troubleshoot large-scale IP networks with multiple VLANs, including core/edge switching, firewalls and internet circuits

· Manage and troubleshoot wireless infrastructure, including guest HSIA, back-of-house and outdoor coverage across the golf courses and event lawns

· Administer and support property systems including Opera Cloud PMS, Simphony POS, Jonas Club, golf tee sheet and handheld devices, phone system, IPTV and their interfaces

· Manage security systems including CCTV/video surveillance, access control and guest room locking systems in coordination with Security

· Maintain PCI DSS compliance, cybersecurity controls, endpoint protection, patching, backups and disaster recovery in line with Corporate IT standards

· Serve as the final on-property escalation point for the IT Department, resolving issues promptly with minimal downtime to guests and operations

· Regularly inspect all physical layer infrastructure such as cabling, MDF/IDF closets, switches and access points to ensure networks are performing optimally

· Manage vendor and carrier relationships directly (ISP, telecom, PMS/POS, low-voltage contractors), including service tickets, quotes and escalations

· Maintain accurate hardware/software asset inventory, licensing and network documentation

· Create documentation and standards for the department with little to no supervision; conduct property-wide technology training

· Assist department leaders with key property initiatives as necessary

· Serve as the in-house technology and AV lead for all events, including conferences, weddings, banquets, golf tournaments and outdoor activations, with no outside AV or production company

· Review BEOs and attend weekly event meetings with Sales, Catering and Golf to plan AV, network, power and connectivity requirements

· Set up, operate and strike event AV including projectors, LED walls/displays, audio/PA, microphones, lighting and livestream/hybrid meeting equipment

· Deploy temporary wired and wireless networks, POS and scoring connectivity for outdoor events and golf tournaments

· Maintain, inventory and plan replacement of the AV equipment fleet; coordinate supplemental AV rentals when needed and support AV revenue with Sales & Catering

· Provide on-site technical support during live events, resolving issues in real time

· Able to work nights, weekends and holidays based on event schedules and rotate being on-call

· Excellent leadership, people management, communication and influencing skills at a senior level

· Select, effectively manage and coach direct reports

· Motivate and effectively performance manage the department to ensure delivery of overall targets and business plan

· Strong problem-solving skills; able to work with minimal supervision

· Deliver projects on time and on budget as determined by Corporate IT and ownership

· Manage the property IT and AV operating and capital budgets with the Corporate VP of IT

· 3-5 years of experience in a hotel, resort or club IT environment, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role; event AV experience strongly preferred.

· Proven experience managing Windows Active Directory environments, specifically hybrid AD / Microsoft Entra ID environments.

· Windows Server 2019/2022, Microsoft 365, Azure/Intune and Windows 11 management skills

· Experience troubleshooting hotel PMS and POS systems and their architectures, including Opera Cloud, Simphony POS, Jonas Club, Agilysys and other key hotel and resort systems

· Strong understanding of networking protocols such as DNS, DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, TCPIP, ARP, NTP, STP

· Advanced hardware troubleshooting experience, with the ability to diagnose physical and component-level failures from peripheral devices through internal system components, including RAM, storage, power delivery, CPUs, and motherboards.

· Hyper-V management skills and understanding of HA architectures

· Hands-on experience with event AV systems (audio mixing, wireless microphones, projection/displays, DSP and control systems) and temporary event network deployments

· Working knowledge of firewalls, CCTV/access control systems and PCI DSS requirements

· IT/AV certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA or AVIXA CTS preferred but not required

· Ability to travel between the resort, golf courses and off-site locations as needed.

· Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.

· Ability to write clearly and concisely.

· Ability to follow safety practices and be safety conscious.

· Ability to work both independently and as part of the team.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

· Able to stand, walk, and sit up to 8 hours in a single day.

· Able to lift up to 75 lbs. and move AV and network equipment using carts, dollies and golf carts.

· Able to climb ladders and work outdoors in varying weather conditions during events and golf operations.

· Occasionally required to sit, climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear, taste, smell.

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK:

· Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, team members may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. Work schedules will include working on holidays, weekends, and alternate shifts. Position requires working from property location.

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer II, Frontier Engineering
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer II for our Frontier Engineering team. This team embeds directly with Snowflake's most strategic customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems . At the IC6 level, you serve as the senior technical authority and architectural leader for a portfolio of high-impact customer engagements. You operate as a peer technical advisor to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, chief architects, and heads of data and AI, setting technical direction that extends beyond individual accounts and influences how Snowflake delivers AI solutions at scale.

AS A PRINCIPAL FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER II YOU WILL:

  • Serve as the senior technical authority and architectural leader for customer engineering leadership: Build durable, peer-level relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, chief architects, and heads of data and AI at Snowflake’s most strategic accounts. Lead architectural steering, technical reviews, and executive strategy alignment while shaping multi-year AI roadmaps across a portfolio of customers.

  • Drive Architecture and Technical Strategy Across a Portfolio of High-Stakes Deployments: Set the technical strategy, architecture, and execution model across multiple complex, high-visibility AI engagements. Own end-to-end outcomes, arbitrate the most difficult cross-system tradeoffs, and establish patterns that scale across customers, teams, and business units.

  • Influence Snowflake Product Direction: Translate recurring customer needs and deployment learnings into clear product requirements, partner with Product and Engineering leaders, and drive adoption of capabilities that improve outcomes across the field.

  • Stay hands-on and set the engineering bar: Write production code and working prototypes on the most critical or ambiguous parts of customer programs, review designs and code, and demonstrate the technical depth and judgment expected across the organization.

  • Set the AI quality and reliability bar: Define organization-level standards for evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, and responsible deployment. Turn ambiguous customer goals into clear, testable measures and ensure those standards are applied consistently across engagements.

  • Provide technical leadership and develop senior technical talent: Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior engineers; develop technical leads; raise engineering standards across the organization; and lead through influence across Engineering, Product, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Travel to Customer Sites: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite working with customers.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including a sustained track record of building and shipping production AI/ML or agentic systems at enterprise scale.

  • Proven track record serving as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs and executive engineering leaders at large enterprises, and setting technical direction across multiple strategic accounts or enterprise programs.

  • Demonstrated success converting client and field delivery patterns into reusable platforms, tools, frameworks, reference architectures, or open-source libraries adopted across teams or customers.

  • Deep expertise in production AI architectures—including RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic systems, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, security, and operating models for enterprise-scale adoption.

  • Hands-on technical leader who writes and reviews production code, stays close to implementation, and can move from executive strategy to the critical technical details that determine whether a system succeeds.

  • Exceptional systems thinking and technical communication skills across deeply technical and executive audiences, with the ability to influence without formal authority and align multiple organizations around a common technical strategy.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience leading cross-organizational technical initiatives that improve how enterprise AI solutions are designed, deployed, and adopted.

  • Active contributions to open-source AI frameworks, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.

  • Familiarity with Cortex AI, Snowpark, or modern enterprise data infrastructure platforms.

WHY JOIN FRONTIER ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE?

Frontier Engineering is where Snowflake’s AI platform meets reality. You’re not building demos, you’re shipping AI applications that run in some of the world’s most complex enterprise environments. At the IC6 level, you also define the reusable architectures, engineering standards, and product feedback loops that allow these solutions to scale across customers. title: Premium & VIP Experiences Intern
description:
Powered by Passion. United by Purpose. Build for Impact.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

The Premium & VIP Experiences Intern will join MLSE’s Premium & VIP Experiences team, gaining unique exposure to some of the organization’s most exclusive hospitality programs, premium spaces, experiences and commercial initiatives.

Working closely with leadership and the VIP portfolio, this role offers a rare opportunity to learn from some of the best in the sports and entertainment industry while contributing to experiences for MLSE’s most valued members, clients and guests.

The successful candidate will work across MLSE’s teams, venues and live entertainment portfolio, gaining hands-on experience in VIP hospitality, premium experiences, commercial strategy, innovation and service excellence. From supporting signature experiences and new premium concepts to researching global best practices and helping bring new ideas to life, no two days will be the same.

This internship is designed for someone who is curious, ambitious and passionate about creating exceptional experiences and wants a front-row seat to how premium sports and entertainment hospitality comes together.

Responsibilities

  • Support the planning and execution of Premium & VIP experiences across MLSE teams, venues and live events.
  • Work closely with the VIP portfolio on initiatives designed to elevate experiences for MLSE’s most valued members, clients, partners and guests.
  • Contribute to commercial initiatives and new revenue opportunities, helping develop and bring new premium concepts and experiences to market.
  • Research global trends and best practices across sports, entertainment, hospitality, luxury and experiential industries to help identify new ideas and innovations for MLSE.
  • Support the development and evolution of premium hospitality spaces, membership programs, benefits and service offerings.
  • Collaborate with teams across the organization including Ticketing, Partnerships, Marketing, Live Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Venue Operations and others to bring premium experiences to life.
  • Assist with VIP member and guest servicing, delivering thoughtful, personalized support and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Support premium seating and in-venue experiences on event and game days.
  • Help maintain key VIP and premium membership information, reporting and program insights.
  • Support research, presentations and business cases for future commercial and experiential opportunities.
  • Stay connected to key dates, events and priorities across MLSE teams and venues to help ensure seamless execution.
  • Bring forward fresh thinking and ideas that challenge how MLSE can continue to elevate the premium and VIP experience.
  • Adhere to all MLSE standards and policies and work in compliance with the Occupational Health & Safety Act.

Qualifications

Note: Before reviewing the qualifications listed below, we want you to know that we understand you may not meet all the qualifications described and have other relevant expertise and experience. We invite you to please share this with us in the "Message to the Hiring Manager" section of our online application.

· Currently enrolled in a University or College degree, diploma or certificate program in business, sport management, hospitality, events, marketing, communications or a related field.

· Passion for sports, entertainment, hospitality and creating exceptional experiences.

· Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in premium experiences, consumer trends, innovation and emerging technologies.

· Proactive and resourceful, with the initiative to take ownership, solve problems and adapt to changing priorities.

· Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with colleagues, senior leaders, clients and VIP guests.

· Collaborative team player who is comfortable working across different teams, brands, venues and areas of the business.

· Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering work and experiences to a high standard.

· Demonstrates discretion, professionalism and sound judgment, particularly when working with confidential information and high-profile guests.

· Comfortable using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, with an openness to learning new digital platforms, tools and technologies.

· Available to support MLSE home games, concerts, special events and experiences, including select evenings and weekends.

· Previous experience in sports or entertainment is not required; curiosity, potential, a strong work ethic and a genuine desire to learn are highly valued.
