title: Senior Software Engineer, Bioinformatics
description:
About Variantyx

Join our rapidly growing, engineering-driven organization and help build the software that powers the future of whole genome diagnostics. Backed by leading life sciences investors, we have achieved industry-leading diagnostic yield and unit economics through a fully vertically integrated pipeline that spans from sample to report. At the core of our success is a proprietary clinical platform that uniquely enables our workflows, allowing us to solve complex biological data challenges at scale. With a strong global presence across our internal teams and external partnerships, we offer the stability of a well-funded industry leader combined with the agility of a high-growth tech company.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to lead the architectural evolution of our core germline clinical bioinformatics pipeline.


Our production pipeline is a large-scale, high-throughput system written primarily in Python. We continue to push the frontier of diagnostic capabilities while also heavily scaling our operations. As part of a small team, you will be expected to take ownership of your work, and to provide clean, well-tested, well-documented, optimized code.


This is not a research position;
it is a production engineering role. You will not just be running tools;
you will be designing and implementing new variant detection modules, supporting and refactoring legacy logic, and identifying key areas for optimization. In addition to translating business requirements into precise technical specifications and implementing them, you will be expected to understand how your code supports our business workflows and how your code affects other teams. Working in a highly-regulated clinical environment means enforcing strict software quality standards to ensure our clinical results are accurate and reproducible, every single time.


What You Will Do

  • Performance Engineering: Identify bottlenecks and opportunities for optimization in our core primary, secondary, and tertiary bioinformatics pipelines.
  • Increase Automation: You will help scale sample throughput by automating business processes, from tasks in the development lifecycle to tasks in the production workflow.
  • Feature Development: You will design, develop, validate, and deploy cutting-edge algorithms for clinical-grade variant detection, making use of our high-performance CPU and GPU compute cluster.


Required Qualifications

Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computational Biology, or similar. 3+ years of industry experience.


  • Production Software Engineering: You are experienced developing production-grade software. You understand the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) deeply. You are experienced with pytest, mocking strategies, and writing modular, testable code.
  • Python Mastery: You are an expert in Python internals, packaging, and design patterns. You know how to untangle complex dependencies and write clean, Pythonic code.
  • Linux/Bash Expert: You live in the terminal. You are comfortable debugging complex interactions in a Linux environment and writing robust shell scripts.
  • Bioinformatics Expertise: Production experience, and significant experience with standard file formats (FASTQ / BAM / CRAM / VCF) and variant calling algorithms and common tools. Experience with short- and long-read sequencing platforms.
  • Strong Architecture Sense: You have experience designing and implementing efficient new processes in a complex environment.


Preferred Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computational Biology, or similar. 5+ years of industry experience.


  • Typescript Experience: Experience writing Typescript, to interface with our MongoDB data layer and execute workflows.
  • Rust Experience: Experience writing Rust, particularly for Python extensions (Maturin/PyO3). C++ experience is also acceptable if you are willing to learn Rust.
  • Database Design: Experience with MongoDB and Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS). Experience designing normalized schemas and performing data migrations.


Compensation and Benefits

  • Employee Stock Options Plan (ESOP)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability insurance
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan

description:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Engineering at Qualified


Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and

embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup, backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback.


You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role


The Brain team owns the intelligence layer behind Piper, our flagship AI SDR product for qualifying leads and booking meetings. Our team is responsible for building, maintaining, and upgrading the agents that power Piper to support new

capabilities and model releases. We own the system prompts, model configuration, context layer, evals, and harness that powers Piper behind the scenes.


What You'll Do


You will work closely with product teams to build the products and features that allow our customers to bring their customer GTM strategy, CRM data, and guardrails together to deliver an on-brand, personalized, muilti-modal AI SDR

agent experience to their website and email.


You will work closely with the AI platform teams to build and maintain LLM evals that measure Piperʼs overall health, response quality, and ensure that those changes contribute to business outcomes like converting leads, booking meetings, and driving pipeline.


Who You Are


Minimum of 5 years of experience working in product engineering or related fields.


Customer-centric thinking: have a deep connection of our customers' needs and how that translates to the experiences that we build for them. Much of your work will be tuning the agent to cater towards that, so you must be comfortable working backwards from a customer's preference and finding ways to capture human judgment as success criteria for an agent.


Product engineering and ownership. Strong full-stack fundamentals and proficiency in frontend and backend development. Ability to work independently and engage with product and domain experts, spot gaps, and own the ideas through to production. Experience shipping real-time and text- based LLM products is nice to have. Weʼre language-agnostic; familiarity with Rails and React is a bonus.Brain Team Job Rec1


Agent fundamentals. You understand the core building blocks of agents: traces, context and tokens, tools, system prompts, models, latency and reasoning tradeoffs, MCP, etc. You know how to troubleshoot a LLM response and identify the source of the issue in the trace. You have an opinion on the strengths and weaknesses of different frontier models. You know what agents are and are not good for. Hands-on work with an LLM observability system, building or contributing to an eval system is a plus.




Nice to Have


Agentic development. Comfortable building alongside agents and utilizing coding agents effectively in your daily development. You can recognize poor quality code and writing produced by agents and know how to steer them towards a high-quality outcome on large tasks. You know how to use them to automate easy/repetitive tasks and build your domain expertise.


Experience building software for marketing, sales, or go-to-market teams, particularly integrations with Salesforce and other CRM platforms. You understand how customer data, lead qualification, routing, and sales workflows fit together, and can translate that understanding into reliable product experiences.


Startup experience and rapid shipping.


Why Join Qualified


Foundational impact: Shape how our AI agents retrieve, reason, and answer, and the tooling every engineer here uses to build them.


Lead real initiatives: Own significant projects end to end, with scope and

influence that grow as you deliver. You'll own the platform as it scales, from retrieval to model providers to agent orchestration, and set the performance and reliability bar that grows with the company.


AI as a core product surface: Turn new AI capabilities into dependable

experiences that customers trust, with strong engineering around evaluation, observability, and iteration.


High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.


Room to grow: Take on larger technical and product scope over time: leading projects, influencing architecture, and leveling up quickly.


If you're excited to build retrieval systems and agent infrastructure at the intersection of AI and enterprise software, we'd love to hear from you.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Process Improvement and Technology

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile App Development
description:
Job Description Summary

The Patient Care Solutions Mobile Center of Excellence (Mobile CoE) is focused on building secure, scalable and high-quality mobile solutions while establishing reusable capabilities, engineering patterns and development practices that can be adopted across multiple products.

The Senior Software Engineer is a strong hands-on technical contributor responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of mobile application features and shared mobile capabilities. The role works closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, UX, Security, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned with Mobile CoE architecture and engineering standards.

The individual should have strong mobile engineering fundamentals and demonstrate expertise in mobile architecture, performance, security, observability, automation, CI/CD, AWS cloud-integrated development and AI-assisted software engineering.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and deliver high-quality mobile application features, reusable components and shared capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads and UX teams to understand requirements, assess technical feasibility and translate requirements into implementable solutions.
  • Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews and architecture decisions, bringing a strong mobile engineering perspective.
  • Apply established Mobile CoE architecture patterns, coding standards and engineering practices, while contributing improvements based on implementation experience.
  • Build reusable mobile components, libraries and common capabilities that can be adopted across applications where appropriate.
  • Maintain high code quality through clean design, code reviews, unit testing, automated quality checks and secure coding practices.
  • Understand the end-to-end application architecture, APIs, AWS services and integrations while developing deep expertise in assigned components.
  • Analyze and improve mobile application performance, reliability, security and user experience using appropriate profiling, diagnostics and engineering practices.
  • Implement appropriate mobile security practices including authentication, authorization, secure storage, session/token management and protection of sensitive data.
  • Build appropriate logging, telemetry, crash reporting and observability into mobile applications to support troubleshooting and operational monitoring.
  • Contribute to automated build, test, CI/CD and release processes and continuously improve engineering efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective solutions.
  • Adopt an AI-first engineering mindset, using AI-assisted tools throughout the SDLC for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, code understanding, technical documentation and developer productivity.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI to automate repetitive engineering activities, accelerate development and improve software quality, while ensuring appropriate human review and validation.
  • Apply responsible AI-assisted development practices, ensuring generated code and recommendations are reviewed for correctness, security, maintainability and compliance.
  • Share technical knowledge, reusable solutions, AI-enabled engineering practices and implementation learnings across the Mobile CoE.

Desired Technical Skills / Experience

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience, preferably 7+ years, with significant experience in mobile application development.
  • Strong experience with one or more modern mobile technologies such as Flutter, React Native, iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin.
  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, state management, navigation, application lifecycle and API integration.
  • Experience building reusable mobile components, SDKs, libraries or shared capabilities across applications.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile application performance optimization including startup, responsiveness, memory/resource utilization and network performance.
  • Good understanding of UX principles, accessibility and mobile design systems.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secure storage, encryption, session/token management and secure mobile development practices.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and AWS-hosted backend services.
  • Experience with automated testing including unit, integration and mobile UI automation.
  • Experience with mobile build automation and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with logging, telemetry, crash reporting, diagnostics and application performance monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and cloud-integrated mobile architectures, with an understanding of reliability, performance, security and cost-conscious engineering.
  • Experience with static code analysis, security scanning and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe software development practices.
  • Strong practical experience using AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering tools for coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation and code review support.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions rather than accepting generated code by default, with appropriate attention to security, quality, maintainability and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer productivity, engineering automation and software quality.
  • Exposure to building or integrating AI-enabled application capabilities is an advantage.
  • Experience developing healthcare, regulated or security-sensitive applications is preferred.

Mobile CoE Mindset

  • Think beyond a single application and identify opportunities for reuse and standardization across mobile products.
  • Prefer common patterns and shared capabilities over application-specific solutions where appropriate.
  • Contribute implementation learnings back into Mobile CoE standards, reference patterns and engineering practices.
  • Help improve developer productivity through automation, AI-assisted engineering, tooling and common development practices.
  • Collaborate across product teams to encourage consistent approaches to architecture, security, quality, performance and observability.
  • Experiment with emerging mobile and AI engineering technologies, evaluate their practical value and help bring useful practices into the CoE.
  • Share reusable approaches and engineering learnings so that improvements made for one product can benefit other mobile teams.

Preferred Professional Training and Certifications

  • Professional training or certifications related to iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native or other relevant mobile technologies.
  • AWS cloud fundamentals or developer certification.
  • Training or certification related to AI-assisted software development, application security, DevOps, Agile or software architecture is an advantage.

Desired Professional Characteristics

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments.
  • Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, UX, Security, QA and DevOps teams.
  • Proactive in identifying technical problems and proposing practical solutions.
  • Willingness to share knowledge and support other engineers through technical discussions and code reviews.
  • Curious and experimental mindset toward AI and emerging engineering technologies, balanced with sound engineering judgment.
  • Continuous learning mindset with interest in advancing mobile, AWS and AI-enabled software engineering practices.

title: Data Analytics CPU Workload Performance Product Manager
description:
We're building a new generation of data center CPUs at NVIDIA — Vera, Grace, and future designs purpose-built for accelerated computing and the workloads defining infrastructure. Data analytics is one of the highest-value arenas for CPU performance, and we need someone to own NVIDIA's strategy and value proposition there! This role sits at the nexus of go-to-market, software architecture, platform architecture, performance measurement, and competitive positioning — making it a true workload strategy role, not a benchmark-running one. From TPC-H and TPC-DS methodologies to collaborative solutions with the world's leading database and analytics vendors, the scope is broad and the impact is real. We're looking for a product manager who deeply understands how CPUs win in practice and can turn that insight into roadmap decisions, customer proof points, and field-ready positioning.


What you'll be doing:

  • Taking responsibility for the workload and market approach for data analytics and data processing on NVIDIA data center CPUs — identifying priority workloads, customer scenarios, and the benchmarks and proof points that should guide the roadmap.
  • Leading the complete lifecycle of benchmarks like TPC-H and TPC-DS: methodology, cluster and benchmarking architecture, competitive analysis, and market positioning.
  • Translating disk, cache, memory, I/O, clustering, availability, and software behavior into concrete CPU, platform, and system requirements. Then advising architecture and platform teams on what to build and why.
  • Building the quantitative value proposition across performance, infrastructure, software licensing, power, and TCO to position NVIDIA CPUs against challenging architectures.
  • Working alongside external ISVs, database and analytics vendors, cloud providers, and strategic customers to verify requirements and build joint solutions and go-to-market approaches.
  • Redefining benchmark results and customer evidence into product decisions, competitive reactions, customer proof points, and field enablement materials.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years of experience in technical product management, performance engineering, or a closely related area.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering — or equivalent experience.
  • Comprehensive, practical knowledge of CPU and database performance.
  • Understanding of system hardware characteristics that influence analytics performance — caching and clustering methods, high availability, memory and I/O sensitivity, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Ability to influence platform and architecture teams by translating workload performance into product, platform, and feature requirements.
  • Experience collaborating with external ISVs, silicon vendors, or the broader analytics ecosystem.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience with TPC-H, TPC-DS, or comparable data analytics benchmarks, including methodology development and measurement.
  • Understanding of the disk, cache, and memory sensitivities of database and analytics workloads at scale.
  • Experience with market entry strategies, solution presentation, or the wider data analytics provider and cloud environment.
  • Background in accelerated computing platforms or data center CPU product launches.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 5, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 19, 2026.

title: SIU Investigator
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$70,400.00 - $116,200.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Investigative Services provides industry-first resources designed to detect and deter fraudulent claims. Using some of the most comprehensive technology available, we have the abilities and expertise to identify potential risks and combat fraudulent practices. As an SIU Investigator, you will analyze, summarize and prioritize information to uncover potentially fraudulent activity. The investigator, supporting a Claim Center, will investigate claims deemed suspicious in nature within all lines of business. The investigator will conduct thorough and comprehensive investigations in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

What Will You Do?

  • Conducts insurance investigations including applicable data base searches with a focus on uncovering all potentially fraudulent aspects of a claim. Periodically engages in specialized investigative area, including Medical, Cyber, Cargo, Fire Motive & Opportunity, etc.
  • Analyzes, monitors and summarizes technical information into actionable investigative strategies. Applies the techniques of critical thinking to dismantle complex problems and reasoning through to its logical conclusion.
  • Provides exceptional customer service by maintaining contact with business partners, customers and external resources throughout the life of each investigation, including liaison network with claim, legal, underwriting partners, public officials, law enforcement officers and others to obtain assistance in conducting investigations.
  • Serves as the subject matter expert (liaison) on fraud to business and industry partners.
  • Applies rules of evidence; recognizes evidence and determines its value to specific claim, evidence collection and interpretation.
  • Applies Local, State and Federal statutes to ensure investigations are carried out within the requirements of applicable law and local office expectations.
  • Identifies cases for potential insurance fraud prosecution and submits questionable claims to the National Insurance Crime Bureau.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Candidate must meet NYS Department of Financial Services Regulation 95 requirements for SIU Investigators: 1. an Associates or Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice or a related field; or 2. Five years of insurance claims investigation experience or professional investigation experience with law enforcement agencies; or 3. Seven years of professional investigation experience involving economic or insurance related matters; or a4. an authorized medical professional to evaluate medical related claims.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to use and interpret information and facts as well as apply critical techniques to investigative process.
  • Strong case management skills and the ability to manage your own work independently.
  • Ability to work in a high volume, fast paced environment managing multiple shifting priorities.
  • Influence and conflict management skills
  • Working level knowledge of insurance and claim operations, Commercial Lines, Personal Lines, and Workers Compensation insurance products.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of investigative experience or a minimum of three years insurance claim or underwriting or legal related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit .

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Specialist Solution Engineer – Analytics (Tableau)

Location: This position is based in the Pacific Time zone and is open to candidates located in Washington and California. Fully remote and hybrid work arrangements are available.

Travel: Up to 25% travel for customer engagements and team events.

Overview
Join the Salesforce Solution Engineering team and help the world’s top technology companies turn data into decisions. Our Solution Engineers work with customers, Sales, Product, and Professional Services to drive the technical sale and help customers realize business value across the entire lifecycle.

What Role Are We Hiring For?
This Analytics Specialist Solution Engineer (Tableau) role supports our Technology, Media & Telecom (TMT) Enterprise accounts. You’ll partner with Account Executives and Analytics sales teams to show how Tableau, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics work with Agentforce and the modern data stack. TMT customers run on platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Google BigQuery, and other cloud data platforms, so you’ll meet them where their data already lives.

You’ll be a hands-on builder and a recognized thought leader who takes an idea from a whiteboard to a working solution, and can present it to the C-suite.

Responsibilities

  • Align solutions to the technology challenges of complex TMT Enterprise accounts. Drive consensus across multi-product solutions, with a primary focus on the Analytics portfolio.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on business development, strategy, and product demonstrations.
  • Lead with thought leadership: share a point of view on analytics, AI, and data trends through customer conversations, executive briefings, events, and internal enablement.
  • Present to the C-suite: confidently engage CXO-level stakeholders and connect technical solutions to business outcomes.
  • Define ambiguous business problems through discovery, then recommend practical next steps.
  • Build, don’t just present: create working demos, rapid prototypes, and proof-of-value solutions that take a customer idea to a tangible outcome.
  • Bring a deep understanding of LLMs, including building agents on both open and closed models.
  • Build data models hands-on in Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, and other platforms.
  • Understand token consumption and design architectures that manage it effectively.
  • Advise on customer data and analytics architecture, including how Tableau and Salesforce integrate with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery) and transformation tooling (dbt).
  • Apply sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, Value Selling) to qualify opportunities, build business cases, and advance deals alongside the account team.
  • Tailor solutions and demos for multiple personas, from data engineers to executives.
  • Complete product, sales, and procedural training and certifications.



Required Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, Data Science, or equivalent experience. We evaluate experience on core competencies, including leadership, military service, volunteer work, and work history.
  • Deep industry experience, with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite executives.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership in analytics, data, or AI, such as speaking, publishing, or advising customers on strategy.
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or Tableau Next. Familiarity with data visualization, dashboarding, and self-service analytics best practices.
  • Hands-on expertise with modern cloud data warehouses and data lakes.
  • Practical experience with the modern analytics stack, such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, and dbt.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills across structured and semi-structured data.
  • A proven builder mindset, with a track record of taking ideas to working solutions.
  • Working knowledge of sales methodologies and how a technical role supports a deal cycle.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. You’re comfortable with technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior solution engineer, sales engineer, or consultant experience at a CRM, analytics, or BI company, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience selling to or supporting technology, media, or telecom customers.
  • Experience building with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) as part of a demo toolkit.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and how analytics platforms surface AI-driven insights (Einstein, agentic AI, predictive analytics).
  • Basic scripting experience (Python, JavaScript, HTML, or similar).
  • Salesforce and Tableau certifications.
  • Experience with design thinking, persona-based discovery, or workshop facilitation.



How We Work

  • Builder mentality: we show up with working demos and real solutions, not just slides.
  • Customer obsession: we go deep on customer problems before prescribing solutions.
  • Peer teaching: we share what we learn, internally, with customers, and at industry events.
  • Flexibility: fully remote or hybrid, working Pacific Time hours.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About the Role
Jungheinrich Lift Truck is seeking a Senior Product Engineer to support the integration, testing, implementation, and ongoing development of assistance systems for the North American market.
In this role, you will serve as a key technical resource, working closely with engineering, product development, service teams, and customers to ensure the successful implementation and performance of assistance system technologies across our lift truck product portfolio. You will be responsible for troubleshooting complex technical issues, coordinating field testing, supporting product enhancements, and ensuring our solutions meet the unique requirements of the North American market.
The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, hands-on experience with industrial lift trucks, and the ability to collaborate across teams to solve problems and continuously improve product performance.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the integration, implementation, testing, and ongoing technical support of assistance systems for the North American lift truck market.
  • Coordinate engineering activities related to product development, feature testing, system integration, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Serve as a primary technical point of contact for complex field issues, providing advanced (Level 3) technical support and driving timely resolution.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute field tests, system validations, and proof-of-concept activities to evaluate product performance and functionality.
  • Perform system commissioning, configuration, software updates, troubleshooting, and recovery using appropriate diagnostic and service tools.
  • Analyze system errors and performance data, including log files, to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and develop effective troubleshooting solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering and development teams to evaluate technical issues, validate solutions, and support continuous product improvement.
  • Provide technical consultation and ongoing support for assistance systems throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support the integration of new features and technologies into lift trucks designed for the North American market.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, dealers, and customers to gather technical feedback and identify market-specific product requirements.
  • Develop and deliver technical knowledge-sharing and train-the-trainer initiatives to support product understanding and service capabilities.
  • Monitor industry trends and competitive technologies to identify opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Participate in industry trade shows, product demonstrations, and other customer-facing technical activities as needed.
Skills & Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Strong technical background in engineering, product integration, testing, or technical support within the material handling equipment or industrial vehicle industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of industrial lift trucks, preferably including Jungheinrich products manufactured for the North American market.
  • Experience working with third-party vehicle technologies, assistance systems, or integrated equipment solutions.
  • Familiarity with system commissioning, software configuration, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of system and software testing methodologies, including error analysis and validation.
  • Understanding of North American regulatory requirements and standards applicable to industrial lift trucks and related technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and coordinate technical activities across multiple stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in hands-on technical environments and participating in field testing and customer-facing activities.
What Success Looks Like
  • Ensuring the reliable operation and performance of assistance systems in the field.
  • Providing timely, effective technical support and resolution of complex product issues.
  • Supporting successful product integration and implementation across the North American market.
  • Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement through technical analysis, field testing, and collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Helping bridge the gap between product development and real-world customer applications to deliver solutions that meet market needs.
Work Conditions
  • Hybrid work out of our Houston, Texas office
  • Frequent virtual and/or in-person collaboration across teams
Why work for Jungheinrich?
At Jungheinrich, we create more impact. Our success thrives on exceptional employees who bring passion and a sense of community. "MORE WITH YOU" isn't just a slogan; it's our commitment to a workplace that values, respects, and empowers every team member. Our global presence spans six regions, with locations in 42 countries and partnerships in 80 others, fostering a dynamic, collaborative environment. Our employees are the key to our ongoing success.
We work "The Yellow Way": Our behaviors for success shape our daily work and the way we collaborate, communicate and grow as a global team. We have dynamic, ongoing training and professional development and offer diverse career opportunities.
Working at Jungheinrich means you can contribute to shaping sustainable material handling – and through that, other key industries. You could be one of the more than 21,000 sustainability enablers committed to a low-emission, healthy and socially just future, both in our company and the world. Discover your dream job now and together we can make a difference!

description:

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer

Headquarters Rolling Meadows, IL or Remote


COMPANY BACKGROUND

Epiq Solutions develops cutting-edge software-defined radio (SDR) products and processing solutions to enable spectrum dominance for maritime, land, air, and space domains. With 15 years serving government and commercial enterprise customers and 25K+ devices fielded to date, Epiq Solutions is a trusted partner with a proven heritage of delivering open architecture products in radically small form factors where time-to-market, cost, and performance are critical for mission success.


For more information, visit https://epiqsolutions.Com.


JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the integration and development of embedded C/C++ drivers, libraries, and components into our SDR platforms. In addition, you will implement and maintain APIs using various standards (MORA, CMOSS, etc.) to enable end-user configuration, control, and status monitoring of the radios. Applicants should be comfortable with the full SW design and implementation flow including contributing to automated testing and CI/CD workflows. This position involves close collaboration with a cross functional engineering team to deliver value to the end customer.


  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement new radio features and add support for new radio products· Decompose high-level goals/requirements into the detailed software components and interfaces needed to achieve the desired result.
  • Deliver reliable and accurate estimates for development efforts.
  • Promote and implement best practices in software design, development, testing, and documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the development lifecycle.
  • Develop applications on embedded Linux systems, using tools such as GCC, GDB, make/Cmake, docker, Jenkins, and rpm/deb packaging.
  • Expand automated test coverage of codebase using Pytest with signal in the loop control of external test equipment including USB/ethernet-enabled RF switches, attenuators, signal generators, and vector signal analyzers.
  • Support technical investigations and address technical questions.
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers to promote best practices.
  • Document technical specifications, design patterns, and development processes.


REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience in software development.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development specializing in ARM-based Linux embedded sensors and systems or other hardware-intensive platforms.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ library and application development.
  • Experience with Python for scripting, tooling, and test automation.
  • Familiarity with build systems and CI/CD workflows (Docker, Bitbucket, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience working with memory-mapped I/O and hardware register interfaces.
  • Knowledge of Linux-based embedded systems, preferably Debian.
  • Strong communication skills—both written and verbal.
  • Self motivated with exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Willingness to mentor junior engineers.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with a cross functional team of engineers.
  • Eligibility to work on Federal contracts which require US Citizenship


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++, including practical experience with C++20.
  • Experience designing and maintaining clean C++ APIs, hardware abstraction layers, device interfaces, and reusable software libraries.
  • Familiarity with FPGA-based systems and the software interfaces used to configure, control, and validate FPGA functionality.
  • Experience with AMD Versal MPSoC or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with Git-based source control, containerized development environments, issue tracking, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Proficiency in Python for hardware control, automation, data analysis, test development, and engineering utilities.
  • Experience with hardware/software integration, including bringing up new functionality, isolating issues between software, FPGA, firmware, and hardware, and developing diagnostic tests.
  • Ability to clearly document interfaces, test procedures, design decisions, and troubleshooting findings for software, FPGA, and hardware engineering teams.
  • Exposure to software-defined radio (SDR) systems.
  • Familiarity with high-performance embedded designs.
  • Understanding of secure API practices and network protocols.
  • Familiarity with SOSA standards including VITA49/MORA


BENEFITS

  • Join a successful and growing company investing in our future success
  • Flexible work hours
  • Generous vacation policy
  • Paid five-week sabbatical every five years
  • 401(k) matching
  • Health, dental, vision insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Wellness reimbursement
  • Charitable Giving Company Match
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience and performance
  • Fun, laid-back culture and rewarding work!

title: Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison
description:
Job Title: Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison

  • Location: US / Remote

Geography: Central East Region

Travel: 60–80% travel expected

Job Type: Full Time

About The Job:

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health. Learn more at .

The Rare Blood Disorders franchise is a patient-centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment. The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on a portfolio of products while upholding the Company's mission and values.

Sanofi's Rare Blood Disorders/Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is a field-based, commercial role responsible for engaging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to strategically inform market development across the rare hematology portfolio of products. The TLL is expected to possess a high level of clinical and customer knowledge, have experience with both field and headquarters protocols and procedures, and possess the drive and spirit to engage with healthcare professionals to help build educational platforms, generate insights, and inform local and national brand strategies, supporting the commercial success of the portfolio. The portfolio focus is primarily on Systemic Mastocytosis (SM) and Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The TLL will work closely, and within approved SOPs, with other field professionals including, but not limited to, Regional Business Directors, Area Business Managers, and Medical Science Liaisons, as well as home office-based colleagues in Marketing, Medical Affairs, Operations, and Market Access.

A core responsibility of this role is driving SM and ITP market development within the assigned region — identifying KOLs and fostering multi-disciplinary connections across specialists who treat and manage SM and ITP patients. The TLL serves as a strategic partner to cross-functional commercial and medical teams. The TLL helps to shape brand strategy through insight generation, KOL engagement, and regional market development initiatives across the full rare hematology portfolio.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

A. KOL Development and Engagement:

  • Work with cross-functional colleagues to coordinate function-specific activities aligned to business and customer needs.
  • Identify, profile, and maintain long-term partnerships with KOLs and emerging leaders within the Hematology and Allergy/Immunology communities.
  • Identify SM champions within the region.
  • Engage in on-label conversations to gather insights on topics such as disease diagnosis and treatment, therapeutic options, and product positioning across SM and ITP.
  • Execute unique, on-label, and strategic HCP programming (e.g., disease state and product) as determined by brand needs.
  • Serve as a single point of contact to resolve commercial KOL issues.
  • Execute a customer-centric, needs-based approach with targeted KOLs.
  • Plan and execute KOL engagements and executive encounters at local, regional, and national conferences, field visits, and other venues as directed.
  • Be a voice for allergy/immunology and hematology/oncology KOLs within the organization, sharing insights with key stakeholders and cross-functional partners to inform brand strategy.

B. SM and ITP Centers of Excellence and Market Development:

  • Lead long-term market development efforts in assigned regions across the SM and ITP landscapes, focusing on high-potential centers and customers.
  • Develop and execute customer engagement plans for KOLs within assigned regions, accountable for fostering KOL connections across multi-disciplinary specialists who treat and manage SM and ITP patients.
  • Maintain understanding of regional market dynamics, including key opinion leaders, institutional accounts, and multi-disciplinary teams to advance SM and ITP patient care and partner with sales leadership and commercial field teams to align regional market development strategies.
  • Develop and execute regional marketing initiatives (insight discovery, advisory boards, roundtables, etc.).
  • Support regional congress planning and execution, including KOL insight gathering engagement at priority conferences across hematology/oncology and allergy/immunology, in partnership with Medical, Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, and Brand Marketing.
  • Proactively meet with assigned centers and/or customers to solicit feedback and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Develop and continuously maintain a high level of clinical competence across SM, ITP, and aTTP.

C. Market Insights and Collaboration:

  • Capture, analyze, and share customer insights aligned with brand priorities across SM and ITP.
  • Work with targeted KOLs to obtain feedback on new and existing brand-related strategies and materials (all materials and programs will be approved by legal, compliance, and regulatory).
  • Capture and analyze competitive intelligence to help shape strategy and activities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional planning, recruitment, and execution of regional and national advisory boards in partnership with HQ Marketing.
  • Identify, align, and recruit appropriate HCP/KOL consultants to meet the needs of marketing and achieve aligned KPIs for each project.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to inform account strategy and plans through treatment pathway discovery and insight generation to advance care in centers of excellence.

D. Speaker Bureau Operations and Content:

  • Assist with speaker bureau management, including identification and training/coaching of promotional speakers with approved slide decks and materials.
  • Assist in the execution of speaker contracting when requested, including completion of annual budget plans, recommendations, and nominations.
  • Coordinate and execute speaker training to ensure assigned speakers are competent, compliant, and up to date on new information.
  • Attend HCP speaker programs to observe, coach, and remediate speakers when necessary to ensure optimal execution of content.
  • Assist with new content creation and existing content updates and renewals
  • Serve as the single point of contact for a high-volume of speaker logistics/scheduling and work cross-functionally to ensure streamlined communication.
  • Lead planning, execution, and pull-through of TLL-owned programs.

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • A minimum of 5 years of work experience in one or more of the following: field sales, product marketing, or medical/clinical in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech or other related life science industries
  • Prior experience interacting with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and/or HCPs.
  • Ability to travel to meetings, trainings, and programs as necessary (60–80%).
  • Must have a valid driver's license.
  • Must reside within the geographic area of the assigned territory, or within a reasonable distance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Rare Diseases and/or Hematology.
  • Allergy/Immunology and/or Hematology-Oncology background preferred
  • Experience in marketing or leading marketing projects.
  • Academic center focus and KOL development experience.
  • Experience working within or building multi-disciplinary treatment teams.
  • Cross-functional commercial background (e.g., marketing, sales leadership)
  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Launch experience, including demonstrated success across multiple drug launches in applicable specialty markets.
  • Previous experience working as a Thought Leader Liaison.
  • KOL and/or speaker management experience.
  • Strong communication, organization, and project management skills
  • Proven ability to work in a highly dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without formal authority and work in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Robust analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to identify and act on creative solutions.
  • Ability to establish credibility, connect the dots, and align multiple stakeholders to pioneer the adoption of new products, methods, and technologies.
  • Flexibility and ability to plan and adapt to changing market conditions.
  • Motivated by patient focus, urgency, and personal commitment to high performance, results, and compliance.
  • Possesses high integrity and exceptional work ethic.

Pursue Progress, Discover Extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn't happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let's be those people.

title: Workday Reporting & Prism Senior Principal Consultant
description:

Acting as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams, this individual provides strategic guidance on reporting, analytics, data modelling, and business insight solutions while ensuring outcomes align with business objectives and Workday leading practices.

The Senior Principal Consultant combines deep Reporting and Prism expertise with delivery leadership, pre-sales support, and people development responsibilities. title: Health Information Management Coding and Revenue Analyst
description:
Default Work Shift:

Day (United States of America)

Hours:

40

Salary range:

$30.59 - $46.48

Schedule:

Full Time

Shift Hours:

8 Hour employee

Department:

Medical Records

Job Objective:

Ensures the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of coded health system encounters across inpatient and outpatient settings including outpatient surgery, emergency, and observation. Conducts retrospective audits, validates code assignment, validates charges where appropriate, and evaluates adequacy in alignment with organizational policies. Serves as an HIM Epic and 3M-360 Super-user.

Job Description:

Education:
Required: Associate’s degree in Health Information Management or related field
Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Health Information Management or related field

Licensure/Certification:
Required: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) from American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)
Preferred: Epic certification in coding

Experience:
Required: Two (2) years of experience in hospital/facility coding and charge capture as a certified coder
Preferred: Formal auditing, consulting or vendor experience; experience using 3M-360; experience with hospital charging and revenue cycle initiatives

Reports To: Manager-Health Information Management Coding
Supervises: N/A
Ages of Patients: N/A
Blood Borne Pathogens: Minimal/ No Potential

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities:

Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and unexpected situations, Ability to create and maintain positive interpersonal relations with peers, staff, leaders and vendors, Ability to investigate and analyze multiple coding resources such as Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, coding and charging for devices and implants, Local/National coverage determinations and payer contracts, Expert knowledge of 3M encoder and related products, Expert-level working knowledge of inpatient and outpatient coding guidelines, including ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT, Extensive knowledge of federal, state, and payer-specific regulations and policies pertaining to documentation, coding, charging, and billing, Extensive working knowledge of revenue cycle workflows, charging, revenue integrity, and hospital accounting principles, Proficient in using Microsoft Office applications with advanced working knowledge of Excel, Working knowledge of Epic workflows pertinent to HIM, coding, and revenue cycle, Written and verbal communication skills

Essential Responsibilities

1. Demonstrates compliance with Code of Conduct and compliance policies and takes action to resolve compliance questions or concerns and report suspected violations.
2. Works closely with HIM Director and Managers to support revenue cycle initiatives, including denials and appeals.
3. Performs routine and targeted audits of inpatient and outpatient (OPPS/APC), encounters; assist with work queue management and troubleshooting account routing issues.
4. Validates diagnosis, procedure or modifier assignment; confirms accurate DRG/APR-DRG/HCC/APC capture as applicable.
5. Communicates with vendors on a daily basis, manages Epic work queues/DNFC, investigates and completes coding updates and corrections, coordinates appeals, denials, and rebills.
6. Reviews documentation for completeness, specificity, and consistency; identifies query opportunities and documentation gaps.
7. Applies editing logic (NCCI, MUEs) and client/organizational standards to assess compliance.
8. Supports denials management workflows, including work queue management, tracking and ensuring timeliness of appeal responses.
9. Supports 3M-360 initiatives, including reporting and analytics; supports system enhancements and upgrades in the testing and production environments.
10. Interacts with organizational leaders, medical staff, Clinical Documentation Improvement, Hospital and Clinic Billing offices and others needing HIM coding support.
11. Supports HIM’s role in coordinating appeals, denials, payer and RAC audits, rebills, hospital-acquired conditions (HAC), including review and analysis of payer and regulatory communications, performing chart review and account analysis, and making appropriate recommendations; communicates with third-parties and payers regarding coding issues.
12. Supports California state reporting, including data validation, correction, and submission within regulatory requirements.
13. Coordinates onboarding and off-boarding of vendor staff.
14. Maintains current AHIMA credentials, certifications, and carries out work duties in accordance with the AHIMA Code of Ethics.
15. Performs special projects and supports HIM and revenue cycle initiatives as needed.
16. Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Feeder
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The feeder is responsible, according to process and procedure, for handling and monitoring quality of material that will be converted into finished product; finished product; packaging materials; and related scrap that results from converting and other associated processes.

The Clamshell Feeder positioned at the Clamshell Machine feed section reaches for and manually lifts blanks from the pallet to the forming machine and loads the blanks in the feeder for 4-6 machines. Some of the machines are fed from a platform. Blanks may be lifted from a pallet that has been placed directly on the floor or may be lifted from a pallet on a lift assist device. The Feeder will manually pre-break blanks at center score as required for product and machine. The Feeder may be required to set up feeding station using a pallet jack to move die cut loads and removing plastic wrap from the full load before blanks can be fed. The Feeder removes empty pallets and baskets of scrap from feeding station area. (Reference Grade 3 Position Description)

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/ DUTIES

  • Handle and move (e.g. pack, feed, palletize, aerate, bale) process specific material/product consistent with the assigned position, the machine speed, and customer and quality specifications.
  • Ensure that all materials associated with the converting process and consistent with the assigned position are available in the correct quantities and in the correct location for order being run. (e.g. RSCs, dividers, bags, film, blanks, etc.)
  • Perform process and product specific quality inspections, complete Quality Control documentation, and communicate any quality issues to the Operator and Supervisor
  • Record data on specified forms and complete required documentation
  • Use RF scanner for process specific requirements to scan transactions to the Warehouse Management and to generate load tags
  • Prepare, unwrap, wrap loads using hand wrapper/ stretch wrapper/banding equipment following the wrapping/banding requirements for the process specific product/material and for assigned position
  • Use manual/ electric pallet jack consistent with assigned position to stage pallets/product/materials in designated area
  • Dispose of process specific waste material following all safety requirements and waste disposal procedures for assigned position to move waste to the baler and for operation of the baler
  • Assist the machine operator and perform equipment and process specific tasks such as filling glue containers or cleaning glue tips.
  • Remove jams at machine position and restart machine as required by position
  • Communicate any machine or product issues to the Operator or Supervisor
  • Perform general housekeeping in the work area and assist others as required during machine down time
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures including GMP, PPE, HACCP, LOTO, and JSA regulations
  • Responsible for ensuring, where applicable, the product safety, quality, regulatory compliance and legality of all products produced and sold

QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Less than high school diploma, but some previous work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is usually needed.

Experience: Equivalent experience or experience multi-tasking in a fast-paced work environment

Certification/ Licenses: N/A

Other Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

OTHER: Ability to use RF scanner for WMS transactions as required for position. Ability to operate a manual pallet jack and/or an electric pallet jack as required for position. Ability to use material handling devices such as a hoist and a pneumatic lift assist handling device as required for position.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand and comprehend documents such as safety rules, internal quality procedures, and machine operating procedures. Ability to communicate production issues to supervisors and others in work area.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Basic mathematics (i.e. counting).

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Working Environment: Safety glasses with side shields, hearing protection, and steel-toed shoes are required. In addition, task specific PPE may be required.
  • Physical Demands:
    The following is a general overview and is used in conjunction with the process specific Physical Requirements document.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Performing the duties of this job requires the ability to quickly move hands, move hands together with arms, and use two hands to grasp and position product or materials. The employee may continuously remain in a stationary position, bend/stoop/twist and use hands and fingers to grasp and position, and use arms to reach and move. The employee may frequently move about the work area. The employee may occasionally ascend/descend stairs, push and pull, and communicate.

The employee may occasionally move and position up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

description:
Job Title

Senior Analyst

Job Description

Job Summary
The Senior Analyst – Travel & Facilities Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end domestic and international business travel for employees while ensuring timely processing and reconciliation of facilities and travel-related invoices. The role also supports workplace security operations and Emergency Response Team (ERT) coordination to ensure seamless business continuity, compliance, and an excellent employee experience.


Roles & Responsibilities:
Travel Operations
• Manage end-to-end domestic and international business travel arrangements including flights, hotels, airport transfers, travel insurance, and visa coordination.
• Coordinate with employees, travel management companies, airlines, hotels, and other service providers.
• Ensure compliance with travel policy and approvals.
• Handle travel escalations, itinerary changes, cancellations, and emergency travel.
• Monitor travel costs and maintain travel MIS and dashboards.
Invoice Processing & Vendor Payments
• Process and validate facilities and travel invoices through Aerchain or equivalent platform.
• Review invoices against purchase orders, contracts, and commercial terms.
• Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, and vendors for timely approvals and payments.
• Manage invoices for pantry, cafeteria, hygiene, water, AMCs, rentals, CAM, utilities, employee transport, flights, hotels, and travel insurance.
• Prepare monthly reconciliations and payment trackers.
Emergency Response Team (ERT)

• Arrange mock drills in coordination with the builder and external training with agencies such as G4S.
• Maintain ERT records and support business continuity initiatives.
Vendor Management
• Manage relationships with travel, transport, security, and facilities vendors.
• Monitor SLAs, resolve issues, and support contract renewals.

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Commerce, Hospitality, Travel Management, or a related discipline.
• Certification in Travel Management or Facilities Management is an added advantage.
• Corporate Travel Management
• International Visa Coordination
• Invoice Processing & Reconciliation
• Vendor Management
• Facilities Administration
• MS Excel, PowerPoint & ERP Systems

End to End Travel Management, Cross functional initiatives across Facilities operations

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager

Denver, CO


Step into a clinical leadership role where you can support your team, strengthen daily treatment programs, and make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals recovering from eating disorders—all while working a four-day work week.

  • Empowering Approach: Help patients build lasting connections and rediscover their sense of self through EDCare's holistic, empowerment-based treatment philosophy.


About Us

EDCare is an independently owned eating disorder treatment center dedicated to helping adolescents and adults find lasting recovery through compassionate, evidence-based care. We provide individualized, holistic treatment that empowers patients to reconnect with themselves and build healthier lives. Our close-knit, collaborative team is committed to serving diverse populations, supporting one another, and creating a welcoming environment where meaningful healing happens.


What You'll Do as a Program Manager

  • Coordinate daily operations across EDCare's residential, partial hospitalization (PHP), and intensive outpatient (IOP) programs, ensuring consistent structure and a supportive treatment environment.
  • Partner with the Program Director to coordinate staffing, manage callouts, and ensure adequate coverage for therapeutic groups and patient meals.
  • Lead weekend operations as the onsite leadership resource, addressing patient needs, staffing challenges, and facility concerns as they arise.
  • Train and orient new program technicians, therapists, and students, helping them confidently navigate their responsibilities and EDCare's treatment approach.
  • Provide individual therapy, facilitate therapeutic groups, and support patient meals when additional clinical coverage is needed.
  • Collaborate with clinical leadership and interdisciplinary teams to strengthen communication, improve processes, and maintain consistent patient care.
  • Support patients through daily check-ins, therapeutic activities, and individualized interventions that promote safety, connection, and recovery.
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation, monitor program attendance, and uphold EDCare's clinical standards, policies, and procedures.


Our Ideal Program Manager

  • Education: Hold a master's degree in behavioral health, social work, psychology, clinical mental health counseling, family therapy, or a related field.
  • Licensure-Focused: Actively pursuing Colorado licensure as an LP, LPC, LCSW, or LMFT, with the ability to obtain CPR certification within the first 90 days.
  • Relevant Experience: Preferably have at least six months of experience working in a therapeutic milieu environment, with an understanding of clinical programming and patient care.
  • Confident Problem-Solver: Take initiative, make sound decisions, and navigate clinical and operational challenges in a dynamic treatment environment. Comfortable with electronic medical records and intermediate Microsoft Office skills.
  • Organized Collaborator: Manage competing priorities, communicate effectively across departments, and help clinical teams work together successfully.
  • Compassionate and Patient-Centered: Believe in individualized, evidence-based treatment and value creating a safe, empowering environment where patients and team members feel supported.


What We Offer Our Program Manager

  • Salary: $68,000-$74,000 annually
  • Schedule: Full-Time, Four-Day Workweek: Friday-Monday, 7:30 a.m.-6:00 p.m.
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability and AD&D Insurance
  • Free Clinical Supervision Toward Licensure

Licensed Professional Counselors, Clinical Social Workers, Marriage and Family Therapists, and behavioral health professionals pursuing Colorado licensure who are ready to grow into a clinical leadership role are encouraged to explore the Program Manager opportunity with EDCare in Denver, CO. Join a compassionate, collaborative team dedicated to providing individualized eating disorder treatment and helping patients achieve lasting recovery.

Maintains stocks and orders necessary supplies and equipment, using the Materials Management Information System for automated purchase requisitions. Works on site providing customer service in surgical and procedural areas.

Job Description:

Education:
Preferred: High school diploma, GED or higher level degree

Licensure/Certification:
N/A

Preferred: Supply distribution, inventory control and/or hospital experience; experience working with surgical supplies/equipment

Reports To: Manager-Supply Chain Materials-OR Supervises: N/A Ages of Patients: N/A Blood Borne Pathogens: Minimal/ No Potential

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities:

Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and unexpected situations, Ability to effectively communicate in a positive and professional manner, Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet deadlines, Understanding of relevant technologies and tools pertinent to the job role, Written and verbal communication skills

Essential Responsibilities

1. Demonstrates compliance with Code of Conduct and compliance policies and takes action to resolve compliance questions or concerns and report suspected violations.
2. Sets up and maintains automated supply stations; understands objective of Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN), Min/Max, and count features; adjusts levels on an ongoing basis to maintain optimum inventory levels.
3. Rotates stock daily and monitors for outdates monthly; refills assigned supply stations verifying current and refill amounts; adjusts ASN quantities as needed.
4. Designates items for Blackout and inventories on a daily basis.
5. Conducts a daily spot check inventory for each supply station; if stocked out refills from Inventory SPD or CS.
6. Labels bins and moves items as necessary to maintain adequate inventory levels and locate like-items together.
7. Runs and analyzes supply station reports to maintain appropriate supply levels as directed by leadership.
8. Acts to notify Manager, Lead-Supply Distribution/Inventory Clerk-SPD of any changes that need to be made in the Workday or the supply stations.
9. Interfaces with department staff on an ongoing basis concerning supply levels.
10. Enters requisitions into Materials Management Information Systems (MMIS) for non-stock supplies using reports or station refill print out.
11. Reviews unfill reports daily and determines from release date if there is a need to contact Buyer for substitute / or refill from INV SPD or CS.
12. Rotates stock to ensure use of items prior to outdate to ensure cost effectiveness handling of supplies in the supply station.
13. Processes credits due to over/under shipment or wrong item shipped within appropriate timeframe and follows up until product is returned and credit request is complete.
14. Properly maintains a delivery log for all deliveries (excluding JIT stock and supplies residing in Intellishelf) utilizing a Workday handheld or a written delivery log as instructed by leadership; obtains signatures upon delivery, prioritizes deliveries; all refrigerated/frozen and priority shipped items are to be delivered on same day as received.
15. Issues all supplies from SPD Inventory to the proper deliver to location and cost center, verifying correct Unit of Measure.
16. Develops and maintains a working relationship with vendor representatives to facilitate new product acquisition, product code changes, and product upgrades; enforces hospital policy for the introduction of new products; checks on status of orders and delivery dates with vendors via phone and e-mail, as appropriate.
17. Assists in removing stock affected by product recalls and notifications and properly documents actions to obtain credits or product replacements.
18. Follows up with vendor representatives and service group supervisors post-surgery to ensure that proper paperwork is filled out correctly and submitted to Materials Management.
19. Collects and submits completed final surgery paperwork in a timely manner for Materials Management.
20. Arranges for equipment and instrument repair with O.R. buyer and obtains loaner equipment when necessary; ships equipment out for repair.
21. Re-orders consigned items and provides serial and lot number information to the O.R. buyer.
22. Inventories and replenishes ancillary service carts (i.e. Orthopat supply cart, cell saver cart, cast cart, soft goods cart, etc.).
23. Assists in the documentation process for human tissue grafts/implants as appropriate.
24. Reviews and assigns purchase orders to O.R. service group supervisors for scheduled surgeries (i.e. loaner banks, trial products, samples, etc.).
25. Performs other duties as assigned.
