title: Lead Product Manager, AI Portfolio, Product, & Value
description:
The Lead Product Manager, AI Portfolio, Product & Value (Focus: Operations) owns AI products for Sensata's operations, starting with Supply Chain and extending to Procurement, Quality and Engineering. Working directly with planners, buyers and plant teams, the role maps how work gets done today, pinpoints the real pain points, and shapes AI solutions whose features directly address them, defining what gets built, the first version's scope and acceptance criteria. The role also owns prioritization, business cases and measured value, so solutions move from pilot to production and are used every day.

General Responsibilities
• Oversees the development of actionable product roadmaps by integrating inputs from cross-functional stakeholders in our business objectives & product strategy.
• Oversees product positioning in the marketplace, including rationalizing pricing strategy based on market conditions.
• Develop product strategy and optimize product portfolio, providing planning and project prioritization
• Contributes to the pricing strategy through the product life cycle
• Owns the balanced scorecard for their product line and drives the development and execution of the roadmap to improvement
• Addresses operational issues associated with quality, delivery and production.
• Anticipating and communicating issues, recommending corrective action, and taking independent remedial actions and reporting outcomes


Experience / Qualifications
• A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience.
• Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
• Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
• Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
• Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
• Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards
• Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
• Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Own AI products for operations use cases, starting with Supply Chain (e.g., demand and supply planning, inventory, S&OP, order fulfillment) and extending to Procurement, Quality and Engineering.
  • Map current workflows with planners, buyers, plant and quality teams; identify pain points, root causes and where AI can improve decisions or remove manual work.
  • Translate pain points into product requirements: map AI features against each pain point, write user stories, and define the first version's scope, acceptance criteria and success metrics.
  • Own the product backlog and roadmap; prioritize features and make clear trade-offs with AI engineers, data scientists and the AI Architect.
  • Test solutions with users, run pilots, gather feedback and iterate until the product is adopted in daily work.
  • Run intake, triage and prioritization for operations AI use cases, and recommend scale, pivot or stop decisions.
  • Build business cases with business owners and Finance (baseline, target value, cost) and track realized value after go-live, such as inventory, service levels, cost and productivity.
  • Make sure every product has a named business owner, success metrics and an adoption plan before build starts.
  • Work with AI Governance, AI Enablement, IT and vendors so products clear governance gates and fit into ERP and planning systems; own business requirements in vendor and build/buy evaluations.
  • Report product status, value and key decisions to AI leadership and business leaders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in product management, digital/AI product or operations roles, including 3+ years owning data, analytics or AI products.
  • Hands-on operations background, ideally in supply chain planning, inventory, S&OP, procurement or manufacturing operations.
  • Strong product discovery skills: workflow and process mapping, user research and pain-point analysis, turned into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Track record of defining a first version and taking products from idea to production with measured adoption and business value.
  • Working knowledge of ERP (e.g., SAP or Oracle), planning systems and operational data.
  • Enough technical depth in GenAI, ML, optimization and agents to challenge engineers and vendors on scope, feasibility and cost.
  • Experience building business cases and tracking realized value with Finance.
  • Experience with Agile product delivery and backlog tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Able to influence senior business leaders with evidence and make clear prioritization calls.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive or industrial environments preferred. Product (e.g., CSPO), ASCM/APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or Lean/Six Sigma certification preferred

title: Associate Director, US Consumer Analytics
description:
Job Title : Associate Director, US Consumer Analytics
Location : Morristown, NJ


About the job
The Associate Director, US Consumer Advanced Analytics, will be responsible for applying data, analytics, and measurement capabilities to improve consumer and patient engagement, media effectiveness, and business decision-making across Sanofi North America. As a member of the Insights and Analytics team, this individual will serve as a strategic analytics partner to assigned brands and indications, while also helping build scalable consumer analytics capabilities that can be leveraged across the portfolio.

This role will partner closely with Brand, Media, Omnichannel, Digital, agency partners, and offshore analytics hub resources to translate business questions into actionable insights, audience strategies, measurement plans, and optimization recommendations. The Associate Director will bring strong analytical judgment, hands-on problem solving, and clear business communication to support more timely, consistent, and impactful consumer marketing decisions. This role will sit within the GTMC (Go-to-Market Capabilities) NA Organization, within the Insights & Analytics pillar.

This position will report to the Director, US Consumer Advanced Analytics and will be based in Cambridge, MA or Morristown, NJ.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.


About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

Brand Analytics Partnership

  • Serve as an analytics business partner to assigned consumer brands and indications, helping translate brand strategy, media priorities, and business questions into clear analytics plans and recommendations.
  • Design and interpret insights for DTC/P ecosystem, impact assessment of use cases, and support on-going advancements to support AI mediated engagement throughout the customer journey lifecycle.
  • Partner with Brand and Media teams to define KPIs, audience priorities, measurement needs, test-and-learn opportunities, and optimization questions for Direct to Consumer/Patient campaigns. Develop performance insights that connect consumer engagement, media activity, audience behavior, patient journey progression, and business outcomes.
  • Lead or support recurring performance readouts, translating analytical outputs into clear business implications and recommended actions.

Consumer Analytics Capability Development

  • Contribute to the development of the US Consumer Media Analytics Strategy
  • Support the development and scaling of consumer analytics capabilities, such as audience segmentation, lookalike modeling, patient journey analytics, media measurement, attribution, reporting, and test-and-learn frameworks.
  • Define and execute business requirements, analytical inputs, and success criteria for priority use cases in partnership with Omnichannel, Digital, Data Management, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams.
  • Design, execute, and interpret analyses of large healthcare and media datasets and translate complex data findings to clear actionable recommendations for commercial and cross-functional teams to drive strategic imperatives
  • Help establish repeatable standards, templates, QA processes, and documentation to improve consistency across brands and indications.
  • Support prioritization of analytics work across brand needs, capability-building priorities, and available team capacity.

Analytics Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as key member of larger Advanced Analytics team, coordinating with Therapeutic Area (TA) Advanced Analytics lead to integrate Consumer Analytics workstreams with other Advanced Analytics deliverables
  • Collaborate with Data Science and technical partners on model development, audience creation, measurement design, test/control construction, and validation of analytical outputs.
  • Partner with Digital and Data teams to ensure dashboards, data assets, and analytics workflows meet business needs and support timely decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Sanofi Data Management and Global Digital teams to ensure robust data infrastructure and quality
  • Coordinate with agency and vendor partners, where needed, to support media measurement, audience activation, performance reporting, and knowledge transfer.
  • Engage with offshore analytics hub team members to support delivery of reporting, analysis, dashboard QA, insight generation, and recurring measurement needs.
  • Ensure analytics outputs are accurate, actionable, privacy-conscious, and aligned with relevant policies, SOPs, and governance requirements.

Team Culture and Ways of Working

  • Contribute to a team culture that values curiosity, collaboration, inclusion, analytical rigor, and business ownership.
  • Work effectively in a matrixed environment, balancing strategic priorities, hands-on analytical work, and cross-functional stakeholder needs.



About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; preferably in a quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in pharma/healthcare analytics; or commercial brand/media analytics with pharma/healthcare analytics experience.
  • Strong foundation in core statistical methods (e.g. descriptive statistics and probability distributions)
  • Experience designing and/or interpreting experiments (e.g., A/B tests, multivariate tests, holdout/control group studies) to measure the impact of commercial, patient, or marketing initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of causal inference methods used for incrementality measurement; hands-on experience with at least one of the following is required, with experience across multiple approaches considered a plus: difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, synthetic control approaches, or comparable quasi-experimental techniques.
  • Experience with one or more of the following pharmaceutical and analytics data sources/platforms:
    • National-level sales/demand data (e.g., IQVIA NPA & NSP)
    • Longitudinal HCP & patient-level claims (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo)
    • CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce)
    • Data management & analysis platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI)
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with analytics applied to HCP, patient, or consumer engagement.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python is required.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Master's, MBA, or PhD in a quantitative field, or advanced certification in data science or machine learning.
  • Relevant therapeutic area experience in pharmaceutical analytics (e.g., specialty care, immunology).
  • Experience with specialty pharmacy/patient services data (e.g., Capgemini/LiquidHub).
  • Experience with media platform reporting tools (e.g., CM360/SA360, Meta Business Manager, Google Analytics).
  • Experience applying experimental design and causal methods to media incrementality and campaign lift measurement.
  • Experience working as a media analyst at a marketing or media agency.
  • Demonstrated experience working with 1st & 3rd party consumer data sources across key media channels such as CRM, CTV/OLV, Search, and/or Social.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in multi-touch attribution modeling, preferably for pharmaceutical brands.


Skills and Competencies


  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to conduct meetings and present independently to cross-functional stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Strong strategic thinking ability, with a solid understanding of the life-sciences industry.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed environment, collaborating across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to think strategically in ambiguous environments and adapt as business priorities evolve.
  • Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence (EQ) and collaborative leadership skills.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team. Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.
  • Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
  • Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.

title: Front of House Porter
description:
Porter/ Driver

The Wellington Hospital, London

Full-time, 37.5 hours per week

Shifts between 0700 and 1900, working 5 days out of 7

Permanent

Salary: £14.80/hour plus excellent benefits


We’re looking for a Porter to join our Front of House team based at The Wellington Hospital. Working within one of the UK’s leading private healthcare facilities, you’ll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the hospital while helping to deliver an exceptional experience for patients, visitors and colleagues.

This is a varied and hands-on role where no two days are the same. You’ll support departments across the hospital with portering, security, patient transport and logistics duties, helping to ensure services run safely, smoothly and efficiently at all times.

As a Porter you’ll provide professional support across the hospital environment, assisting patients and visitors while maintaining high standards of customer service and operational excellence. From supporting emergency response teams and managing waste streams, to transporting patients and assisting with deliveries across site, your work will make a real difference to the overall patient journey. You’ll become part of a collaborative and supportive team where professionalism, compassion and teamwork are valued every day.

Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Other’s may think this is just a role in our Front of House team, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.

What you’ll do:

  • Taking patients and visitors to their rooms
  • Transferring patients between hospital departments
  • Delivery of mail, equipment and materials
  • Hospital blood rounds
  • Collection and disposal of refuse (including clinical waste and sharps)
  • Assist in managing Medical Gas
  • Assisting the undertakers’ team
  • Medicine and fluid delivery/ storage
  • Carry out security/fire patrols of all internal and external Hospital Buildings, and to ensure all incidents are recorded in the correct manner
  • Driving of the shuttle bus across different Wellington Campus sites

What you’ll bring:

  • Physically fit, able to lift heavy items when required
  • Full UK, clean drivers license is essential
  • Previous experience in a similar role is essential
  • Excellent communication and customer skills
  • Knowledge of Health and Safety procedures

Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

By caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Front of House Porter, you’ll be eligible for:

  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you

title: Senior Scientist and Executive Director Envision Research Institute
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Scientist and Executive Director (ED) of the Envision Research Institute (ERI) is responsible for directing all activities required to conduct and monitor multiple research projects, lead and mentor scientists and fellows, and ensure alignment with Evnsion’s mission and strategic vision. The Sr. Scientist and ED of ERI helps formulate effective strategic goals and objectives and ensures implementation and operational integration of those goals and objectives as directed by the VP of FMS Operations. The Sr. Scientist and ED of ERI is responsible for financial viability of the department. The Sr. Scientist and ED of ERI works with the Research Program Manager to ensure equipment maintenance, policy and procedure updates, ethics training and IRB oversight of scientific staff.

The Sr. Scientist and ED of ERI also maintains their own independent research and publishes in peer reviewed scientific journals.

In addition, the Sr. Scientist and ED of ERI ensures ERI employees, fellows, and research assistants maintain compliance with all applicable standards and regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS INCLUDE

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee the Envision Research Institute department and infrastructure while ensuring that the plan and strategy of the research department are consistent with the Mission of Envision.
  • Advance Envision’s research arm engaging in quantitative, translational and applied low vision and blindness research that addresses the overall mission of Envision and research priority areas of Envision.
  • Conduct measurable, scientifically valid research that addresses practical issues in helping to close practice gaps in the clinical treatment and rehabilitation of persons who have low vision or blindness.
  • Create and chair Envision Research Advisory Panel with members from Envision and other collaborating institutions to peer review preliminary research proposals for conceptual compatibility with Envision’s research priority areas, scientific merit, adherence to human subject guidelines and Envision budget guidelines.
  • Lead efforts to develop and stimulate participation in clinical research activities that encourage collaborations between Envision and the public and private sectors.
  • Plan, direct and evaluate the operations of the research department, as well as infrastructure support as they relate to the research department, assuring the accomplishment of Envision’s mission, strategic goals and institutional objectives.
  • Manage and secure Institutional Review Board review for research projects approved by the Envision Research Advisory Panel.
  • Establish and oversee grants administration pre- and post-award function, within Envision’s organizational grant framework, to obtain and manage research funding.
  • Seek outside research funding from both government (National Institute of Health, National Scientific Foundation, Department of Education, etc) and non-government sources and develop collaborative research with other institutions.
  • Maintain a high degree of awareness of the current state of low vision and blindness rehabilitation research and advancements as it relates to Envision by attending relevant symposia, scientific meetings and workshops, and reviewing key journals.
  • Provide leadership in the utilization and implementation of continuous process improvement strategies, with the key objectives of creating change that positively affects cost, efficiency, compliance, and quality.
  • Track research key performance indicators (publications, fellows trained, conference presentations, etc.)
  • Ensure adequate and useful resources, technology, equipment, and support are in place to support the work of research team members who are low vision or blind.

Financial and Strategic Management

  • Assists the VP to develop and implement the annual strategic plan and objectives for the research instutute.
  • Monitor and manage the annual operational budget and financial affairs of the research department, emphasizing cost containment without compromising quality of care
  • Oversee software implementation, updates and training, ensuring efficient implementation across locations.
  • Oversee, with support of the Research Program Manager, institute resource procurement and maintenance, including equipment, software, library resources and vendor management.

Leadership and Staff Development

  • Foster a culture of excellence through continuous improvement, teamwork, and a positive work environment.
  • Oversee recruitment, development, and performance evaluation of employees.
  • Work with multi-divisional functions (e.g., finance, IT, human resources, marketing, compliance) to ensure acquisition and training of qualified staff, development and activation of effective policies and procedures
  • Promote research integrity and responsibility while ensuring that all Envision staff participate in research endeavors adhere to regulations, policies, procedures and strict standards of ethical conduct.
  • Ensure continuing education and professional development of Envision’s research staff.
  • Personify and promote Envision’s core values of integrity, curiosity, passion, initiative, teamwork, and excellence.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, adapting to changing priorities and proactively problem-solving with a focus on solutions-oriented outcomes.

Partnership Development and Communication

  • Participate in community outreach activities to promote science and low vision and blindness education.
  • Present the process, goals, and results of Envision’s research at key research venues including meetings, conferences and through publication in peer reviewed journals.
  • Provide leadership in internal and external communications to ensure the organization’s mission and services are well understood.
  • Maintain open lines of communication to executive and peer leaders on issues concerning assigned areas of authority and current trends in the field.
  • Maintain confidentiality and protect the organization’s value by upholding the highest standards of privacy.
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to develop partnerships, funding, and resources while advising on Envision research projects, development and areas of scientific interest to Envision.

Research

  • Participate in research projects as a Principal Investigator or Co-Investigator when appropriate.
  • Complete ethics training to perform research on human subjects
  • Develop a rigorous scientific research methodology and obtain ethical approval for the study.
  • Conduct research projects independently in the field of low vision and blindness.
  • Develop research protocols, recruit suitable research participants, collect data, and complete projects in a timely manner.
  • Perform data analysis using appropriate statistical tests as outlined in the protocol.
  • Present research findings at national and international conferences attended by other vision scientists for peer review.
  • Publish scientific manuscripts in high-impact, peer-reviewed vision science journals.
  • Contribute to the advancement of science through innovative research projects that aim to improve the quality of life for individuals who are low vision or blind.

Other Duties

  • Assist with special projects as needed.
  • Flexibility to perform other duties as assigned.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of scheduled time.

title: Undergraduate Research Assistantship - Black Studies Archive
description:
Serve as an undergraduate research assistant on the project: Black Studies Archive.

This project is to establish a Black Studies Archive that will collect, preserve, and promote the scholarship of Pace students and faculty. It will be a digital and physical collection built on the research papers and teaching materials of Distinguished Professor Jean Fagan Yellin, who started teaching in Pace’s English department in 1968, whose work brought justice to African American writer Harriet Jacobs, and who recently passed away in 2023; and Distinguished Professor Ellease Ebele Oseye, who retired in 2022 after 47 years in our department as an expert on the Black Arts movement.

The research assistant will:

  • Organize, sort, and catalogue physical materials (e.g., books, papers, photographs) in the Yellin and Oseye collections
  • Scan and digitize any materials in need of preservation in these physical collections
  • Curate and interpret their original research and teaching materials in Black Studies for today’s student audiences

* You must have Federal Work Study funding added to your awards BEFORE applying for this position. You are potentially eligible for Work Study if you are a US Citizen or permanent resident, have filed a FAFSA, are enrolled in at least 6 credits, and are in good academic standing.

This position requires the following:

  • Must be Work Study eligible
  • Basic knowledge of how to scan and edit documents and images, use other media conversion technology (e.g., VHS tape to digital), or a willingness to learn
  • A personal interest in 19th- and 20th-century studies of African American literature and culture
  • Self-motivation and openness to intergenerational mentorship (i.e., learning from older and younger people)

Instructions to find your Work Study eligibility status:

  • Log into your MyPacePortal and click on “Student Home” and then the “Financial Aid” box (middle of screen).
  • Once in Financial Aid, select the “Award Offer” tab and the correct Award Year.
  • Scroll down to “Options to Pay Net Cost” and take a screenshot of the funds that are allocated specifically to Work Study for the academic year. Make sure your name is captured in the screenshot, then upload the screenshot, and submit it along with your application.

* If these details are not available in the “Award Offer” section of your profile, you are NOT currently eligible for Work Study funding. If you are a US citizen or permanent resident, and you have filed a FAFSA, you can open a Help Desk ticket with Financial Aid to determine your Work Study eligibility.

title: Senior Development Engineer, Renewable Energy Projects
description:
Want to help build Italy's next generation of renewable energy projects? As a Senior Development Engineer at European Energy, you'll lead the technical development of large-scale solar, wind and battery storage projects that power the energy transition. This is your chance to combine technical expertise with strategic influence in a fast-growing international company. Join us and help turn ambitious renewable energy plans into reality.

European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, and operate solar (PV) and wind energy projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. In addition, we explore new technologies, including battery energy storage, biogas, and carbon capture. As part of this, we are highly active in M&A activities across the entire value chain. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.

Your New Team

You will join European Energy Italy, a team of approximately 15 colleagues based primarily at our Milan office. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across the organization, including our EPC team at headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark, collaborating on grid connection, technology, and design aspects of our projects.

We are a highly motivated, ambitious, and supportive team where trust, knowledge sharing, and open dialogue form the foundation of how we work together. As our project pipeline in Italy continues to grow rapidly, you will play a key role in a wide range of technical activities, gaining hands-on experience while benefiting from excellent opportunities for professional growth and increasing responsibility over time.


Your New Role

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will support the Project Development team with permitting and grid connections in the screening, development and early structuring phase. You will lead the development engineering activities behind our Italian portfolio of utility-scale solar PV, onshore wind and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, including hybrid plants combining all three technologies.


Working closely with engineering consultants, grid operators and public authorities, you will own the technical side of our projects from site origination and grid connection requests through permitting and up to Final Investment Decision (FID). Your goal will be to make every project technically robust, cost-competitive, bankable and fully compliant with the Italian regulatory framework.


This is a senior role for an engineer who combines technical depth and sound judgement with commercial awareness, and who can translate engineering choices into better investment decisions across the portfolio.


Your Responsibilities

Grid Connection and Evaluation

  • Lead grid connection requests with Terna and the relevant DSOs (e.g. e-distribuzione), under both the current and the reformed framework, from application through technical queries to final connection approvals
  • Analyse Terna's microzone capacity data and connection offer ahead of each Open Season to identify the most valuable connection points for new and existing projects
  • Prepare and manage the company's participation in each Open Season, from selecting connection solutions to obtaining the connection attestation through Terna's portal, optimizing our position on the grid.
  • Represent European Energy in technical discussions, connection procedures and working groups with grid operators and other external stakeholders, including Terna technical tables for shared connection solutions.

Hybridization

  • Review the current pipeline to identify hybridization opportunities across solar PV, wind and BESS, at both plant and connection-point level.
  • Assess hybridization strategies from a technical and economic perspective, including technology mix, sizing, shared use of connection capacity and curtailment risk.
  • Optimize the point of connection and capacity allocation for hybrid projects, ensuring technical coherence across technologies.
  • Ensure technical coherence across technologies at shared connection points, working with Project Development, EPC department and commercial teams to maximize the value of each site.

Project Development and Permitting

  • Identify new opportunities through GIS-based site screening and grid capacity analysis (e.g. Terna Econnextion, DSO hosting-capacity maps), including powered land for data center use
  • Review and optimize project layouts to maximize energy yield, installed capacity, permitting success and overall project value.
  • Act as the main technical interface between Project Development, EPC department, engineering consultants, technology suppliers and specialist advisors.
  • Coordinate site investigations, engineering studies and multidisciplinary assessments needed to move projects through internal milestones and permitting procedures (PAS, Autorizzazione Unica, PAUR, VIA).
  • Contribute to improving internal tools for pipeline tracking and management.


Prerequisites to progress in the job

  • Master's degree in Electrical, Energy or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years' experience in the engineering and development of utility-scale renewable energy projects in Italy.
  • Proven track record taking solar PV, wind and/or BESS projects through development to ready-to-build status or FID.
  • Hands-on experience managing grid connection requests with Terna and DSOs, with solid knowledge of Italian connection rules (ARERA TICA, Terna Grid Code, CEI 0-16).
  • Good understanding of the Italian regulatory and permitting framework (ARERA, MASE, GSE; PAS, Autorizzazione Unica, PAUR, VIA).
  • Proficiency in QGIS, Google Earth and AutoCAD, as well as Microsoft Office and project tracking tools.
  • Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken.


We Offer

  • Close collaboration with senior colleagues and meaningful deal ownership from day one.
  • A culture of knowledge sharing and international collaboration across 21+ countries.
  • Flexible work policy and a diverse, inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for career advancement in a growing company and sector.


European Energy at a glance – The Power of Tomorrow, Today

We are now more than 890 employees with 50 nationalities represented in 21 countries, and we are growing rapidly in both Copenhagen and across our global offices. We all work for our common goal to be a leading partner in the green transition and to create The Power of Tomorrow, Today.


Our working environment is built on mutual respect for the varied strengths and talents of our employees, with a flat hierarchy and a culture that encourages initiative and innovation. Our employees value our flexible working culture, permitting better reconciliation of work and personal life. At European Energy, you will work with colleagues from around the world and become part of a collaborative international network.

We lead with purpose. At European Energy, our leadership culture is built on six guiding principles that shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. These principles help us act responsibly and empower each other to succeed.


Workplace: Milan, with occasional travel around Italy

Reference: Filippo Ricci, Country Manager, Italy

How to apply: We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or background. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask that you do not include a photograph in your CV. We assess all candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the position once a suitable candidate has been identified. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email or any other direct messaging channels. Applications must be submitted through the designated application link.

Contact person: For more information about the position, please reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner, Camilla Astrup caas@europeanenergy.com

We look forward to receiving your application!

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health. Learn more at .

The Rare Blood Disorders franchise is a patient-centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment. The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on a portfolio of products while upholding the Company's mission and values.

Sanofi's Rare Blood Disorders/Rare Hematology Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is a field-based, commercial role responsible for engaging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to strategically inform market development across the rare hematology portfolio of products. The TLL is expected to possess a high level of clinical and customer knowledge, have experience with both field and headquarters protocols and procedures, and possess the drive and spirit to engage with healthcare professionals to help build educational platforms, generate insights, and inform local and national brand strategies, supporting the commercial success of the portfolio. The portfolio focus is primarily on Systemic Mastocytosis (SM) and Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The TLL will work closely, and within approved SOPs, with other field professionals including, but not limited to, Regional Business Directors, Area Business Managers, and Medical Science Liaisons, as well as home office-based colleagues in Marketing, Medical Affairs, Operations, and Market Access.

A core responsibility of this role is driving SM and ITP market development within the assigned region — identifying KOLs and fostering multi-disciplinary connections across specialists who treat and manage SM and ITP patients. The TLL serves as a strategic partner to cross-functional commercial and medical teams. The TLL helps to shape brand strategy through insight generation, KOL engagement, and regional market development initiatives across the full rare hematology portfolio.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main Responsibilities:

*All TLL interactions are on-label and consistent with commercial compliance, legal, and regulatory guidelines.*

A. KOL Development and Engagement:

  • Work with cross-functional colleagues to coordinate function-specific activities aligned to business and customer needs.
  • Identify, profile, and maintain long-term partnerships with KOLs and emerging leaders within the Hematology and Allergy/Immunology communities.
  • Identify SM champions within the region.
  • Engage in on-label conversations to gather insights on topics such as disease diagnosis and treatment, therapeutic options, and product positioning across SM and ITP.
  • Execute unique, on-label, and strategic HCP programming (e.g., disease state and product) as determined by brand needs.
  • Serve as a single point of contact to resolve commercial KOL issues.
  • Execute a customer-centric, needs-based approach with targeted KOLs.
  • Plan and execute KOL engagements and executive encounters at local, regional, and national conferences, field visits, and other venues as directed.
  • Be a voice for allergy/immunology and hematology/oncology KOLs within the organization, sharing insights with key stakeholders and cross-functional partners to inform brand strategy.

B. SM and ITP Centers of Excellence and Market Development:

  • Lead long-term market development efforts in assigned regions across the SM and ITP landscapes, focusing on high-potential centers and customers.
  • Develop and execute customer engagement plans for KOLs within assigned regions, accountable for fostering KOL connections across multi-disciplinary specialists who treat and manage SM and ITP patients.
  • Maintain understanding of regional market dynamics, including key opinion leaders, institutional accounts, and multi-disciplinary teams to advance SM and ITP patient care and partner with sales leadership and commercial field teams to align regional market development strategies.
  • Develop and execute regional marketing initiatives (insight discovery, advisory boards, roundtables, etc.).
  • Support regional congress planning and execution, including KOL insight gathering engagement at priority conferences across hematology/oncology and allergy/immunology, in partnership with Medical, Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, and Brand Marketing.
  • Proactively meet with assigned centers and/or customers to solicit feedback and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Develop and continuously maintain a high level of clinical competence across SM, ITP, and aTTP.

C. Market Insights and Collaboration:

  • Capture, analyze, and share customer insights aligned with brand priorities across SM and ITP.
  • Work with targeted KOLs to obtain feedback on new and existing brand-related strategies and materials (all materials and programs will be approved by legal, compliance, and regulatory).
  • Capture and analyze competitive intelligence to help shape strategy and activities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional planning, recruitment, and execution of regional and national advisory boards in partnership with HQ Marketing.
  • Identify, align, and recruit appropriate HCP/KOL consultants to meet the needs of marketing and achieve aligned KPIs for each project.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to inform account strategy and plans through treatment pathway discovery and insight generation to advance care in centers of excellence.

D. Speaker Bureau Operations and Content:

  • Assist with speaker bureau management, including identification and training/coaching of promotional speakers with approved slide decks and materials.
  • Assist in the execution of speaker contracting when requested, including completion of annual budget plans, recommendations, and nominations.
  • Coordinate and execute speaker training to ensure assigned speakers are competent, compliant, and up to date on new information.
  • Attend HCP speaker programs to observe, coach, and remediate speakers when necessary to ensure optimal execution of content.
  • Assist with new content creation and existing content updates and renewals
  • Serve as the single point of contact for a high-volume of speaker logistics/scheduling and work cross-functionally to ensure streamlined communication.
  • Lead planning, execution, and pull-through of TLL-owned programs.

About You:

Key Capabilities

  • Strong communication, organization, and project management skills
  • Proven ability to work in a highly dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without formal authority and work in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Passionate, confident, articulate, and comfortable in a team environment.
  • Ability to successfully engage with top KOLs and other HCPs.
  • Expertise in creating and executing customer account plans.
  • Robust analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to identify and act on creative solutions.
  • Ability to establish credibility, connect the dots, and align multiple stakeholders to pioneer the adoption of new products, methods, and technologies.
  • Flexibility and ability to plan and adapt to changing market conditions.
  • Motivated by patient focus, urgency, and personal commitment to high performance, results, and compliance.
  • Possesses high integrity and exceptional work ethic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • A minimum of 5 years of work experience in one or more of the following: field sales, product marketing, or medical/clinical in the pharmaceutical/biotech space.
  • Prior experience interacting with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
  • Ability to travel to meetings, trainings, and programs as necessary (60–80%).
  • Must have a valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Allergy/Immunology and/or Hematology-Oncology background preferred
  • Experience in marketing or leading marketing projects.
  • Academic center focus and KOL development experience.
  • Experience working within or building multi-disciplinary treatment teams.
  • Cross-functional commercial background (e.g., marketing, sales leadership)
  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Launch experience, including demonstrated success across multiple drug launches in applicable specialty markets.
  • Previous experience working as a Thought Leader Liaison.
  • KOL and/or speaker management experience.
  • Project management and vendor management experience.
  • Understanding of oral targeted therapies with a requisite diagnostic component and ability to navigate complex market access environments.

title: Clinical Trials Medical Writer
description:
Job Title: Medical Writer

Department: Study Set Up

Location: Remote East Coast | Must Sit in East Coast

Hours Per Week: 40 hours

Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday


SUMMARY

The Medical Writer is responsible for interpreting complex clinical study protocols and other medical/scientific documentation to prepare and coordinate laboratory specification and study‑specific medical/technical documents for ACM Global Laboratories. They will partner with internal departments in the development, drafting, review, editing, and finalization of documents used to conduct clinical studies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of complex clinical study and amendments in accordance to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the development, revision, and maintenance of high profile and expedited complex study documents and amendments in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Responsible for authoring and finalizing global lab specification documents (GLSD) and other related documents, as needed.
  • Interpret, understand, and contribute to the scientific details of the protocol/technical documentation; identify and resolve gaps to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for medical documentation utilized throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Lead, initiate, and manage multiple rounds of internal and external document review.
  • Liaise and drive timely collaboration between key stakeholders to ensure technical documentation meet high quality standards and aligns with business process.
  • Participate in client interactions during study start-up activities and/or during study amendment process.
  • Review of low to medium complexity GLSD in accordance to SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the review of high complexity GLSD in accordance with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of lab manuals in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Review lab manuals to ensure alignment with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Resolve challenges and build consensus between all cross-functional groups and collaborators in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a general working knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA), Medical & Healthcare Regulatory Agency (MHRA), New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH and other pertinent regulations.
  • Demonstrate initiative in professional self-development to improve job performance to maintain relevant working knowledge of clinical trials.
  • Resolve queries for complex studies by using knowledge of regional differences and internal ACM processes for low and medium complexity GLSD and understanding of department responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties and/or tasks as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BA/BS, or equivalent experience in scientific field
  • 1 yrs clinical trials or other laboratory experience required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Applied knowledge of routine document content preparation, including the use of style guides, medical dictionaries, regulatory guidance documents, and templates
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and desktop publishing or word processing
  • Education in medical or technical writing
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to effectively influence others, work in a team environment, and collaborate across lines of business and functions
  • 1+ years’ experience drafting clinical trials documentation

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

$77,000.00 - $92,000.00

Rochester

14624

title: Director, Customer, Patient and Market Decision Intelligence
description:
Job Description Summary

The AIDE Opportunity, Performance and Measurement team enables I&A, Commercial, and Field organizations to improve decision-making through high-quality data, deep functional expertise, advanced analytics, and actionable insights that drive growth and performance across the portfolio. Working closely with the East Hanover COE and Decision Intelligence teams, the group brings analytical rigor and business insight to support smarter, data-driven decisions.

The Director, CPM DI will lead the Hyderabad-based integrated POD model across brands and therapeutic areas, delivering insights that answer two critical questions: how the business is performing and why, and which customers, patients, providers, physicians, and health plans should be engaged and how. This role requires strong healthcare customer understanding, the ability to integrate analytics into a clear business narrative, and close collaboration with AIDE capability and functional teams to deliver integrated commercial insights and recommendations.


Job Description

Director, Customer , Patient and Market Decision Intelligence

Location – Hyderabad #LI Hybrid

Major Accountabilities

  • Patient journey and pool prioritization: Lead creation of detailed patient journey mapping to identify key steps leading to diagnosis and treatment, leakage points and touchpoints, and lead patient pool prioritization at distinct points in the journey to drive growth.
  • Patient, HCP, and provider segmentation: Assess unique features of patient and provider cohorts using secondary data (behavioral, attitudinal, clinical, level of access control and system complexity) and capabilities to inform personalized marketing and engagement strategies.
  • Engagement drivers: Deliver insights on factors that influence prescribing patterns, roadblocks and drop-off points, and partner with internal stakeholders to refine engagement strategies.
  • Influence mapping: Lead KOL identification through HCP influence, peer networks, reach and expertise assessment.
  • Integrated narrative: Support the articulation of a clear narrative of the business performance and customer opportunity grounded in data and insights, considering current strategy and how it should evolve, in partnership with I&A Decision Intelligence team, as part of the I&A POD.
  • Lead a team of experts in Hyderabad for the patient, provider and account analytics and drive hiring, onboarding, and coaching team members to build a collaborative, high-performing culture.
  • Lead efforts to upskill, mentor, and support the professional growth of the team members, ensuring their sustained development and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Data pipeline quality: Maintain close connection with Data Ops, Functional Excellence and Reporting to optimize the data-to-analysis-to-reporting pipeline and investigate performance anomalies with End-to-End Quality Assurance so that data variance is not interpreted as performance signal.
  • Own cross-portfolio analytics and requests accountability in CPM, focused on patients, providers, HCPs and market dynamics insights, pulling in the TA subject matter expertise and capacity from respective teams.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 12 years of experience in pharma or healthcare industry, with a strong understanding of market dynamics, regulatory environments and healthcare providers and patient behaviors.
  • Proven track record in customer analytics and performance management, strategic planning or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to drive business outcomes through data-driven insights.
  • 8+ years of domain expertise in one or more of: enterprise analytics, secondary data analytics, primary market research, field analytics, patient service analytics, or related strategic analytics/management consulting.
  • 7+ years of people management experience, with a proven track record of enabling data-driven decision-making at a senior leadership level, including addressing complex business challenges and shaping organizational strategy in therapeutic areas
  • Experience creating and implementing segmentation models for HCPs and patients based on attitudes, behaviors, and beliefs.
  • Experience creating end-to-end patient and provider journey maps and managing multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals
  • Experience managing relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leadership and external partners
  • Substantial people leadership experience, including leading senior talent, developing leaders, and operating through globally distributed or cross-location delivery models.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple complex priorities, establish governance and decision rights, and deliver high-quality outcomes under ambiguity and tight timelines.

Leadership skills

  • Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team through Associate Director and SM leaders, creating clear accountability for enterprise value, business impact, functional expertise, and quality of delivery.
  • Able to navigate cross-functional complexities and enable impactful and fast decision-making by identifying core issues of the situations, keeping focused on the big picture, and adapting and prioritizing during the change
  • Collaborate across boundaries, influence without authority, integrate diverse perspectives, challenge assumptions with data-driven decision making, and adapt leadership style to maximize team and enterprise impact.
  • Own talent planning for the capability, including hiring, onboarding, objective setting, coaching, performance management, succession, career development, engagement, and retention.
  • Build strategic consulting and executive advisory capability of the team so that analytical outputs consistently translate into actionable business recommendations.
  • Create a culture of collaboration, constructive challenge, innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and accountability across Hyderabad and cross-functional teams.
  • Support I&A and AIDE leadership on cross-team talent priorities, organizational operations, capability planning, and site-level initiatives.

Success Measurements

  • Decision Impact: Enterprise recommendations materially improve the quality, speed, and clarity of portfolio, forecasting, and investment decisions.
  • Segmentation effectiveness: Accuracy and actionability of patient and provider segments created from behavioral, attitudinal and clinical data.
  • Journey mapping completeness: Feedback rating on comprehensiveness and insight quality of patient and provider journey maps, including leakage points and touchpoints.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Effectiveness of collaboration and integration of insights across teams, and clarity of communication between functional and business teams.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Strong endorsement from the US Enterprise team, I&A LT, AIDE leader and underlying functional leaders on influence, responsiveness, and quality of challenge.
  • Talent & Team Health: Successful hiring, development, engagement, retention, and progression of senior talent, with clear succession and capability plans.

Required Skills

  • Exceptional business acumen paired with a deep understanding of pharmaceutical business dynamics
  • Deep understanding of patient and provider data as well as behavioural, attitudinal and clinical data within a healthcare network
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights and solutions persuasively to diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including marketing, market research, field insights, NPS insights, performance insights and patient engagement, to drive strategic alignment
  • Strong leadership skills in a team environment requiring negotiation, persuasion, collaboration, and analytical judgment
  • Commitment to driving and enabling data-driven decision making throughout all levels of the organization
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing business needs and priorities

Preferred Skills

  • Deep understanding of the US pharmaceutical commercial model, portfolio economics, and associated data and analytics ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical datasets such as prescription, claims, patient-level, access, promotional, finance, and operational data.
  • Strong program management, change management, and senior stakeholder communication capability.

Location: Hyderabad NKC | Hybrid | 3 days a week in office is mandatory.

Direct Reports: 5-8 Associate Director and Senior Manager level leaders


Skills Desired

Brand Analysis, Brand Awareness, Commercial Excellence, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Insights, Digital Marketing, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Thought Leadership, Trend Analysis

title: Principal Program Leader – Digital & Data
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position

In Pharma Technical Operations (PT), we deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide. Beginning in 2026, PT’s leadership has committed to expanding our global digital impact and scale major Data & Digital programs across PT.

As a Principal Program Leader – PT Digital & Data, you will join an elite, internal advisory and delivery team within PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE). Acting as an internal program leader, you will serve as a high-impact catalyst for digital evolution across Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

In this role, your initial strategic focus will be spearheading and scaling a complex, global Data Governance operationalization initiative across global sites and functions - ensuring robust alignment with QMS, GxP, Data Integrity, and emerging regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, GMP Chapter 4, Annex 11). As the governance framework reaches maturity and sustainment, you will strategically transition your program management scope to lead, advise, and scale other complex, high-priority data and digital transformation initiatives across the PTE portfolio.

Core Responsibilities

Transformational Delivery & Governance:

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Build, lead, and empower cross-functional workstreams (Process experts, Engineering, Data, AI, Migration, and Change Management) accountable for achieving key technical, operational, and business milestones.
  • Design, create and scale Global PT wide programs: Lead the end-to-end advisory and deployment of e.g. Digital capability, Data Governance, Data Integrity, and QMS frameworks across PT manufacturing sites and functional areas, ensuring compliance, inspection readiness, and operational alignment.
  • Executive & Site Leadership Guidance: Serve as a trusted advisor to site heads, functional directors, and steering committees as well their organizations - guiding them through complex change pathways, resource prioritization, and digital & data maturity roadmaps.
  • Standards & Compliance: Establish robust program governance ensuring full alignment with internal and GMP/GxP standards.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Matrix Leadership: Partner closely with executive stakeholders across diverse domains - including PT site leaders, Quality, Development (CMC), manufacturing, supply chain, regulatory and supporting functions - to build confidence, manage competing priorities, and secure operations-wide alignment.
  • Resource & Financial Stewardship: Manage the overall program budget (headcount, capital investment, operating costs), monitor program effectiveness (tracking promised ROI/business value vs. reality), and apply data-driven decision-making to optimize resource allocation.
  • Drive adoption strategies: Drive AI-assisted tools, shopfloor automation, and operations-wide data models, helping teams transition from transactional execution to data-informed decision-making.

Organizational Change Management, Onboarding & Adoption:

  • Ensure seamless integration of Organizational Change Management (OCM) and behavioral adoption strategies across all program streams, partnering with dedicated change leads to drive business process adoption.

Who You Are

You are an executive-level transformation leader who thrives at the intersection of complex digital and data technology, human behavior, and large-scale operational environments. You combine deep technical literacy and hands-on technical execution with strategic foresight, empathy, and a proven track record of driving change across matrixed organizations. A balanced blend of direct, hands-on technical building alongside Change Management and Stakeholder Coaching is essential for success in this role.

Qualifications & Expertise:
  • Education: University degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.
  • Professional Experience:
  • Domain & Program Expertise:
    • 10+ years of senior leadership experience in program management, Digital, Data, or IT transformation within large-scale matrix organizations and multi-site global operational networks (e.g., 1,000+ end-users across multiple geographies).
    • 8+ years driving transformations within pharmaceutical operations, biotechnology, manufacturing, or healthcare technology.
    • Domain Leadership: Deep expertise in Digital, Data, GxP/GMP compliance, Data Integrity frameworks, and IT/OT data environments, with a proven track record of strategic advisory and guiding executive stakeholders through multi-site rollouts.
  • Regulatory & Compliance:
    • Demonstrated mastery in shaping executive strategy and guiding organizational readiness within validated environments, navigating labor frameworks (Workers Councils) and digital governance (GDPR, EU AI Act) without compromising strict GxP quality standards.
  • Organizational Change & Influence:
    • Lean/Agile mindset with exceptional stakeholder management, empathy, and executive influence across cross-functional teams.
    • Demonstrated experience applying behavioral science principles (e.g., behavioral economics, nudge theory, habit formation loops) in a professional or operational context.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certifications: Certified in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or other large-scale Agile frameworks; formal certification in Organizational Change Management (e.g., Prosci, Kotter).
  • Languages: Business-fluent English is required; German is an asset given frequent collaboration with major PT hubs (e.g., Kaiseraugst, Basel).

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity.

PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) drives the digital evolution of Pharma Technical Operations, empowering our global manufacturing and supply network with cutting-edge data, infrastructure, and operational tools.

What We Offer:

  • Transformational Impact: Direct leadership of Roche’s flagship AI infrastructure project, shaping the future of therapeutic development and operational excellence.
  • High-Visibility Scope: Broad strategic influence across both PTE and global Technical Operations executive leadership.
  • Growth & Empowerment: An empowering environment that values autonomous leadership, psychological safety, flexible hybrid working models, and continuous learning.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Sr CRA
description:

Office

Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Location/Division Specific Information

Performs and coordinates different aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.

Discover Impactful Work:

Conducts remote or on- site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation. Manages procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments. Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability. Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites and client company personnel. Assists project manager or clinical team manager on assigned projects and will take a lead role where required. Supports the line manager to mentor, train and contribute to the development of junior clinical team members.

A day in the Life:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
  • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
  • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
  • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Keys to Success:

Education

Bachelor's degree in a life science related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

Experience

Considerable clinical research monitoring experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years) with a demonstrated high level of expertise in all aspects of clinical monitoring.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Expert clinical monitoring skills
  • Expert knowledge of FDA guidelines, ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
  • Excellent critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
  • Proficient in Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate medical research data and proficient knowledge of medical terminology
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to maintain customer focus
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
  • Effective presentation skills
  • Ability to utilize problem-solving techniques applicable to constantly evolving environment
  • Good digital literacy: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
  • Frequently drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals. May also include extended overnight stays.
  • Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
  • Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
  • Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
  • Frequent mobility required.
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software.
  • Ability to communicate complex information and ideas so others will understand
  • Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
  • Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Benefits

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com
