Description of Duties:

The Senior Systems Engineer supports SLS Program / NASA systems on the Amentum ESSCA contract.

The key purpose of the position is to plan and perform systems engineering, development, assembly, test, verification, certification, integration activities specifically for the SLS Upper Stage for Artemis IV and beyond. Provide support to implement additional requirements for the ARTEMIS and MAESTRO software including design, development, integration and testing with Upper Stage partner(s). Facilitate integration as needed between SLS Core Stage test & integration facilities and Upper Stage test & integration facilities.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Systems Engineer will provide systems engineering support to the NASA SLS Upper Stage program office at MSFC. The skills needed to support the Core Stage consists of all the skills provided to the ES53 IATF, including Simulations software developers, systems engineers, integration and test engineers, and mechanical and electrical technicians.

Additional responsibilities are defined below:

• Perform or coordinate systems engineering activities including Trade Studies and Analysis, Requirements Definition and Traceability, Requirements Allocation and Verification, Interface Definition, System Integration and test, and Design Verification and Validation. Also ensure requirements and specifications can be verified and validated, including risk mitigations, usability and NASA requirements.

• Work closely with SLS Upper stage program office and IATF software, hardware, and facility development personnel during development, understanding of configurations in development, operation, verification, and validation of IATF systems and emulators.

• Assist the project verification and validation team by defining and delivering verification and validation project deliverables.

• Identify the data that will be required to show objectively that all configurations of the product meet their requirements, as well as customer needs.

• Ensure that all test systems and equipment are appropriately validated and controlled.

• Review and analyze IATF system test data and record pass/fail results and conclusions. Ensure that results are traced to requirements.

• Measure and report on progress toward completion of verification and validation, and summarize the verification and validation performed, the data reviewed, and conclusions reached in compliance.

• Support completion of development testing, to characterize designs and understand trade-offs.

• Create or contribute to project deliverables which may include verification and/or validation plans, protocols, and reports; execution of the plans and protocols; and resolving deviations.

• Manage timeline for verification and validation activities and generate status reports.

These activities will continue as the launch vehicle architecture matures and the SLS program completes program phases, reviews and schedule milestones.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 14 days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

Office environment. Requires ability to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely communication, both verbally and in writing (100%). Requires ability to interact professionally with co-workers, management, and client (100%). Requires travel in the domestic USA (5%). Requires ability to work at a computer for long periods of time (100%).

Systems engineering experience supporting hardware and software integration, requirements development, verification and validation, and testing is preferred.

Job Description Summary

Als Staf Apotheker maak je deel uit van een team van zes apothekers en ben je roulerend aanwezig op de drie locaties in Eindhoven, Zwolle en Leiderdorp. In de radiofarmaca apotheken worden dagelijks aseptisch radiofarmacon spuiten bereid voor diagnostiek en therapie. Deze worden geleverd aan nucleaire afdelingen van ziekenhuizen in heel Nederland. Samen met je collega’s houd je toezicht op de bereiding en de logistiek, geef je producten vrij, en ben je farmaceutisch verantwoordelijk. In deze unieke positie krijg je als apotheker de kans om in een internationaal bedrijf werkzaam te zijn en tegelijkertijd nauw in contact te blijven met de Nederlandse markt. Deze positie heeft raakvlakken met de farmaceutische industrie, ziekenhuisfarmacie en de openbare farmacie, en biedt daarmee een grote diversiteit aan activiteiten. Voor deze functie bieden we in eerste instantie een contract voor 12 maanden aan.

Job Description

GE HealthCare is een toonaangevende wereldwijde innovator op het gebied van medische technologie en digitale oplossingen. Ons doel is om een wereld te creëren waar gezondheidszorg geen grenzen kent. Laat je ambitie spreken, transformeer ideeën in baanbrekende realiteiten, en word onderdeel van een organisatie waar elke stem ertoe doet en elk verschil bijdraagt aan een gezondere wereld.

GE HealthCare Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) is de nummer één wereldwijde leverancier van contrastmedia en moleculaire imaging agents die worden gebruikt om medisch beeldvormingsonderzoek te verbeteren. PDx-producten worden gebruikt in alle belangrijke diagnostische en behandelingstrajecten en helpen zo 3 patiënten per seconde over de hele wereld.

GE HealthCare PDx Eindhoven produceert just-in-time radiofarmaceutische producten, die over de gehele wereld worden verkocht en gedistribueerd naar ziekenhuizen ten behoeve van medisch beeldvormingsonderzoek. Ons bedrijf bevindt zich op de Campus van de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven.

De GE Healthcare Radiopharmacies NL organisatie bestaat uit drie apotheken gevestigd in Eindhoven, Leiderdorp en Zwolle. De radiofarmaca apotheken leveren kant-en-klare spuiten met radiofarmacon aan ziekenhuizen in Nederland.

Wat ga je doen?


  • Je rouleert tussen de drie radiofarmaca apotheken (Eindhoven, Leiderdorp en Zwolle) en hebt eigen verantwoordelijkheden op het gebied van kwaliteitsborging, implementatie van nieuwe processen en afstemming van de manier van werken tussen de drie locaties;
  • Samen met je collega’s ben je farmaceutische verantwoordelijk voor de drie apotheken. Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden, geeft producten vrij en bent een aanspreekpunt voor nucleair geneeskundigen;
  • In geval van afwezigheid van een van de beherend apothekers fungeer je als verantwoordelijke apotheker.

Dagelijkse werkzaamheden


  • Controleren van recepten die digitaal binnenkomen en het vrijgeven van producten;
  • Toezien op naleving van Goede Manieren van Produceren (GMP);
  • Vragen beantwoorden van nucleair geneeskundigen;
  • Afhandelen van klachten en afwijkingen;
  • Implementatie van nieuwe producten en procedures op de drie locaties en verwachtingen communiceren met het team;
  • Coördinatie met collega's om uniforme standaarden voor de drie apotheken te ontwikkelen in samenwerking met andere functies;
  • Opstellen van nieuwe procedures en verantwoordelijk voor het handhaven van een hoge standaard voor kwaliteitsbeheer op alle drie de locaties;
  • Als je volledig bent opgeleid, het vrijgeven van klinisch testmateriaal.

Wat breng je mee?


  • BIG geregistreerd als apotheker;
  • Ervaring of affiniteit met productbereiding;
  • Kennis in de radiofarmacie of bereidheid deze op te doen;
  • Je bent een proactieve en enthousiaste collega met sterke analytische vaardigheden en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden;
  • Je hebt de capaciteit om problemen op te lossen onder tijdsdruk.

Beloning

Ons totale beloningspakket is ontworpen om je de ruimte en flexibiliteit te bieden die nodig zijn om jouw ideeën om te zetten in baanbrekende veranderingen. Ons salaris en onze secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn alles wat je mag verwachten van een organisatie met wereldwijde kracht en schaal en er zijn volop carrieremogelijkheden in een bedrijfscultuur die zorg, samenwerking en ondersteuning bevordert.

Behaviour

We verwachten van alle medewerkers dat ze onze gedragsregels naleven: handelen met bescheidenheid en vertrouwen opbouwen; leiden met transparantie; werken met focus en verantwoordelijkheid stimuleren- altijd met onverminderde integriteit.

Inclusiviteit

GE HealthCare is een Equal Opportunity Employer waar inclusiviteit belangrijk is. In ons aannamebeleid spelen ras, huidskleur, religie, nationale of etnische afkomst, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, genderidentiteit, leeftijd of handicap geen rol.

title: Weaving Operator (PFC)
description:
The weaver operator will be responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining machinery to ensure high quality production. This role involves physical activities, monitoring production output, conducting quality checks, maintaining accurate records and adhering to safety and quality standards.

DESCRIPTION

  • Ensures compliance regarding Safety, Food Safety, Quality and Good Housekeeping practices for all activities.
  • Immediately report to supervisor any incident and unsafe condition.
  • Basic Troubleshooting skills and ability to perform routine machine maintenance
  • Operates 4 to 6 machines at efficiency speed.
  • Check yarns, elastomer, and material to make sure there are no breaks, twisting, matting, wrapping or low yarns.
  • Follow inspection, production, and operational procedures in accordance with work instructions.
  • Conduct quality checks and identify products that do not meet quality standards
  • Resolve basic machine malfunctions, and promptly report any major issues to the supervisor
  • Maintain detailed records of machine settings, production output, and any repairs made.
  • Comply with all company policies, including safety, quality and housekeeping standards.
  • Perform all tasks with a sense of urgency and accuracy.
  • Adhere to safety protocols, wear appropriate personal equipment (PPE)
  • Maintain a clean and organized workspace.
  • Conduct other duties as assigned by management.

COMPETENCIES

  • Ability to work independently.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and measuring skills.
  • Understanding of wrap and weft yarns and weaving patterns.
  • Knowledge and adherence to safety regulations and protocols.
  • Mental alertness to identify and react to machine processes, quality and safety issues.
  • Dependable, punctual, and reliable.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while ensuring accuracy and safety
  • Basic math and measuring ability.
  • Be able to read and write.
  • Familiarity with FSSC 22000:2005, GMPs, LOTO and HACCP are preferred.
  • Familiar with the Lockout Tagout procedures.

EXPERIENCE

  • Previous experience in manufacturing is preferred.
  • Sewing knowledge or a related field is a plus.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to stand for long periods, lift up to 50 pounds, and perform repetitive tasks.
  • Competence in operating basic tools and measuring devices (e.g., tape measure, scale).
  • Ability of repetitive reaching, bending, pushing, pulling, kneeling, carrying, going up and down ladders/steps.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Work is performed primarily on the manufacturing floor, which may involve exposure to loud noises, machinery, high temperatures and chemicals.
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required.

title: Assembly Technician
description:
Are you a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working with mechanical, electrical, and automated systems? As an Assembly Technician, you will play a key role in building, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintaining factory test equipment that supports CoolIT's industry-leading liquid cooling solutions for AI, high-performance computing, and data center applications.


Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Automation, and Production teams, you will help ensure our test systems operate safely, reliably, and efficiently.


What's in it For You

  • Vacation and flex days, plus a paid company-wide shutdown during the holiday season.
  • Comprehensive benefits from day one, including Dental, Drug, Vision, Paramedical, and Health Spending coverage.
  • Casual yet professional "dress for your day" work environment.
  • Company-funded RRSP contributions.
  • Annual professional development allowance to support continued learning and career growth.
  • Opportunity to work on industry-leading cooling technologies supporting AI and high-performance computing applications.

What You Will Do

  • Assemble, install, commission, and support factory test equipment and automated manufacturing systems.
  • Build, wire, configure, and troubleshoot electrical panels, sensors, actuators, and instrumentation.
  • Support automated test stations by configuring hardware, software, and communication interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control system issues to minimize downtime.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, and equipment upgrades.
  • Work with Engineering and Production teams to improve equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency.
  • Follow safe work practices and promote a safety-first culture.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and records for equipment and maintenance activities.

Position Details

  • Location: Calgary, AB
  • Work Arrangement: Onsite
  • Schedule: Full-time

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or technical certificate.
  • 1-3 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing, maintenance, assembly, testing, or a related technical environment.
  • Basic mechanical and electrical aptitude.
  • Experience using hand tools and basic diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to follow drawings, work instructions, and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with industrial or manufacturing equipment.
  • Experience with piping, pumps, valves, sensors, or instrumentation.
  • Familiarity with PLCs, HMIs, or industrial control systems.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics and P&IDs.
  • Experience supporting test equipment or production equipment.

Physical Requirements of Position

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift throughout the workday.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely.
  • Ability to work around manufacturing and test equipment.
  • Occasional lifting of parts, assemblies, and equipment.

Successful candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening, including criminal record and education verification checks.


About CoolIT Systems


CoolIT Systems, an Ecolab company, is the global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling solutions for AI, data center, and high-performance computing applications. Our technology powers some of the world's most advanced computing environments while helping drive sustainable innovation.


During pre-screening, we may use an AI tool, supported by human oversight, to efficiently manage tasks such as resume screening and/or interview scheduling. All hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.


Successful candidates will be required to undergo pre-hire background checks as a condition of employment.

title: Vyr. gamybos technikas(-ė)
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

Job Description




„Thermo Fisher Scientific“ kuriame sprendimus, padedančius žmonėms gyventi sveikesniame, švaresniame ir saugesniame pasaulyje. Tai daugiau nei mūsų misija – tai kasdienis darbas, kuriantis vertę pacientams, mokslui ir visuomenei.

Vilniaus padalinyje kuriame ir gaminame inovatyvias gyvybės mokslų bei diagnostikos technologijas, naudojamas visame pasaulyje. Mūsų komandos dirba aplinkoje, kurioje svarbūs profesionalumas, bendradarbiavimas, inovacijos ir nuolatinis tobulėjimas.

Šiame padalinyje komanda specializuojasi produktų fasavimo ir komplektavimo procesuose, vykdomuose laikantis Geros gamybos praktikos (GGP) reikalavimų. Čia ruošiami GGP kokybės nukleotidai, naudojami mRNR terapijose, vakcinų ir vaistų gamyboje, diagnostikoje bei gydyme.




Pareigų aprašymas



Ieškome Vyr. gamybos technikas(-ė), kuris (-i) prisijungs prie mūsų gamybos komandos ir prisidės prie sklandaus produktų fasavimo, ženklinimo bei komplektavimo procesų vykdymo.

Šioje pozicijoje būsite atsakingas (-a) už etikečių spausdinimą, produktų fasavimą, vizualinę patikrą ir galutinių produktų komplektavimą, laikydamiesi nustatytų darbo procedūrų bei aukštų kokybės standartų.

Jūsų darbas prisidės prie kokybiškų produktų tiekimo laboratorijoms ir sveikatos priežiūros įstaigoms, vykdančioms svarbius mokslinius ir medicininius tyrimus. Ši pozicija tinkama kruopštiems, atsakingiems ir kokybei dėmesingiems kandidatams (-ėms), norintiems (-čioms) dirbti reguliuojamoje gamybos aplinkoje.




Pagrindinės atsakomybės



• Atlikti produktų fasavimą pagal nustatytas darbo procedūras ir kokybės reikalavimus

• Atlikti vizualinę produktų patikrą

• Spausdinti ir paruošti produktų etiketes

• Komplektuoti galutinius produktus ir atlikti jų kokybės patikras

• Užtikrinti tikslų produktų ženklinimą ir komplektavimą

• Palaikyti švarią ir tvarkingą darbo aplinką

• Laikytis standartinių darbo procedūrų (SOP), GGP, kokybės ir saugos reikalavimų




Patirtis ir kvalifikacijos



• Vidurinis išsilavinimas

• Gebėjimas skaityti ir suprasti gamybos dokumentaciją, instrukcijas bei standartines darbo procedūras (SOP)

• Kompiuterinis raštingumas ir gebėjimas dirbti su dokumentavimo sistemomis

• Gebėjimas laikytis detalių darbo procedūrų ir kokybės standartų reikalavimų




Įgūdžiai ir kompetencijos



• Kruopštumas, tikslumas ir dėmesys detalėms

• Atsakingas požiūris į darbo kokybę

• Gebėjimas dirbti tiek savarankiškai, tiek komandoje

• Gebėjimas tiksliai laikytis nustatytų instrukcijų ir procedūrų

• Geri darbo organizavimo įgūdžiai

• Gebėjimas išlaikyti aukštą tikslumo ir kokybės lygį atliekant gamybines užduotis




Vertinsime kaip privalumą



• Bent 2 metų darbo patirtį gamybos, operacijų, gamybos procesų, laboratorijos ar susijusioje srityje

• Darbo patirtį GGP aplinkoje

• Darbo patirtį švariose patalpose




Darbo sąlygos ir darbo laikas



• Darbo modelis – darbas vietoje

• Darbo dienos – pirmadienis–penktadienis (I–V)

• Darbo laikas – 8:00–16:45 val.

• Darbas vyksta švariose patalpose, laikantis griežtų taršos kontrolės procedūrų

• Darbo metu privaloma naudoti asmenines apsaugos priemones (AAP) pagal nustatytus saugos ir kokybės reikalavimus

• Darbas reikalauja kruopštumo ir tikslumo atliekant produktų fasavimo, ženklinimo ir komplektavimo užduotis




Ką siūlome



• Metinį priedą už rezultatus ir papildomas finansines naudas

• Išsamų sveikatos paketą: privatų sveikatos, gyvybės ir nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą

• Darbuotojų ir jų šeimos narių gerovės programą: psichologines konsultacijas, sveikatos patikras, skiepus bei sveikatingumo iniciatyvas

• Profesinio augimo galimybes: vidinius mokymus, prieigą prie „Thermo Fisher e-University“ ir nuolatinį tobulėjimą

• Galimybę dirbti globalioje, inovacijas skatinančioje organizacijoje ir bendradarbiauti su tarptautinėmis komandomis

• Kasdienes naudas: dalinai kompensuojamą maitinimą, sporto salę ir įmonės transportą

• Įtraukią ir palaikančią darbo kultūrą, komandos renginius bei bendruomenės iniciatyvas

• 2 papildomas apmokamas savanorystės dienas per metus




Kaip kandidatuoti



Jeigu vertinate kruopštumą ir kokybę, norite dirbti modernioje gamybos aplinkoje bei prisidėti prie produktų, naudojamų svarbiuose mokslo ir sveikatos priežiūros procesuose, gamybos, kviečiame kandidatuoti ir prisijungti prie „Thermo Fisher Scientific“ komandos.


Net jei Jūsų patirtis apima tik dalį šiai pozicijai reikalingų kompetencijų, tačiau esate motyvuotas (-a) mokytis ir tobulėti, lauksime Jūsų kandidatūros.


Esame lygių galimybių darbdavys ir vertiname įvairovę.


Dėkojame visiems kandidatams (-ėms) už susidomėjimą. Dėl didelio gaunamų paraiškų skaičiaus galėsime susisiekti tik su kandidatais (-ėmis), atrinktais (-omis) į kitą atrankos etapą.

Compensation

The monthly salary range estimated for this position based in Lithuania is €1,291.67–€1,941.67.

title: Global Expert Estimating & Benchmarking (80-100%)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Global Expert Estimating & Benchmarking, you will lead the integration of data science, predictive modeling, and cost engineering to ensure cost certainty across our global multi-billion-franc capital project portfolio. Joining our Global Capital Investment team in Basel, you will leverage advanced analytics, AI, and historical benchmarking to transform raw data into high-value strategic insights. This is a unique opportunity to shape future-ready estimating standards and drive value-focused investments across an international sites network.


The Opportunity

  • Drive cost certainty & standards: Develop, implement, and maintain global standards for cost estimating and benchmarking in alignment with industry best practices (e.g., AACE, IPA, RICS).
  • Deliver early-stage & conceptual estimates: Lead early-stage cost estimating and oversee conceptual and basic design estimates across major capital projects worldwide.
  • Pioneer predictive modeling & AI: Develop data science strategies using AI, LLMs, custom coding (Python/R), and BIM 5D to build automated parametric models and predictive forecasting tools.
  • Track market economics: Monitor global market trends, inflation, and economic indicators to assess their impact on project budgets and organizational standards.
  • Facilitate risk & value engineering: Support risk workshops to establish data-backed allowances for contingency, design development, and schedule reserves while driving value engineering.
  • Build capability & community: Lead a global Community of Practice for estimating and benchmarking while conducting technical training to build internal engineering competency.

Who You Are

  • Educational & Professional Credentials: You hold a Master’s degree (MSc or higher) in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or a quantitative field, paired with certifications like CEP, CCP, or MRICS.
  • Mega-Project & Controls Experience: You bring at least 15 years of hands-on experience in mega-project estimating, cost engineering, or global project controls across international, multi-cultural matrix organizations.
  • Data Science & AI Coding Skills: You possess high proficiency in quantitative data analysis with hands-on coding experience in Python, R, and AI-augmented project intelligence (e.g., Claude, LLMs) to automate parametric models.
  • Industry Standards & Methodologies: You bring expert knowledge of AACE/RICS standards, combined with proven ability in market economics tracking, risk workshop facilitation, and value engineering.
  • Collaborative Leadership & Mobility: You are a strong systematic thinker and communicator who thrives on continuous improvement, fluent in English (German is a plus), and open to up to 20% international travel.


We look forward to your application!


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Receiving Team Lead 3rd shift Sunday-Thursday 11 pm – 7 am -$24.82, plus $1.50 differential rate
description:

3rd shift Sunday-Thursday 11 pm – 7 am -$24.82, plus $1.50 differential rate

Fort Mill, SC, USA


The Receiving Team Lead is responsible for ensuring all incoming shipments are accurately received, put away, and that all pick locations are properly replenished. This role leads the receiving and replenishment department, coordinating daily operations to maintain inventory accuracy and workflow efficiency.


Come build your career.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better, For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? • Troubleshoot associate issues and provide guidance as needed.

• Ensure compliance with all work instructions and ISO standards.

The Details:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

And More:

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. title: Part -Time Maintenance
description:
Now Hiring: Part-Time Maintenance Technician

Location: Winslow, Indiana

We are seeking a dependable, skilled, and motivated Maintenance Technician to join our team at our Winslow, Indiana property. The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical aptitude, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to perform a variety of maintenance and repair tasks.

This position is currently part-time, with the possibility of transitioning to full-time as operational needs grow. The successful candidate will help maintain the property's buildings, grounds, equipment, and overall safety while providing timely and professional maintenance services to residents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance on building systems and equipment.

  • Maintain clean, safe, and presentable grounds and exterior areas.

  • Troubleshoot and perform repairs involving plumbing, electrical systems, HVAC, and general building maintenance.

  • Complete general carpentry, repairs, installations, and other maintenance projects.

  • Respond promptly to emergency maintenance requests.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, work orders, and service logs.

  • Monitor, order, and maintain inventory of maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment.

  • Identify safety concerns and report maintenance issues requiring additional attention.

  • Work independently and collaborate with the property management team to ensure efficient daily operations.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Minimum of two years of maintenance experience or experience in a related field.

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

  • Must have basic hand tools necessary to perform routine maintenance duties.

  • Basic knowledge of plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, and general building repairs.

  • HVAC, plumbing, electrical certifications, or technical training are a plus but are not required.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.

  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining a safe environment.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Competitive pay and benefits, as applicable to the position.

  • Opportunity for additional hours and potential transition to full-time employment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • Supportive team environment with an opportunity to make a positive impact on the property and its residents.

Interested applicants are encouraged to apply! We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, demonstrates reliability, and is committed to keeping our property safe, clean, and well-maintained.

title: Patient Liaison Officer
description:
Patient Liaison Officer

40 hours per week (some flexibility required)

Monday - Friday


At HCA UK, we know that a reassuring voice, a warm welcome and excellent organisation can make all the difference to someone navigating their healthcare journey. As a Patient Liaison Officer within our HANS service, you'll play a vital role in creating a seamless experience for patients, clients and clinicians, ensuring every interaction is handled with professionalism, compassion and care.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive and collaborative team where your contribution is valued and recognised. Working in a hybrid environment, you'll combine exceptional customer service with strong administrative and organisational skills, helping to coordinate patient care while supporting the efficient running of a busy clinical service. You'll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to delivering an outstanding experience and supporting one another to achieve shared goals.

Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Other’s may think this is just a role in HANS, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.

What you'll do

  • Be the first point of contact for patients, clients and stakeholders, providing an exceptional customer experience by telephone and email.
  • Manage clinician diaries, coordinate appointments and meetings, and support patients throughout their healthcare journey.
  • Maintain accurate patient records, open and close patient files, and upload specialist reports using clinical systems.
  • Provide comprehensive administrative support to the clinical team, including audio typing medical reports and correspondence.
  • Support service improvement projects, reporting activities and database management whilst ensuring compliance with confidentiality and governance standards.

What you'll bring

  • Previous experience in an administrative, patient-facing or customer service role.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a compassionate and professional approach.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
  • Strong typing skills and confidence using databases and digital systems. Experience of medical software or electronic patient record systems would be an advantage.

Why join HCA UK?

At HCA UK, you'll be part of a community that values compassion, collaboration and continuous learning. We invest in our colleagues through ongoing development opportunities, supportive leadership and the chance to broaden your experience within one of the UK's leading healthcare organisations.

Whether you're supporting patients through important moments in their healthcare journey or helping clinicians deliver exceptional care, your contribution will be recognised and valued. In return, you'll benefit from a flexible hybrid working arrangement and the opportunity to develop your career within a well-established and growing service.

If you're passionate about delivering outstanding service and thrive in a fast-paced healthcare environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Audit - Mid Market - Graduate - Poole - September 2027
description:
Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future.

See how businesses really work and make an impact from day one.
Audit is about more than numbers. It's about understanding organisations, building trust in financial information, and helping businesses, investors and communities make informed decisions. You'll work with a diverse range of clients, gain insight into different industries, and develop skills that will benefit you throughout your career.
At Forvis Mazars, you'll work towards a professional qualification, learn from experienced professionals, and gain hands-on experience using the latest technology and data-driven tools. With real responsibility, continuous learning, and exposure to a variety of businesses, Audit offers an exciting foundation for a successful career.
Ready to challenge yourself, accelerate your development, and discover how businesses really work? Start your career in Audit with Forvis Mazars and make a difference from day one.

About our team:
Join our Mid-Market Audit team, working with a diverse portfolio of privately owned businesses, from ambitious start-ups to large international groups. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of industries, helping businesses achieve their goals while developing valuable technical, commercial and client-facing skills.

Hear from our graduate trainee Max:
“I've really enjoyed the combination of on the job learning and studying. There is a great network of people from dedicated learning and development teams to my people manager and buddy to support with the transition from university'
#LI-DNP

To apply for our Graduate Programme, you’ll need:

  • GCSE Maths and English Language at Grade 4/C (or equivalent qualifications).
  • Achieved a minimum of 112 UCAS tariff points from your top three A Levels, BTECs, Scottish Highers/Advanced Highers, or other recognised Level 3 qualifications.
  • Achieved or predicted a 2:1 degree classification (or equivalent).

We know everyone’s circumstances are different. If exceptional circumstances have affected your academic results, we’ll consider the context you provide as part of your application.

Does this sound like you?

Enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and spotting trends.
Curious about business, financial performance and risk.
A clear communicator who builds strong relationships.
Interested in technology, data analytics and AI in audit.
Adaptable, motivated and eager to learn.

title: BHCC Clinician/Discharge Planner (76616)
description:
Position Schedule: 3 - 12 hour shifts 11 am - 11:30 pm Sunday, Monday & Tuesday or Wednesday, Thursday & Friday

Position Summary:

Under supervision, the Clinician provides crisis assessments, psychosocial evaluations, treatment planning, monitoring, and discharge planning for individuals receiving services in a Behavioral Health Crisis Center (BHCC). The Clinician delivers immediate intervention for clients experiencing acute mental health and/or substance use crises. Responsibilities include conducting crisis assessments, gathering collateral information, engaging in natural support, determining appropriate levels of care, and coordinating services as part of an interdisciplinary treatment team.

Job Responsibilities and Performance Standards:

  1. Performs job responsibilities under supervision.
    • Conducts timely clinical assessments of behavioral health needs for individuals presenting for crisis services.
    • Determines appropriate services and recommends alternate care plans within established time frames.
    • Completes or directs the intake process, ensuring accurate assembly of medical, psychological, and financial information.
    • Utilizes Mindset and CPI de escalation skills to prevent escalation and avoid physical restraint.
    • Prioritizes eligible applicants appropriately and refers ineligible individuals to suitable community resources.
    • Documents are all assessments and clinical activities accurately and within required time frames.

  1. Serves as job expert or organization resource in assigned areas.
    • Communicates identified treatment goals clearly to clients and their families or supports.
    • Monitors client progress through interviews, team discussions, chart reviews, and other means; conveys relevant updates to authorized family/support members.
    • Writes clear, concise, and accurate progress notes in accordance with policy and documentation standards.

  1. Advocates for clients and coordinates needed services.
    • Develops and maintains effective working relationships with community partners.
    • Participates in internal and external meetings, committees, task forces, or review sessions to support communication and service coordination.
    • Represents the organization professionally at community meetings or events.
    • Collaborate with team members on case management, case consultation, and discharge planning.
    • Makes appropriate referrals for support services and ensures follow through as applicable.

  1. Conducts client interviews to establish safe discharge plans and ensure continuity of care.
  • Meets with clients and families to address concerns and practice skills identified in treatment goals, individually or in groups.
    • Supports treatment and nursing care plans by engaging clients in preparation for discharge.
    • Assists clients in accessing community resources, including legal, medical, financial, and social services.
    • Coordinates transportation for appointments and discharge in a timely manner.
    • Contact clients or guardians to obtain updates on progress and needs.
    • Communicate with internal and external providers to obtain background information and coordinate care according to established guidelines.
    • Collaborates with service agencies to address concerns and recommend treatment plan changes.
    • Provides short term case management and referrals for clients experiencing emergency situations.

  1. Maintains professional knowledge and competency.
    • Attend seminars, workshops, and professional meetings as available.
    • Participate in required in service training and continuing education activities.
    • Stays current with trends and developments in behavioral health by reviewing relevant literature and professional materials.

title: Shipping / Receiving Clerk
description:
West Star is the fastest growing maintenance repair organization in the industry and we recognize this is the result of our talented team of trusted employees working together to deliver customer service excellence. We are committed to providing our employees with personal and professional growth opportunities while fostering a culture of respect and well-being with a small company feel.

When you join our team we don’t think you should have to wait for your benefits to kick in. That’s why when you start, they start with you! This includes medical, dental, 401K match, time off accruals, weekly pay days and much more. We don’t want you to live to work, we want you to work and live.

What you can expect as a Shipping and Receiving Clerk at West Star:

This hourly position requires an energetic individual to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented shipping/receiving position. They will need to work well under pressure and with time constraints. Accurate data entry with excellent organizational skills are essential. Ideal candidates must be able to read and interpret documents such as vendor invoices, packing slips, bills of lading and internal company documents. Experience with regard to receiving inspections, documentation and traceability of aircraft parts per FAA regulations helpful but not required. This position is key to ensuring effective and efficient shipping and receiving of product. Experience in handling static sensitive and fragile electromechanical product helpful but not required.

You will be ESSENTIAL to many FUNCTIONS including:

  • Receive all incoming parts under strict FAA receiving regulations.
  • Verify material with invoice or packing sheet.
  • Stage parts for distribution by runners to various work orders and other departments.
  • Receive and prep shipments for outside sales customers.
  • Package shipments with proper labeling by carrier.
  • Log all shipments by specified carrier.
  • Track packages when required.
  • Occasionally help parts counter personnel.
  • Assess freight charges and bill to appropriate work orders.
  • Effectively and clearly communicate (i.e., speak, write, read) in English
  • Any other job-related duties as assigned by supervisor or management

What you’ll need to bring with you:

Your Education:
A High school diploma or equivalent.
A valid driver’s license approved for airline travel and/or a valid passport is ideal, but not mandatory.

Your Experience:
Experience with FedEx Ship Manager/UPS Worldship software helpful but not required.
Forklift experience preferred, but not required.

Your Initiative:
We’re looking for team players who are self-motivated and able to perform in a fast paced environment where working under specific deadlines and time constraints will be common. Must be well organized, have a high attention to detail, strong written/verbal/analytical and interpersonal skills and the capability to work with minimal supervision.

Your Sense of Responsibility:
Attend work every day as scheduled to include overtime and weekend assignments. Notify supervisor in advance of shift starting if unable to work.
Must have reliable transportation to get to work each and every day.
Follow West Star Aviation repair station receiving inspection guidelines to maintain certified and traceable product.
Responsible for handling of fragile expensive aircraft avionics components.
Responsible for receiving and shipping of all materials.

Other particulars:

Physical Requirements
Lifts 50 lbs.
Routine walking, bending and use of stairs.

Mental Requirements
Work with others in a professional manner.
Prioritize workload.
Work with new or upgraded computer systems.

Working Conditions
Occasionally will work outside in all types of weather on large projects.

Equipment Used
PC computer, telephone, fax, calculator, FedEx and UPS software, forklift, power/hand tools and packaging foam and banding machines.

title: The North Face: Supervisor - Towson Town Center
description:
At The North Face we dare to lead the world forward through Exploration. We were born to Explore, Disrupt and to Lead. We were born to Love Wild Places and to Spark Curiosity. We believe that exploration is a mindset - both on the mountain and off the mountain - and it infuses everything we do. As a community of explorers, we stay curious about new ideas, places, and people.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with a team of adventure-loving people, The North Face just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit The North Face Careers or .

Supervisor

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Supervisor at The North Face looks a little like this.

As a Supervisor, you play a key role in supporting the store’s leadership team and driving abets-in-class customer experience. You will lead by example, coach and develop associates, and ensure operational excellence across customer engagement, merchandising, and store standards. In partnership with the Store Manager and Assistant Store Manager, you will help maximize store profitability, foster an inclusive team culture, and contribute to the store’s success. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced retail environment, enjoys mentoring others, and is passionate about delivering exceptional service. Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

  • Deliver a high level of personalized customer engagement through genuine interactions.​
  • Support the store team in achieving and exceeding sales goals by monitoring progress against key performance indicators, while also achieving individual goals.​
  • Model selling behaviors and foster a consumer-centric mindset through authentic customer interactions.​
  • Coach and develop associates to deliver high levels of customer engagement and meet productivity goals.​
  • Supervise daily store operations, including opening and closing procedures, floor coverage, and task delegation.​
  • Support stockroom operations by organizing inventory, processing shipments, and ensuring timely product flow to the sales floor.​
  • Assist in training and onboarding new team members; provide ongoing feedback and support.​
  • Maintain visual merchandising standards and ensure product replenishment aligns with brand directives.​
  • Support inventory integrity through proper shipping, receiving, and loss prevention practices.​
  • Promote community engagement by participating in local initiatives and events.​
  • Uphold company policies, safety standards, and operational procedures.​
  • Foster a positive and inclusive store environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and learning.

What do you need to succeed?

We all bring unique skills to work each day. For this role, there are foundational skills needed to succeed, along with 1+ years of retail or store leadership experience in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment​. A High School Diploma or equivalent is preferred; but we value hands-on experience and demonstrated achievements most.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • Proven ability to drive results through store teams and exceed sales and profit goals.​
  • Skilled in coaching, motivating, and building high-performing, diverse teams.​
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence across all levels.​
  • Solution-oriented and flexible in a fast-paced, dynamic retail environment.​
  • Capable of working independently, managing shifting priorities, and meeting business expectations.​
  • Comfortable using word processing, spreadsheets, and retail software tools.​
  • Ability to stand and move throughout the store for extended periods and perform physical tasks such as bending, reaching, squatting, climbing ladders, and lifting light to moderate weight, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Now WE have a question for YOU.

title: Senior Scientist I / II – Translational Immuno‑Oncology Research
description:
Job Description Summary

Are you passionate about cancer immunology and keen to bridge exploratory research to early clinical development? This is an exciting opportunity to join the Oncology Translational Research (OTR) department at Novartis Biomedical Research in Cambridge, MA. OTR is a global, laboratory-based research organization supporting the Oncology Disease Area from early target identification through proof-of-concept clinical trials and late-stage development. OTR plays a critical role in understanding target biology, therapeutic mechanisms of action, response and resistance mechanisms, biomarker strategy, indication selection and rational combination opportunities.

We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Senior Scientist I/II with demonstrated knowledge of cancer immunology and expertise in developing and executing assays that enable biomarker discovery and validation. This is a predominantly on-site, hands-on laboratory role supporting targeted-therapy programs in hematologic malignancies. The successful candidate will partner closely with project scientists to translate biological hypotheses into robust, decision-enabling experiments.

Location: Cambridge, US #LI-Onsite

This role is based in Cambridge, US. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.


Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, troubleshoot and optimize multiparameter/spectral flow-cytometry and complementary cell-based assays to characterize immune, stromal and tumor cell populations across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors and evaluate pharmacodynamic responses.
  • Execute ex vivo studies using human primary cells, tumor cell lines and patient-derived blood and tissue samples, including complex co-cultures, with rigorous sterile technique.
  • Develop fit-for-purpose readouts for proliferation and viability, apoptosis, differentiation, cytokine signaling, target engagement and mechanism of action.
  • Analyze and integrate experimental data using appropriate statistical and visualization tools; communicate clear interpretations, limitations and recommended next experiments to multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Independently plan and execute experiments aligned with project strategy, manage competing priorities and deliver reproducible data within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain accurate, complete and contemporaneous experimental records in the electronic laboratory notebook and ensure traceability of methods, samples, analyses and conclusions.
  • Introduce and qualify new laboratory methods when they materially improve project decisions, throughput or data quality.
  • Contribute to publications and technical reports, train colleagues in established methods and collaborate effectively across functional teams.

Essential for the role:

This is a dual posting. The final level of the offered role will be determined by the hiring team based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required to perform the role at the offered level.

  • Senior Scientist I: Bachelor’s degree in cell biology, molecular biology, immunology or a related discipline with 5+ years of relevant work experience; or Master’s degree in a related discipline with 3+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Senior Scientist II: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant biological discipline with 7+ years of relevant work experience; or Master’s degree in a relevant biological discipline with 5+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with multiparameter or spectral flow cytometry, including panel design, sample preparation, instrument operation, acquisition, quality control and data analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with primary human cell culture and immune-cell or tumor-biology assays, including sterile complex co-cultures and patient-derived blood or tissue material.
  • Experience with intracellular cytokine staining and multiplex cytokine assays, such as MSD, to quantify pharmacodynamic responses in experimental models.
  • Strong quantitative data-analysis and presentation skills using tools such as GraphPad Prism and Spotfire, with the ability to produce clear, decision-ready figures and reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design and execute rigorous experiments, troubleshoot complex assays and translate results into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent organization, collaboration and written and oral communication skills, including a consistent record of complete and contemporaneous ELN documentation.

Desirable for the role:

  • Experience with IncuCyte or a comparable real-time cell-analysis platform.
  • Prior biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience supporting drug-discovery projects and working to project timelines and quality expectations.

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.

We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Cleveland

Facility

Cleveland Clinic Main Campus

G13001

Shift

Evenings

Schedule

Job Summary

Job Details


Join Cleveland Clinic's Main Campus where research and surgery are advanced, technology is leading-edge, patient care is world-class, and caregivers are family. Cleveland Clinic is recognized as one of the top hospitals in the nation. At Cleveland Clinic, you will work alongside passionate and dedicated caregivers, receive endless support and appreciation and build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.


Cleveland Clinic’s M81 Surgical Short Stay Unit cares for patients in need of extended recovery or observation following surgeries or procedures. This unit captures a wide variety of specialties, including endocrinology, urology, radiology, general surgery, plastics, colorectal, neurology, orthopaedic, and ophthalmology. M81 caregivers pride themselves on delivering efficient and effective workflow processes to ensure patient discharges are expedited and care is of the highest quality. Because of the variety and complexity of patients cared for, M81 offers caregivers an array of growth and learning opportunities. This unit also has an active unit-based Shared Governance and high caregiver engagement.


A caregiver in this position works 3PM-11:30PM. Every other Saturday.


A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Provide or assist with patient care under the supervision of an RN. Patient care may include vital signs, weight, assisting patients with personal care and activities of daily living, patient transfers/transport, pulse oximetry, point of care testing, dressing changes, applying external monitoring devices and removing urinary Foley catheter.
  • Report abnormal findings or changes in physical, mental and emotional conditions to an RN.
  • Assist with keeping patients’ rooms clean and orderly.


Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross within new hire period (Nursing students required to have BLS prior to hire)
  • One year of recent, full-time patient care experience
  • Additional education/training may substitute for some/all of the stated experience (i.e. mental health experience)
  • Nursing students who have recently completed a minimum of one clinical rotation as part of an accredited nursing school program may substitute the clinical rotation for the required experience
  • Military experience as a Hospital Corpsman (HM), Combat Medic (68W) or Medical Service Technician (4N0X1) will be considered

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires full body motion to move and lift patients, manual finger dexterity with good eye-hand coordination; involves extensive standing and walking.
  • Medium Work - Exerting 50 to 100 pounds of force rarely, and/or 0 to 50 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.
  • Physical Demand requirements are in excess of those for Medium Work.

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

title: Embedded QA Specialist - Subtitle & Narrative (English)
description:
We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.

Founded in 2012 by renowned game developer Chris Roberts, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is one of the largest global independent studios, dedicated to delivering next-generation AAA games. CIG prides itself in thinking outside the box, encouraging creativity and developing ground-breaking technology. CIG believes in raising the bar for the gaming industry and the gaming community as a whole.

About the Role

Every line of dialogue in Star Citizen and Squadron 42 has to land on screen at the right moment, spelled and punctuated exactly as it should be, and accessible to every player. As our embedded Subtitle and Narrative QA Specialist, that’s your job. You’ll work alongside our Narrative, Audio, UI Tech and QA teams to make sure it happens. No previous games QA experience? No problem. If you have a great eye for detail and a love of language, we’ll train you in the rest.

What you’ll do:

  • Test that subtitles trigger, match the spoken line, and time and prioritise correctly across cinematics, ambient scenes and in-game wildlines.
  • Review subtitles and other in-game text (UI, objectives, markers, items text) against Narrative style guidelines.
  • Create closed captions to our agreed standards.
  • Log clear, reproducible bugs (string IDs, build details, capture) and follow them through to closure, with training on our tools, including Jira.
  • Track down issues at source with Narrative, Audio and UI Tech, and suggest process and tooling improvements.
  • Maintain test cases and coverage tracking and report progress to leadership.

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional written English and a sharp eye for spelling, punctuation and consistency.
  • A methodical mindset: you enjoy tracking down exactly why something isn’t right, and explaining it clearly.
  • Organisation and accuracy when working through large volumes of dialogue to deadline.
  • Good communication skills and the confidence to work closely with Narrative, Audio, UI and wider QA teams.
  • An interest in accessibility and why good captions matter to players.
  • A passion for games, especially narrative-driven sim and space games.

Helpful, but not essential:

We’ll provide training, so if you don’t have these yet, don’t let that put you off applying:

  • Experience in games QA, or in subtitling, captioning, proofreading, editing or localisation (games, film or TV).
  • Familiarity with Jira, Perforce or data-driven text systems (string IDs).
  • Knowledge of caption conventions such as reading speed, line length, speaker ID and non-speech audio.
  • Python scripting, or familiarity with recognised captioning standards.


Diversity Statement

CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.

Fraud Statement

We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.

If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info[@]cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.

title: Distinguished Engineer - Systems Architecture
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.


What you’ll be doing …

As a Distinguished Engineer in Network & Technology IT, you will serve as the domain expert in Network Service Assurance. Your primary objective is driving autonomous, intent-driven network operations for global management teams. Key responsibilities include building AI-driven agentic workflows, integrating wireless and wireline surveillance, correlation, and ticketing systems, and incorporating 3rd party tools. You will lead end-to-end program delivery across network engineering and provisioning using legacy and modern solutions, providing thought leadership in ideation and requirements sessions.

You will lead design and development for alarm/event processing, correlation, and automation. Your role encompasses DevSecOps leadership and technology modernization—specifically refactoring legacy workflow, correlation, and automation systems to modern, cloud-native Standard Operating Environment (SOE) standards.

In collaboration with Centralized and Enterprise Architecture teams, you will align on solutions, domain boundaries, and high-level architectural principles. You will partner with development teams in Planning, Engineering, Inventory, and Workflow/Orchestration to align HLDs and API definitions, ensuring timely delivery with cross-functional partners. Key responsibilities include:

  • End-to-End Core Architecture: Architecting end-to-end functionality across core modules (UFM, UWA, SA360/UTP) for key wireline and wireless initiatives (ANO360, Frontier Integration, iEN, Sesame).
  • Workflow Modernization: Leading the modernization of legacy alarm processing, ticketing, and jBPM workflows into scalable, event-driven microservices architectures.
  • API & Resiliency Standards: Defining blueprint patterns and standards to refactor legacy automations into API-driven workflows with high resiliency, observability, and self-healing.
  • Development Execution & Code Quality: Leading development teams to ensure solid code implementation, data integrity, traceability, performance, and resiliency in workflow execution.
  • Executive Leadership & Facilitation: Partnering with Director and VP-level leadership to drive decision-making velocity, facilitate working sessions, and align cross-functional technical teams.
  • Organizational Change Management: Acting as an effective change agent using stakeholder analysis and structured change management techniques.
  • Directional Architecture & Governance: Creating architectural enablers and conducting design reviews to align systems with the Directional Architecture, Standard Operating Environment (SOE), and domain boundaries.
  • Talent Mentorship: Mentoring upcoming architects and development leads in the Service Assurance space.
  • Cross-Functional Technical Guidance: Providing technical guidance to cross-functional teams in crafting solutions and detailing system and process impacts.
  • Mission-Critical Domain Support: Supporting mission- and business-critical applications in Network Systems across provisioning and service qualification domains.
  • Continuous Delivery & Vendor Alignment: Aligning teams to a shared technical direction and partnering with vendors and internal teams to validate assumptions, evaluate options, and build the Continuous Delivery Pipeline.
  • Agile Planning & Solution Definition: Participating in Development Cycle (DC) Planning, System/Solution Demos, Inspect & Adapt events, and exploring high-level solution trade-offs.
