  • Prevent loss and damage by identifying irregularities early and informing violators of policies and procedures.
  • Direct traffic during events, incidents, or peak operational periods as needed.
  • Support team operations during routine duties and emergency situations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Director of Operations Intelligence & Analysis (I&A)
description:

The Director of Operations leads and integrates multiple programs and operational functions to drive operational excellence and business results. This role provides strategic leadership across a portfolio of programs, translating business priorities into actionable plans that drive performance, quality, efficiency, customer satisfaction and sustainable expansion of the portfolio.

The Director oversees program delivery, resource allocation, financial performance, and process improvement initiatives while fostering collaboration across teams. As a key organizational leader, the Director ensures alignment between strategic priorities, growth objectives and operational outcomes, driving accountability and measurable results.

Working closely with senior leaders, program managers, customers, and stakeholders, the Director addresses complex business challenges, identifies opportunities for improvement or expansion, and supports the successful achievement of organizational and growth priorities.


Work Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day, Core hours: 0900-1500

Essential Responsibilities:


Strategic Leadership & Program Oversight

  • Lead a portfolio of programs and operational functions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and successful execution of strategic initiatives and growth objectives.
  • Translate strategic objectives into operational and growth plans, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance measures, and accountability mechanisms to support business objectives and portfolio expansion.
  • Identify operational risks, opportunities, and emerging issues, developing mitigation strategies and action plans, including opportunities for expansion.

Operational Management


  • Direct day-to-day operations across multiple programs, ensuring delivery commitments, quality standards, and performance expectations are met.
  • Monitor operational performance and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, and customer outcomes and support portfolio growth.
  • Lead workforce planning and resource allocation efforts to optimize organizational capacity for current and future growth.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Evaluate operational investments, staffing plans, and business initiatives to support sustainable growth and organizational success including assessment of growth potential.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Build and develop high-performing teams through coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Establish clear goals, expectations, and accountability measures across teams that support growth and operational excellence.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
  • Support succession planning and workforce development initiatives aligned with future portfolio growth.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as a key liaison with executive leadership, customers, and stakeholders, communicating performance, risks, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead complex discussions, negotiations, and decision-making processes while building strong partnerships that drive successful outcomes and create opportunities for expansion.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Analyze operational data and performance trends to identify opportunities for improvement and drive informed decision-making, include growth opportunities.
  • Lead initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, modernize business processes, and promote a culture of innovation and accountability to enable growth and scalability.
  • Build strong partnerships that drive customer satisfaction, retention, and growth of existing business.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Operations, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other relevant leadership certifications.
  • Experience leading organizational integration, transformation, or portfolio growth initiatives.
  • Experience identifying, supporting, or operationalizing new business or expansion opportunities.
  • Experience managing geographically dispersed teams.

title: Assoc Clinical Development Director
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Associate Director, Virology Clinical Development (MD)


The Associate Director, Virology Clinical Development (MD) plays a key role in the clinical development of therapies within the Virology Therapeutic Area. As a physician member of a multidisciplinary development team, this position contributes to the planning, execution, oversight, analysis, and reporting of clinical studies across multiple stages of development.

The role provides scientific and medical expertise to support clinical development strategies, study conduct, regulatory submissions, data interpretation, and scientific communications. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and external stakeholders to help advance innovative treatments for patients with viral diseases.


Location: Foster City, California

This is an on-site, Foster City-based position. The successful candidate must work from the Foster City campus; remote work is not available for this role.


This is an opportunity to contribute to the clinical development of novel therapies for HIV infection in a dynamic, collaborative environment. Working on-site as part of a cross-functional team, you will support the planning, execution, monitoring, and interpretation of clinical studies within the Virology Therapeutic Area. For assigned projects, you will contribute to a range of clinical trial activities, including study protocol development, investigator and study-related documentation, medical monitoring activities, data review and interpretation, study reporting, regulatory submissions, scientific publications, and presentations. This role provides an opportunity to gain broad experience across the clinical development process while helping advance innovative therapies for people with HIV.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides scientific and clinical expertise to cross-functional teams to support clinical development project deliverables and timelines.
  • Contributes to the development and review of clinical trial protocols, clinical study reports, and responses to health authority inquiries.
  • Provides ongoing medical monitoring for clinical trials, including but not limited to assessment of eligibility criteria, toxicity management, and drug safety surveillance.
  • Contributes to the clinical development component(s) in the preparation/review of regulatory documents, investigator brochures, and development plans.
  • Supports the collection, review, and interpretation of clinical data for internal analysis and decision-making.
  • Manages the preparation and/or review of data listings, summary tables, study results, and scientific presentations.
  • Presents scientific and clinical information at investigator meetings, internal forums, and scientific conferences.
  • Adheres to regulatory requirements of study conduct and industry standards of Good Clinical Practice as well as Gilead SOPs.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years with PhD/PharmD

OR

  • 2+ Years with MD in a relevant scientific, medical, or healthcare discipline.
  • Ability and willingness to work on-site at the Foster City, California campus. This position is not eligible for remote work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MD or DO degree preferred, with training and/or experience in HIV medicine, Infectious Diseases, and/or HIV clinical research.
  • Exposure to clinical research through academic, fellowship, investigator-initiated, translational, or industry-sponsored studies is preferred.
  • Interest in HIV clinical drug development and clinical trial design, with a demonstrated desire to develop expertise in these areas.
  • Experience presenting scientific or clinical data through publications, abstracts, posters, presentations, or other scholarly activities is preferred.
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams in academic, clinical, research, or industry settings is preferred.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and apply new concepts in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute across projects as needed.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, as evidenced through clinical practice, research, academic training, or other professional experiences.
  • Foundational understanding of the drug development process and clinical research, or a strong interest and aptitude for learning these areas.
  • Familiarity with FDA and EMA regulations, ICH guidelines, GCP, and standard clinical research principles is preferred but not required.
  • Strong scientific and medical knowledge, with the ability to critically evaluate and interpret clinical and scientific data.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed.
  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees receive the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop, and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

title: [MA] Office-based Medical Affairs Scientist (MAS), Breast Cancer team, Oncology Medical Affairs
description:
MAIN REPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES

JOB POSITION PURPOSE

  • The MAS roles are hybrid in responsibilities. Specific roles in teams can vary between 80% field with 20% head office activity to 80% head office activity with 20% field activity. This is a continuum and not fixed and will vary based on business needs. Rarely there may be a role that is 100% Field.
  • Be the Pfizer Japan medical scientific point of contact for HCPs, medical societies, regulators, academia and other external stakeholders.
  • Play a central role as a scientific and medical leader who can identify unmet medical needs, contribute to building and executing medical plans and establish clinical evidence.

MAIN REPONSIBILITIES:

Demonstrate medical and scientific leadership and expertise

  • Ensure the highest scientific standards during in / external activities to provide deep medical and scientific expertise.
  • Develop local medical plan aligned with global medical plan to address local unmet medical needs and fill data gaps, and contribute to the implementation of local medical strategies and life cycle clinical plans for inline and pipeline medicines / vaccines.
  • Provide and exchange medical/scientific information for/from medical facilities in the assigned area and external stakeholders and make important contributions to decisions of medical strategies for assigned products, to ensure safe, proper, and effective uses of assigned products. These activities contribute to patients and healthcare professionals from medical, pharmaceutical, and clinical study’s perspective.
  • Drive for heightened understanding of the burden of disease in the assigned therapeutic area and medical attributes of our products to enhance the safe and efficacious use.
  • Contribute to achieving the department/team goals, and/or participate in cross-organizational projects as a core member and provide guidance to deliver the results.

Develop and Execute Medical Plan aligned with medical strategy to meet unmet medical needs in the assigned product(s) and therapeutic area(s)

  • Identify unmet medical needs and healthcare disparities in the assigned asset(s) and therapeutic area(s), and execute customer facing medical activities including unbiased medical and scientific communication with HCPs and other relevant individuals and organizations, medical advisory board meetings, educational seminars, and data generation initiatives, medical materials creation and necessary scientific input.
  • Create an activity plan with senior medical management to address unmet needs and data gaps.
  • Develop a Customer Facing part of Medical Plan in the therapeutic area(s) and asset(s) to establish collaborative scientific relationships with stakeholders.
  • Providing subject matter expertise and high-quality scientific exchange, bringing in insights (formally and informally) into the organization to shape strategy.

Collaborate with medical stakeholders’ management as a scientific expert for HCPs, medical societies, academia, etc.

  • Establish a strong collaborative scientific relationship through non-promotional activities such as scientific exchanges (e.g., discussion using the latest research papers and follow-up of contents of academic conference presentations) with relevant stakeholders in the assigned area.
  • Maintain a comprehensive stakeholder map to identify relevant HCPs, medical societies, and other relevant external stakeholders. And to communicate effectively and agilely at an expert level.
  • Follow up clinical investigator-sponsored research and medical grants compliant with Pfizer policies.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Acquire and maintain extensive, up-to-date medical and pharmaceutical information in the assigned area to identify unmet needs and support medical strategy.
  • Deliver key medical and scientific activities within the medical plan, e.g., high-quality educational materials, generation of real-world evidence, non-interventional studies, database studies and registries (in collaboration with the Health & Value team) and ensure timely publication of data.

Establish a highly reliable, long-term relationship with stakeholders

  • Enhance opportunities for creation of evidence based on medical needs by sharing customer insights with internal/external stakeholders through constructive and cross-functional partnership.
  • Optimize patient centricity of medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus.
  • Establish deep and enduring peer-to-peer scientific relationships with leading HCPs and specialists, including non-traditional partners and key decision makers.
  • Maintain and enhance the cross-BU alignment on metrics.
  • Ensure to collect necessary information and analyze insights prior to the meetings to provide deep medical and scientific expertise to stakeholders and HCPs.

Aligns, contributes, and collaborates with Relevant internal stakeholders

  • Provide information on expert / HCP / relevant feedback on product life cycle strategies to related divisions/department in the company.
  • Share the medical/scientific information & insights within appropriate limits/ways for Marketing colleagues to develop brand plan(s).
  • Scientific input for scientific meetings and materials
  • Provide medical education programs with medical societies or relevant stakeholders.

Collaboration in clinical development

  • Provide medical/scientific input into protocol feasibility assessments for clinical trial proposals.
  • Collaborate with Development Japan (DJ)/global development to identify appropriate investigators / sites for Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Work together with clinical research/DJ colleagues and in collaboration with above country and global BU colleagues to drive the timely completion of Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Demonstrate scientific / medical leadership and provide input into the global clinical teams and DJ to ensure design and selection of trials relevant to Japan’s needs, leveraging customer and patient insights Supporting DJ on clinical development program as well as regulatory interactions from early development phase.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of product(s)/therapeutic area(s) medical strategy and delivering medical and scientific advice both internally and externally to assure appropriate use of product(s) and patient’s safety aligned with the short- and long-term business goals of assigned product(s)/therapeutic area(s).

Data communication and customer insights

  • Provide accurate, high-quality, and unbiased medical information to HCPs and external experts, including managing unsolicited medical requests (UMRs).
  • Provide scientific insight and support to field- and head office based commercial colleagues.
  • Collaborate with the cross functional team in-country and above-country to develop impactful and compliant promotional and non-promotional materials of value to customers.
  • Collect and share insights from HCPs and stakeholders to inform medical strategy and business opportunities.
  • Manage local advisory boards to gain customer insights.
  • If media-trained, present the scientific perspective on selected topics during media-briefings.

Observe the code of conduct, company’s regulations, and compliance, make communication with related departments, and exercise leadership in POJ.

  • Ensure awareness of code of contact for Medical Affairs (guidance for external medical interactions) and observe it. Give promotional or non-promotional explanations depending on the related departments.
  • Conduct activities in compliance with the MHLW Guidelines for Prescription Drug Sales Information Activities.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Ensure activities and communications are conducted in compliance with all policies, guidelines, and regulations.

Ensure awareness of responsibility for reporting adverse events

  • For all Pfizer products, observe applicable laws/regulations and the Pfizer policy, and “Gather and report safety information*.” At an appropriate time, attend training programs on obligation of assigned safety reporting.

AS NEEDED:

  • Contribute to Business Development in the assigned area(s): In collaboration with Japan Medical Lead, Japan Medical Product Lead, Global MA members and other members from relevant functions, identify unmet medical needs and candidate therapies for potential medical interventions in the assigned therapeutic area(s) in Japan through medical activities such as advisory boards and consultations with medical experts while keeping confidentiality.
  • Rapidly respond to critical supply issues from a medical perspective (e.g., rapid communications with academic societies and regulatory authorities).

REQUIRED SKILL SET

Education:

Minimum requirement

  • 4-year university undergraduate degree AND master’s degree in life science, or
  • Pharmacists
    • 4-year university graduates with pharmacist license and master’s degree or equivalent life science research experience, or
    • 6-year university graduates with pharmacist license, or
  • Nurses with a master’s degree, or
  • Veterinarians, or
  • Dentists, or
  • MDs

Preferred

  • In addition to those who meet the minimum requirementsabove, the qualifications below are preferred.
  • MD (clinical experience, board certification preferred), or
  • PhD in Life Science

Technical Skills:

  • Medical/ pharmaceutical expert knowledge of therapeutic disease area/ products
  • Ability to communicate appropriately and build good relationships with internal/external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively with teams and across functions by demonstrating Pfizer’s Values & Behaviors and the agility to learn from others.
  • Capable of medical discussion with relevant departments and external HCPs.
  • A person who understands compliance and relevant laws/regulations in the pharmaceutical industry and advocates the appropriate use of the products.
  • Can demonstrate appropriate knowledge and understanding of internal organization structure, key stakeholders and strategies.
  • A person who can quickly acquire necessary medical/ scientific knowledge and skills through self-learning.

Experience:

  • MA/DJ experience and / or research experience preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Scientific publication experience preferred.

Language:

  • Able to understand written and spoken English and Japanese in assigned therapeutic disease area, and scientific interactions.
  • Minimum TOEIC score of 730

title: Senior Director, Global Diagnostics
description:
At AstraZeneca, we turn ideas into life-changing medicines. Working here means being entrepreneurial, thinking big, and working together to make the impossible a reality. We are committed to leading a revolution in oncology and beyond, seeking to redefine patient care and address unmet needs around the world. Through relentless innovation and our diverse portfolio, we are setting new standards for what science can achieve in the clinic and commercial marketplace alike.


AstraZeneca is more than one of the world’s leading biopharmaceutical companies—we are united in our dedication to make a meaningful difference to patients, healthcare, and society. With a culture that champions diversity, inclusion, and collaboration, AstraZeneca is a place where people are empowered to continuously learn, grow, and shape the future of healthcare.

We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. Director, Global Diagnostics for ETCAMAH to join our Global Diagnostics commercial team. This pivotal role helps channel our scientific capabilities to generate a positive impact and improve patients’ lives. As a Sr. Director, Global Diagnostics, you will lead commercial activities for diagnostics across key indications and launch brands, with a particular focus on ETCAMAH and other breast indications, while also providing biomarker and diagnostics expertise to help shape the breast tumor strategy. In this role, you will collaborate across multiple functions and geographies to ensure best-in-class diagnostics capabilities aligned to commercial and patient needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of the integrated global diagnostics strategy for breast indications, ensuring alignment with franchise brand plans and commercial objectives.
  • Drive the creation and implementation of commercialization and marketing plans for each diagnostic, focused on launch readiness, growth, and maximizing patient impact.
  • Collaborate closely with franchise commercial teams, medical affairs, R&D, insights & analytics, market access, and local market affiliates to coordinate and optimize diagnostic initiatives globally.
  • Build and nurture partnerships with external oncology stakeholders, including patient advocacy and policy groups, diagnostic developers, key opinion leaders, and HTA/payer organizations to enhance diagnostics capabilities and value proposition.
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership to address challenges and opportunities in biomarker testing adoption, patient journeys, and the diagnostic sample testing pathway.
  • Enable markets to develop and execute effective strategies to drive awareness, adoption, access, availability, and accuracy of biomarker testing that inform and improve patient treatment.
  • Gather and leverage internal and external insights to inform strategy, monitor performance, and adjust tactics to maximize effectiveness and impact.

title: Databricks Solutions Architect Senior Manager
description:
JOB REQUISITION

Databricks Solutions Architect Senior Manager

LOCATION

MINNEAPOLIS

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

JOB DESCRIPTION

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Consulting Senior Manager to join our growing Enterprise Data & Analytics team.

.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Manager, you’ll partner with our clients to identify and manage risk. You'll develop strategies to solve complex business problems using new ways of thinking, and devise solutions to support your clients' needs through using the latest tools and methods. You’ll develop lasting relationships with client personnel and further these relationships through quality product delivery. You’ll foster a network within the business community and serve as an ambassador of Protiviti in the market. You will also be a mentor and provide performance development to teams as you oversee the successful completion of project work plans.

What Will Help You Be Successful

  • You enjoy designing and delivering modern data engineering solutions with Databricks.
  • You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to data architecture and engineering, including the latest trends and developments with Databricks.
  • You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing exceptional experiences.
  • You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.
  • You promote a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.
  • You create development opportunities for others, including participating in the creation and rollout of training, and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.
  • You have interest in contributing to the preparation of client proposals and strategies to win new business.
  • You excel at identifying opportunities to integrate product solutions and resources to improve client service capabilities.
  • You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

You demonstrate Leadership & Management capabilities through the following:

  • You care about the success and well-being of both your clients and colleagues.
  • You collaborate by creating a team environment where everyone feels that they are valued, welcomed, and can contribute their ideas.
  • You deliver and earn the trust of your clients and colleagues by building best-in-class solutions and managing deliverables.

You have experience with many and familiarity with most of the following Concepts and Methodologies:

  • Ability to articulate the value of Databricks capabilities to customers and colleagues, and proven track record of data storytelling to guide decision-making.
  • Participation in the process of formulating, communicating, and executing data strategies that align with organizational goals and objectives leveraging Databricks and relevant technologies.
  • Experience in assessing existing data solutions, whether on-premises or in the cloud, to inform improvement initiatives.
  • Advanced skills in architecting future state data solutions using Well-Architected Frameworks aligned to Databricks.
  • Experience in planning and migrating data solutions from various sources, including on-premises, other cloud platforms, or legacy systems, to Databricks.
  • Highly proficient with implementing ETL processes and databases using either Databricks or complimentary solutions.
  • Significant experience optimizing existing data implementations, including pipelines, queries, and data models, to enhance performance and delivery of value to the business.
  • Knowledge of administering and maintaining data solutions to ensure stability, security, scalability, and affordability.
  • Highly proficient in data engineering, including data movement, data integration, transformation, and cleansing.
  • Ability to lead designing, managing, and optimizing data warehousing / modern data platform.
  • Highly skilled in data modeling, including entity-relationship diagrams, dimensional modeling, and semantic modeling.
  • Ability to perform data analytics, including exploratory data analysis and leveraging data for actionable insights.
  • Experience with implementing data governance frameworks and policies, including an understanding of managing data assets using Unity Catalog.
  • Understanding of data security practices, including encryption and access control.
  • Knowledge of networking as it applies to configuring Databricks on-prem or within cloud solutions.
  • Understanding of DevOps or DataOps concepts and experience with the deployment of Databricks solutions.
  • Expert in SQL and Spark (PySpark & Spark SQL) and bonus for familiarity with any of the programming languages such as C#, Java, Scala, R, DAX, MDX, or M.
  • Bonus: Experience with Data Science and/or Machine Learning.

Competency with at least 3 and exposure to most of these technologies:

  • Databricks Lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Unity Catalog governance, lineage, access controls, and data sharing
  • Apache Spark development using PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake
  • Data engineering with Auto Loader, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, and workflow orchestration
  • Databricks Asset Bundles, Git integration, CI/CD, and environment promotion
  • Databricks SQL, serverless compute, query optimization, and performance tuning
  • Bonus: Mosaic AI, MLflow, model serving, and generative AI capabilities
  • Evaluating, summarizing, organizing, and interpreting data.
  • Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network, including with senior executives.
  • Successfully pursuing business development opportunities and identifying and implementing strategies to obtain new work or clientele.
  • Ability to translate and communicate issues, risk, or challenges to client personnel, including executives.
  • Leadership and direct supervisory experience of teams including conducting performance appraisals, mentoring and coaching, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.

Your Educational and Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., MIS, CIS, Analytics)
  • 7+ years working in in professional services or related industry.
  • Professional Certification
  • Required: Professional Databricks certification (Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional)
  • Preferred: Databricks Champion.

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

-

title: Medical Science Liaison Rhinology - Southeast
description:
Job title: Medical Science Liaison Rhinology - Southeast

  • Location: Remote, US

About the job


The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-facing role that serves as a trusted scientific partner to key external experts, conducting frequent scientific exchanges to enhance understanding of Sanofi's products. The MSL executes stakeholder engagement plans to gather insights that inform medical strategies and future research, while staying current on therapeutic developments to identify research opportunities and support evidence generation.


This role involves recognizing and sharing insights about patient and healthcare provider needs, maintaining effective communication with internal stakeholders across Medical Affairs and Commercial Operations, and ensuring full compliance with company, industry, legal, and regulatory requirements through excellent governance and risk management.


Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main Responsibilities:


1. Scientific Engagement: Conduct one-on-one and group interactions with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare stakeholders, sharing medical/scientific information about products and disease management within regulatory guidelines.

2. Stakeholder Mapping & Strategy: Identify, profile, and prioritize ~50 stakeholders using the Scientific Engagement Model; develop territory and individual engagement plans aligned with Medical Affairs strategy.

3. Relationship Building: Establish long-term peer relationships with KOLs, payers, and HCPs by demonstrating strong clinical knowledge and articulating the medical value of Sanofi products.

4. Congress & Event Presence: Attend scientific congresses, symposia, and organize educational meetings or advisory boards to establish Sanofi's medical presence in the field.

5. Medical Information Support: Respond to unsolicited requests for medical information on products and disease states; support speaker training for continued scientific education.

6. Insight Generation: Gather feedback from stakeholder interactions, critically evaluate published studies, and report insights that inform Sanofi's medical strategies, messages, and product development.

7. Internal Collaboration: Share scientific information and external insights with Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and other internal teams while ensuring compliance with company and regulatory policies.

8. Evidence Generation Support: Identify clinical trial sites, monitor disease epidemiology, support protocol development, and facilitate investigator-sponsored study (ISS) submissions through approved processes.

9. Healthcare Policy Awareness: Understand healthcare policies, guidelines, and clinical practices at local, state, and national levels as they relate to the therapeutic area.

10. Independent Operation & Compliance: Work remotely with minimal supervision, travel nationally/internationally as needed, and maintain strict regulatory boundaries between non-promotional medical activities and commercial operations.

About you

Basic Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in a technical, scientific or medical field (MD, PhD, Pharm D preferred) or other Relevant Life Science degree (RN/MS/PA/NP)
  • Must reside in territory. This position will cover the West territory— currently including Florida, Alabama, Georgia, Mississippi, Louisiana, Tennessee, and South Carolina (subject to change). Candidate must live within the territory near a major airport with flight availably to adequately cover the territory and necessary travel.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry, Medical Science Liaison role, or relevant clinical practice. Additional years of experience are an asset. MSL experience strongly preferred.
  • Candidates with relevant Immunology clinical experience consisting of Rhinology, Otolaryngology and/or Allergy may be considered.
  • Clear understanding of medical practice, clinical decision making, and healthcare systems related to patient care.
  • Ability to interpret key scientific data and translate this information to meet educational and research needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to address educational and research needs through delivery of cutting edge scientific/evidenced based data.
  • Understand the design and execution of research studies.
  • Exemplary communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working on multi-disciplinary teams and managing significant volume of projects.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and ability to pass a complete background check.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Patient Journey Partner - Hema & Hemo
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.


Key Responsibilities


  • The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
  • Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
  • Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
  • Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
  • By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
  • The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
  • Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and service.

Roche Mandatory Responsibilities


  • Respects and implements the values of the company: Integrity, Courage and Passion.
  • Complies, along with the team, with all Roche Corporate Business principles, Code of Conduct, policies and practices.
  • Maintains awareness of the company’s requirements to fully report adverse events and other reportable drug safety and product complain information.

Mindset & Behaviors


The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

  • Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys
  • Mindset:
    • Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
    • Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
    • Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
    • Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine)
  • Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling.

Who You Are


Experience:

  • System thinker and deep listener
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience partnering with PAGs is highly desired.
  • Experience leading Cross-functional team is required. Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired.
  • Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence
  • Able to understand and leverage digital means and tools is desired

Knowledge:

  • Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.
  • Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions
  • Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

Other relevant capabilities:

  • Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired and the local language fluency
  • Business travel availability
  • Driving license, B category, mandatory

Preferred Qualifications:

  • University degree
  • An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.
  • Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Position Type

Administrator

Shape the Future of Enrollment at Dallas College

Dallas College seeks a strategic, digitally fluent enrollment leader to serve as the Associate Vice Chancellor, Enterprise Strategic Enrollment and Digital Growth.


This senior leadership position will build and scale an integrated enterprise approach spanning recruitment, admissions, financial aid, records, registration, onboarding, outreach, prior learning assessment, and the overall student enrollment experience.


Reporting to the Vice Chancellor of Student Success, the Associate Vice Chancellor will connect enrollment strategy, student success, analytics, digital growth, and technology-enabled enrollment pathways. This leader will modernize systems and digital channels, strengthen yield and student engagement, reduce administrative barriers, and help create a coordinated, mobile-first, student-centered enrollment enterprise.


Why This Role Matters

The Associate Vice Chancellor will have the opportunity to:

  • Build a comprehensive, multi-year enrollment strategy aligned with Dallas College priorities, workforce needs, student success goals, and long-term demographic trends.
  • Strengthen the full enrollment journey, from prospecting and recruitment through admissions, financial aid, registration, onboarding, and ongoing service touchpoints.
  • Use forecasting, predictive modeling, dashboards, and performance metrics to turn enrollment data into clear decisions and accountable action.
  • Modernize customer relationship management platforms, marketing automation, analytics, AI-enabled personalization, chatbots, behavioral tracking, and digital engagement capabilities.
  • Design local, regional, national, online, and global growth strategies while advancing access, persistence, completion, transfer, workforce alignment, and equitable outcomes.
  • Lead through partnership across Student Success, Academic Affairs, Workforce Education, Marketing, Information Technology, Finance, campus leadership, and other institutional teams.

The Leadership Impact


Enterprise Enrollment Strategy

Create coordinated enrollment plans, forecasts, goals, operating models, and accountability routines that move strategy into execution.

Digital Growth and Modernization

Advance technology-enabled, mobile-first enrollment pathways and integrated prospect engagement across channels and markets.

Student Experience and Success

Remove avoidable barriers, improve responsiveness, strengthen onboarding, and protect the enrollment funnel from unnecessary attrition.

People and Partnerships

Develop high-performing teams and align stakeholders around shared enrollment outcomes within a complex, highly matrixed institution.


The successful candidate will bring enterprise enrollment leadership, strong operational discipline, analytical depth, digital fluency, and a student-centered approach.


This leader will be able to translate complex enrollment trends into practical recommendations, influence across shared governance and distributed operations, build trust with diverse stakeholders, and guide teams with clarity, empathy, accountability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.


Position / Job Summary

The Associate Vice Chancellor, Enterprise Strategic Enrollment and Digital Growth is a senior leadership role responsible for creating, leading, and scaling an enterprise enrollment strategy that integrates student success, digital growth, recruitment operations, analytics, and technology-enabled enrollment pathways for Dallas College. Reporting to the Vice Chancellor of Student Success, this position provides enterprise leadership for recruitment, admissions, records, registration, financial aid, onboarding, outreach, prior learning assessment, and student enrollment experience while modernizing the systems, digital channels, and automated prospecting infrastructure that support sustainable growth. The role ensures enterprise-wide alignment and coordination across divisions, and functional areas so that enrollment strategies, investments, policies, systems, and services advance the institution’s strategic goals and priorities. The role develops and implements multi-year and annual enrollment plans, advances data-informed and predictive strategies, strengthens yield and student engagement, reduces administrative barriers, and ensures enrollment-related policies, practices, systems, communications, and services operate as a coordinated, mobile-first, student-centered enterprise. The ideal leader brings high energy, strategic digital fluency, a strong understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation, AI-enabled personalization, online learning, and global acquisition models, and the ability to be a results-oriented, accountable, empathetic, and trusted thought partner across a highly matrixed and complex institution such as Dallas College.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and oversee a comprehensive multi-year and annual enterprise enrollment management plan aligned with Dallas College priorities, student success goals, workforce needs, and long-term demographic trends.
  • Lead integrated strategies across recruitment, admissions, records, registration, financial aid, onboarding, outreach, Welcome Center operations, prior learning assessment, and related enrollment functions.
  • Develop annual admissions and financial aid forecasts, predictive models, enrollment goals, operational plans, and budgets; use data to monitor progress, evaluate effectiveness, and hold teams accountable for results.
  • Establish strict governance over key enrollment growth metrics, including Student Acquisition Cost, lead-to-enrollment velocity, yield conversion rates, funnel progression, and related performance indicators.
  • Identify target audiences and design creative recruitment, yield, and engagement strategies for local, regional, national, online, and global student populations.
  • Develop and deploy a multi-channel enrollment growth strategy that aligns digital marketing, outreach, recruitment, communications, and student success interventions across local, regional, national, online, and global markets.
  • Collaborate in the development and launch of global acquisition funnels that rapidly scale out-of-state, international, and online student segments while supporting Dallas College enrollment growth priorities.
  • Partner with Marketing, Academic Affairs, Workforce Education, Student Success, Information Technology, Finance, and other stakeholders to establish enterprise-wide alignment and coordination; integrate priorities, resources, campaigns, communications, services, and student pathways; and ensure enrollment initiatives advance Dallas College’s strategic goals and priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Academic Affairs, Workforce, Operations, External Affairs, and other institutional teams to ensure digital onboarding improves first-year persistence rates and protects the enrollment funnel from avoidable attrition.
  • Leverage current and emerging technologies, enrollment systems, digital media, automation, analytics, and online engagement strategies to communicate with students, families, secondary school partners, community organizations, and other audiences.
  • Oversee the modernization and integration of enterprise customer relationship management platforms, including Salesforce or comparable systems, modern marketing automation platforms, and predictive analytics tools to build an automated prospecting and student engagement engine.
  • Eradicate administrative barriers by engineering a rapid, mobile-first, and algorithmically optimized application and onboarding pathway that simplifies the student experience from prospect through enrollment.
  • Integrate AI-driven personalization tools, chatbots, behavioral tracking, and digital engagement strategies into the enrollment funnel to optimize recruitment operations, improve responsiveness, and support prospective students 24/7.
  • Evaluate and improve the end-to-end student enrollment experience to ensure timely, accurate, inclusive, and positive engagement through admissions, financial aid, registration, onboarding, and ongoing service touchpoints.
  • Advance enrollment strategies that support access, persistence, completion, transfer, workforce alignment, net tuition revenue optimization, and equitable outcomes across Dallas College’s diverse student communities.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to executive and institutional leaders, offering clear analysis, recommendations, scenario planning, and operational guidance on enrollment opportunities, risks, and performance.
  • Lead, coach, and develop enrollment teams; establish clear priorities, service standards, accountability routines, performance expectations, and a culture of collaboration, empathy, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Required Dallas College Professional Development Hours per Academic Year.
  • All employees are required to complete a minimum of 19 hours.
  • People leaders are required an additional 16 hours of leadership development.
  • Perform other duties not listed as assigned.

Minimum and Preferred – Education, Experience, and/or Certifications

Required Qualifications for Role

  • Master’s degree required in higher education administration, student affairs, business administration, public administration, educational leadership, or a closely related field as confirmed by official transcripts.
  • Eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in higher education enrollment management, student success, admissions, financial aid, recruitment, records, registration, or related student services leadership.
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing comprehensive enrollment management strategies, achieving enrollment goals, strengthening yield, and improving the student enrollment experience.
  • Demonstrated experience using data, forecasting, predictive modeling, enrollment systems, and analytics to inform strategy, evaluate outcomes, and drive accountability.
  • Experience leading teams and collaborating across complex, highly matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders, shared governance, distributed operations, and institution-wide service expectations, with demonstrated success coordinating enterprise priorities and aligning cross-functional work with institutional strategic goals.
  • Strong understanding of technology-enabled enrollment services, digital engagement, online learning environments, and the use of emerging technologies to improve student access, communication, and service delivery.
  • Experience leading or supporting CRM modernization, marketing automation, digital funnel optimization, AI-enabled personalization, chatbot deployment, behavioral tracking, or comparable technology-enabled enrollment growth initiatives.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and executive communication skills, with demonstrated ability to build trust, influence decisions, communicate with clarity, and inspire collaboration across diverse stakeholder groups.

Preferred Qualifications for Role

  • Earned doctorate preferred.
  • Community college or large multi-campus higher education leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience serving local, national, international, online, adult, first-generation, transfer, workforce, and other diverse student populations preferred.
  • Experience developing digital acquisition funnels, enrollment campaigns, or growth strategies for out-of-state, international, online, adult, first-generation, transfer, workforce, and other diverse student populations preferred.
  • Official transcripts required.
  • Bilingual or multilingual preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven success in enrollment management strategy, including strategic thinking in planning, implementation, goal attainment, recruitment, admissions, financial aid, registration, yield, and student engagement.
  • High-energy, results-oriented leadership style with demonstrated accountability for outcomes, sound judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to move priorities from strategy to execution.
  • Strong understanding of enrollment systems, student information systems, digital media strategies, online learning environments, emerging technologies, automation, and technology-enabled student service models.
  • Advanced knowledge of CRM platforms, marketing automation, predictive analytics, AI-driven personalization, chatbots, behavioral tracking, and digital funnel management to strengthen prospect conversion and student engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data, predictive modeling, metrics, dashboards, and analysis to assess policy and practice effectiveness, identify opportunities, improve processes, and strengthen institutional accountability.
  • Ability to govern and interpret enrollment growth metrics, including Student Acquisition Cost, lead-to-enrollment velocity, yield conversion, first-year persistence, funnel attrition, and related indicators of enrollment effectiveness.
  • Ability to develop creative, sustainable recruitment and enrollment strategies that respond to demographic shifts and engage students across local, national, international, online, and workforce markets.
  • Demonstrated empathy, cultural competence, and student-centered commitment to serving diverse and global student populations with clarity, care, responsiveness, and respect.
  • Ability to navigate and lead effectively in a highly matrixed and complex organization; build coalitions; clarify accountability; influence without direct authority; coordinate priorities, resources, systems, and services enterprise-wide; and align stakeholders around shared enrollment outcomes and Dallas College’s strategic goals and priorities.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to communicate with clarity, candor, transparency, and frequency while serving as a compelling spokesperson for Dallas College.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted thought partner to institutional leaders by translating enrollment trends, risks, opportunities, and operational realities into sound recommendations and actionable decisions.

Competencies

Dallas College seeks to identify core and professional competencies for each role and level which helps define the level of expertise needed and desired to demonstrate success in the role.

  • Strategic Leadership & Vision
  • Talent Development & Succession Planning
  • Results Orientation & Accountability
  • Change Leadership & Innovation
  • Data-Driven Decision-Making
  • Collaboration & Enterprise Influence
  • Executive Communication & Presence
  • Inclusive Leadership & Employee Engagement
  • Operational Excellence & Resource Stewardship
  • Strategic Judgment & Problem-Solving

Normal physical job functions performed within a standard office environment. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to individuals with physical challenges to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.

title: Audit - Mid Market - School Leaver - Milton Keynes - September 2027
description:

See how businesses really work and make an impact from day one.

Adaptable, motivated and eager to learn.
Ready to study towards a professional qualification alongside your role.

title: Brokerage Coordinator

description:
Kipling EMEA/Global is looking for an exceptional Designer on a six-month temporary contract to join our Design team based in Antwerp, Belgium.

At Kipling we are on a mission. To live a vibrant and colourful life, go to places we’ve never been before. Be curious. Dare to live the life we’ve always wanted. That’s our mission and influences everything we do. At Kipling we empower you to go your own way. Diversity makes us stronger and at Kipling we do believe your story matters, this is why we welcome all backgrounds.

We lighten your step, powering your curiosity to go your own way. #LiveLight

Let’s talk about the role!

You as Designer will design forward thinking commercial products reflecting the brand purpose, and creative vision, through your own designs and with creative designer collaborations.

As Designer you will be building the design directions each season alongside other team members. You will be responsible for designing seasonal collections for mainline and back to school collection.

Working closely with European Product Development, Asia Product Sourcing and Product Management teams you will steer your projects through the GTM milestones and deadlines.


How You Will Make a Difference

You will achieve this by:

  • Conceptualize designs that reflect the trends, but also reflect the integrity and aesthetic of the Kipling brand.
  • Sketch concept ideas to show quick results and speed up the process.
  • Contribute to the organisation of seasonal collection presentations.
  • Work closely with the head of design and the cross-functional design team.

  • Work closely with our Asian product developers on sourcing and sample making

To succeed as a Designer, you must manage your own design initiatives and the Design creatives for collaborations. This requires both a creative discipline as well as an ability to manage external relationships.

You should be creative and manage creative relationships, with:

  • An expertise in creative product design and how to build a season theme and prints.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Experience with the back-to-school market and graphic design is a plus.

A formal education and subsequent master’s degree in design or Product Design are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience.

What’s in it For You

We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity

As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Azenta Inc.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity

Job Title

Senior Software Engineer

Job Description

How You’ll Add Value:


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions across cloud-native microservices, data platforms, AI-enabled applications, and integration services. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Quality, DevOps, UX, and Business stakeholders to translate business requirements into enterprise-grade software solutions.


You will play a critical role in building Azenta's next-generation Informatics platform by:


  • Designing and delivering scalable cloud-native software solutions
  • Building highly available, secure, and compliant enterprise applications
  • Accelerating software delivery through modern DevSecOps and AI-assisted development practices
  • Driving engineering excellence through architecture, code quality, automation, and observability
  • Supporting innovation in AI-enabled workflows, analytics, and decision-support capabilities
  • Mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across the platform
  • Helping establish the long-term engineering foundation for the LIMS platform

What You’ll Do:


Software Engineering & Architecture:


  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise-scale software solutions
  • Contribute to application architecture, platform architecture, and technical roadmap planning
  • Develop cloud-native services using modern microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Create reusable frameworks, services, APIs, and platform components
  • Design highly available and resilient systems capable of supporting large-scale sample and laboratory data workloads
  • Participate in architecture reviews and technical design sessions

Platform & Cloud Engineering:


  • Build and operate applications within AWS cloud environments
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tooling
  • Implement containerized workloads using Kubernetes and container technologies
  • Contribute to system scalability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, and operational readiness
  • Implement platform monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions

AI & Data Engineering:


  • Develop AI-enabled platform capabilities including intelligent search, recommendations, workflow automation, analytics, and natural language interfaces
  • Collaborate with data and AI teams to integrate machine learning and generative AI services
  • Design scalable data processing and integration workflows
  • Support development of knowledge management and retrieval capabilities

Product Development:


  • Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, estimation, and planning activities
  • Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, architects, and UX designers
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Participate in software release planning and post-release support activities
  • Support product validation and customer-focused development efforts

Quality & DevSecOps:


  • Champion engineering best practices across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Implement automated testing strategies including unit, integration, performance, and regression testing
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
  • Support CI/CD pipeline implementation and optimization
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, audit, and quality requirements
  • Promote secure coding standards and DevSecOps practices

Leadership & Collaboration:


  • Lead technical initiatives and complex development efforts
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance across teams
  • Work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and engineering standards
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption where appropriate


What You Will Bring:


Required Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience developing enterprise applications, including experience with SaaS/cloud-native solutions, Agile development, and the full Software Development Lifecycle

Technical Expertise:


  • Strong proficiency in Java with experience in React/TypeScript and/or Python
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise applications using microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and third-party system integrations
  • Strong experience with AWS and modern cloud/platform engineering practices, including Kubernetes/Docker, Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD
  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including data modeling, design, optimization, and performance tuning
  • Experience with modern DevSecOps practices, including automated testing, code quality, monitoring/observability, and secure software development
  • Experience developing or integrating AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation capabilities
  • Knowledge of relevant interoperability standards and frameworks such as REST, OpenAPI, HL7, and FHIR

Core Competencies:


  • Strong architecture, system design, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction and engineering standards
  • Ability to balance business priorities, technical excellence, and competing demands

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with LIMS, biobanking, laboratory, or scientific software, including laboratory instrument integration
  • Experience within Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Healthcare, Diagnostics, or Clinical Research
  • Experience supporting regulated environments such as GxP, FDA, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, or SOC 2
  • Knowledge of bioinformatics, genomics, sample management, or scientific workflows
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms or participating in large-scale modernization/digital transformation initiatives
  • Experience with AI-enabled capabilities such as intelligent search, knowledge retrieval, natural language interfaces, or workflow automation

Your Working Conditions:


  • General office setting
  • This position qualifies for a hybrid schedule - 4 days in-office,1 day working remote

title: Project Design Manager
description:
Job Title

Project Design Manager

Job Description Summary

The FM Project Design Manager serves as the primary design representative supporting a client Design Leader for facilities-related capital improvement and renovation projects across an existing restaurant portfolio. This role is responsible for managing a high volume of concurrent projects while providing design oversight, consultant coordination, stakeholder engagement, and strategic guidance to ensure projects align with brand standards, operational requirements, and long-term asset objectives. A successful candidate is highly organized, client-focused, and able to effectively balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while delivering exceptional project outcomes.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary design contact for facilities management projects, providing architectural and interior design guidance for existing restaurant environments.
  • Ensure consistent application of client design standards, brand image requirements, and operational design principles across renovation, refresh, and capital improvement projects.
  • Evaluate existing conditions and develop design solutions that enhance functionality, guest experience, and operational efficiency while preserving brand integrity.
  • Review and approve design deliverables for compliance with established design guidelines, facility standards, and project objectives.
  • Lead multiple facilities-related design projects simultaneously.
  • Develop and manage project schedules, scopes, and key milestones to ensure successful delivery.
  • Identify project risks, constraints, and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies to maintain overall project performance.
  • Monitor design progress and coordinate project activities to ensure alignment between stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
  • Manage relationships with architects, engineers, specialty consultants, contractors, and furniture/equipment vendors.
  • Oversee consultant performance, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to project schedules and budget requirements.
  • Review consultant drawings, specifications, and construction documents for completeness, code compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Facilitate collaboration among cross-functional project teams to achieve project goals and business objectives.
  • Review permit comments and work with design consultants to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Support construction activities through design clarification, issue resolution, site reviews, and coordination of project modifications.
  • Partner with construction teams to ensure design intent is maintained throughout project execution.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and key decisions to leadership and project teams.
  • Facilitate design reviews, working sessions, and stakeholder presentations to drive alignment and informed decision-making.
  • Foster strong partnerships across internal and external teams to support successful project outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve facility performance, operational effectiveness, and project delivery processes.
  • Leverage lessons learned and industry best practices to enhance design standards and facilities management initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development of future-focused design solutions that support evolving operational, maintenance, and brand requirements.
  • Support strategic planning efforts related to restaurant reinvestment, modernization, and long-term asset management.
  • Manage a high volume of concurrent projects and client requests across a diverse portfolio, effectively balancing competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and schedule commitments.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, building strong relationships through proactive communication, sound judgment, and consistent delivery of project objectives.
  • Demonstrate urgency and accountability in driving projects forward, identifying obstacles early and coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve timely resolution.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/ Engineering/Interior Design and/or Construction Management.
  • 5 years’ + experience in design, construction and project management, preferably in the restaurant industry
  • Strong knowledge of architecture design and operations, construction principles and understanding of generally applicable laws and regulations with respect to restaurants and public use buildings
  • Strong presentation and organizational skills
  • Multi-discipline design team management experience
  • Reasonable computer application skills in AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, Office, Outlook, etc.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and ability to convey design concepts and goals
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast moving environments and adapting to evolving standards and site constraints.
  • Self-motivated, ambitious professional with a strong work ethic and a proven ability to take ownership of responsibilities and deliver results.
  • Results-driven individual who effectively prioritizes tasks, manages competing deadlines, and remains focused on delivering successful project outcomes while maintaining high standards of quality.
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume workload consisting of multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, and competing business priorities.
  • Experience serving in a client-facing role with responsibility for building relationships, influencing decisions, and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • Exceptional prioritization, organization, and time-management skills with the ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and drive results with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
