title: Senior Engineer - Electrical & Electronics Product & Process Technologies
description:
Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.

What we offer:

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

Group Summary:

Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.

Job Responsibilities:

Magna's Advanced Product & Process Technologies (APPT) team is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Engineer – Electrical & Electronics Product and Process Technologies to support the development, evaluation, and industrialization of next-generation automotive electrical and electronic systems.


This role bridges advanced product development and manufacturing process innovation, with a focus on automotive electrical and electronic (EE) architectures, powertrain electronics, battery systems, electric motors, embedded systems, and electronics manufacturing technologies. Successful candidate will contribute across the technology lifecycle, from concept development and simulation through prototyping, manufacturing process development, industrialization, and technology transfer.

The ideal candidate combines strong electrical and electronic engineering expertise with practical experience in design for manufacturing, manufacturing process development, product industrialization, and advanced manufacturing technologies.


Duties / Responsibilities:

Design for Manufacturing & Industrialization

  • Lead and support Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Test (DFT) activities throughout product development.
  • Improve manufacturability, quality, reliability, testability, scalability, and cost efficiency of electrical and electronic products.
  • Develop engineering guidelines, best practices, and technology roadmaps related to product industrialization.
  • Collaborate with design teams to ensure manufacturing considerations are incorporated early in product development.

Manufacturing Process Development

  • Develop and assess manufacturing processes for electronic modules, PCB assemblies, power electronics, harnesses, battery systems, motors, and related electrical/electronic products.
  • Define process flows, equipment concepts, tooling, automation strategies, inspection methods, traceability requirements, and end-of-line test approaches.
  • Support prototype builds, pilot production activities, process validation, and production readiness assessments.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams and suppliers to support successful technology deployment and production launch.

Advanced Manufacturing & Digital Technologies

  • Investigate and apply advanced manufacturing technologies including automation, robotics, machine vision, smart manufacturing, and digital engineering tools.
  • Explore applications of artificial intelligence, machine learning, manufacturing analytics, computer vision, and digital twins to improve quality, productivity, and process capability.
  • Support development of innovative solutions for process optimization, defect prevention, predictive maintenance, and manufacturing intelligence.

Technology Development & Evaluation

  • Develop, evaluate, and mature advanced automotive electrical and electronic technologies and architectures.
  • Support innovation activities related to electrification, embedded electronics, power electronics, battery systems, motor-drive systems, sensors, connectivity, and control systems.
  • Assess emerging technologies, manufacturing methods, and industry trends to identify opportunities for future products and processes.
  • Perform benchmarking, feasibility studies, technology assessments, and trade-off analyses.

Engineering Analysis & Simulation

  • Utilize modeling, simulation, and analytical methods to evaluate system performance, manufacturability, reliability, thermal behavior, cost, and design trade-offs.
  • Support concept development, design optimization, and validation activities through data-driven engineering approaches.
  • Translate engineering findings into product and process recommendations.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Work closely with product engineering teams, manufacturing operations, suppliers, universities, research institutions, and technology partners.
  • Drive cross-functional technology development initiatives and provide technical leadership in areas of expertise.
  • Support intellectual property generation, technical publications, internal knowledge sharing, and strategic technology planning.
  • Present technical findings and recommendations to engineering, manufacturing, and business stakeholders.

Qualifications / Requirements:


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or PhD is considered an asset.

Work Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in automotive electronics, electrification, advanced engineering, manufacturing engineering, or related technology development environments.

Experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Electrical and electronic (EE) systems
  • Power electronics
  • Battery systems and battery management systems
  • Electric motors and motor-drive systems
  • Embedded systems and electronic control unit
  • PCB and electronic module development
  • Wiring harnesses and power distribution systems
  • Electronics manufacturing and industrialization
  • Experience with product development from concept through prototype, validation, industrialization, and production launch.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, manufacturing operations, suppliers, and external technology partners.

Skills / Competencies:


Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of automotive electrical and electronic systems and product development processes.
  • Knowledge of electronics design, simulation, prototyping, validation, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), Design for Test (DFT), and product industrialization.
  • Familiarity with electronics manufacturing technologies including PCB assembly, electronic module assembly, testing, and process validation
  • Working knowledge of engineering and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Altium, Cadence, thermal simulation, manufacturing analytics, or equivalent platforms.

Industry & Quality Practices

Knowledge of the following is considered an asset:

  • APQP, PPAP, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans
  • ISO-26262, ISO-21434, ASIL
  • Include IPC standards for automotive PCB design
  • EMC/EMI/ESD standards for automotive Electronics
  • SPC, MSA, Design of Experiments (DOE)
  • IATF 16949 and IPC standards
  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Root Cause Analysis
  • Functional Safety and automotive quality methodologies

Advanced Technologies

Exposure to the following areas is considered an asset:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Manufacturing Analytics and Data Science
  • Computer Vision
  • Digital Twins
  • Industry 4.0
  • Robotics and Automation
  • Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

Tools

  • Experience with system modeling, controls development, simulation, and validation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Stateflow, Simscape, dSPACE, NI LabVIEW, ETAS, and similar platforms.
  • Experience with PCB design, electronics development, circuit simulation, and power electronics tools including Altium, Cadence/OrCAD, Siemens Xpedition, LTspice, PSpice, SaberRD, PSIM, or equivalent tools

Professional Skills

  • Strong systems-thinking and analytical problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to connect product design decisions with manufacturing outcomes.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and project execution skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a global engineering environment.
  • Self-motivated, innovative, and able to thrive in a fast-paced technology development environment.

Work Environment

  • Combination of office, laboratory, prototype-build, and manufacturing environments.
  • Ability to work safely with electrical and electronic test equipment, prototype hardware, and manufacturing processes.
  • Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment:

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

description:
Project Superintendent

Department: Field Operations

FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary

The Project Superintendent is responsible for the daily on-site management of commercial cabinet and millwork installation projects. This role oversees all phases of field operations, including scheduling, coordination of field staff and subcontractors, installation quality, safety compliance, and customer satisfaction. The Superintendent must be highly skilled in the installation of custom millwork, casework, and solid surface products, ensuring adherence to project specifications, deadlines, and safety standards.

  • Monitor job site safety and enforce company safety policies in compliance with OSHA and other regulatory agencies.

title: Foreman
description:
Job Title: Foreman

Location: St. Louis, MO
Reports to: Superintendent
Compensation Range: $28.00 - $39.00 per hour (depending on experience, skills, and qualifications)
Benefits: Comprehensive package including medical, 401(k) with company match, and career development opportunities

About Ceres Environmental Operations

Ceres Environmental Operations (CEO) is a leader in crisis management, rapid response, and disaster recovery, committed to rebuilding stronger, safer communities. We specialize in emergency response, environmental services, planning, and consulting, including debris removal, blue roofs, logistics, debris management, demolition, recycling, forest management, and coastal and marine restoration. As a licensed general contractor, we offer unparalleled expertise to restore stability where it’s needed most.

Driven by Purpose, Powered by People

At CEO, we believe you're more than just an employee; you're part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.

We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you'll fit right in. We don't just respond to challenges; we rise to them.

What We Are Looking For

Ceres Environmental Operations is seeking an experienced and hands-on Foreman to lead vegetation management and debris removal crews.This role is responsible for supervising and directing Trimmers and laborers while actively participating in field operations. The Working Foreman serves as the crew leader, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.

This position reports directly to the Superintendent and is responsible for overseeing small field crews, assigning daily work activities, monitoring productivity, and enforcing safety standards. Success will be measured by maintaining a strong safety record, meeting production goals, developing crew members, and consistently delivering quality work while leading by example in the field.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and supervise daily activities of Trimmers and vegetation management crew members.
  • Perform field work alongside crew members, including operating chainsaws, clearing debris, and supporting vegetation removal activities.
  • Assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are completed safely and efficiently.
  • Conduct daily safety briefings and enforce compliance with company safety policies and procedures.
  • Inspect work sites and identify potential hazards, corrective actions, and productivity improvements.
  • Train and mentor crew members on proper equipment operation, work practices, and safety expectations.
  • Coordinate with the Superintendent regarding staffing, equipment needs, project status, and operational challenges.
  • Complete daily production reports, safety documentation, and equipment inspection records.
  • Ensure equipment, tools, and vehicles are properly maintained and utilized.
  • Support storm response, emergency operations, and special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in vegetation management, tree trimming, landscaping, forestry, construction, or related outdoor field operations.
  • Minimum one (1) year of crew leadership, supervisory, or foreman experience.
  • Demonstrated experience operating chainsaws and vegetation management equipment safely.
  • Strong understanding of OSHA and field safety practices.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading crews on storm recovery, emergency response, or debris management projects.
  • CDL Class A or B license.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • Experience operating chippers, skid steers, brush cutters, or other vegetation management equipment.

What to Expect

This is a working leadership position, not a desk-based supervisory role. The Working Foreman is expected to actively perform the same physical work as the crew while providing day-to-day direction and oversight. You will spend the majority of your time outdoors managing field operations, assisting with vegetation clearing, cutting and removing limbs, collecting debris, and ensuring projects remain on schedule.

Work may occur in residential neighborhoods, rights-of-way, parks, utility corridors, and disaster-impacted areas. Crews frequently work in varying weather conditions including heat, cold, rain, humidity, and uneven terrain. Hours may fluctuate depending on operational demands, weather events, and emergency response activities.

Successful candidates thrive in a fast-paced environment, lead from the front, prioritize safety, and can effectively balance productivity with crew development and accountability.

Physical Requirements and Environment

Ceres provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants with sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. The physical requirements listed below reflect the essential functions of this role. If you need accommodation to perform these functions, please inform us during the application process.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move up to 75 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb, and perform physically demanding work throughout the workday.
  • Ability to operate chainsaws, hand tools, and vegetation management equipment safely and effectively.
  • Ability to work in adverse weather conditions, including heat, cold, rain, humidity, and uneven terrain.
  • Willingness to wear required PPE, including hard hats, hearing protection, eye protection, gloves, high-visibility apparel, and steel-toed boots.
  • Ability to work near moving equipment, traffic, vegetation hazards, dust, noise, and other outdoor environmental conditions.
  • Commitment to following and enforcing all safety standards and protocols.

Why Join CEO?

At CEO, you won't just have a job, you'll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.

We offer:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
  • The chance to make a lasting difference for communities across the U.S.

Ceres Environmental Operations is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Ceres does not sponsor employment-based visas for this position unless stated otherwise.

E-Verify: We comply with Federal law by verifying employment eligibility.

General Responsibilities:

  • Check the quality of each holesaw for total roundness, weld height, weld penetration
  • Degrease cup when necessary, working from travelers and record data according to established procedure.
  • Maintain equipment and work area in a neat and clean condition. Report any discrepancies, equipment malfunctions, defective material or other unusual situations to the Foreman.
  • Observe and obey all safety rules, regulations and practices and employ all safety equipment and devices.
  • Perform other similar or related duties as assigned or directed.

Climate:

title: Senior Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Job Title:

Senior Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis

Job Description:

Senior Specialist, Financial Planning & Analysis


The Role:


Entegris is seeking a skilled Senior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team. The ideal candidate will be critical in driving Entegris’ forecasting and financial performance.


As part of the Corporate FP&A team you will collaborate across Finance and with functional business partners to analyze and communicate key drivers of company results and operational variances. This candidate will play a key role in aggregating data, analyzing financials, reporting results, forecasting future periods, and influencing spend targets.


This role in particular partners closely with Information Technology, Finance, Human Resources, and the Law Department and offers close exposure to Entegris’ executive leadership team (ELT). The ideal candidate possesses strong business and financial acumen, analytical and problem-solving capability, technical systems expertise, communication skills, and an ability to work independently to solve problems and drive outcomes.

What You will Do:

  • Advance “AI-Native” in the Finance function by creating agents and leveraging Copilot to automate routine administrative tasks; streamline legacy financial models and processes using Power BI, Power Query.
  • Develop and maintain robust financial models to standardize reporting, analyze key business trends, and communicate clear and actionable results.
  • Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Strategic Long-Range Plan (SLRP) with template development, input collection, financial analysis, and slide creation.
  • Partner closely with business partners to communicate results, understand drivers, and influence decision making aligned with operating plan targets and key metrics.
  • Become acquainted with functional drivers, leading indicators, and measure business results against key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Assist with ad-hoc analyses, reporting, model creation, and project management with an inquisitive mindset and “drive-to-completion” approach.
  • Collect financial and non-financial inputs to develop supportable and accurate forecasts of headcount, operating expense, and capital expenditures.
  • Aggregate high-volume and complex data from disparate systems across Workday, SAP, BPC, Accolade, and other sources.• Forge relationships with the broader Finance organization and become a trusted, strategic business partner to Entegris functions and the ELT.
  • Bring a strong work ethic and positive attitude to everyday responsibilities.

What We Seek:

  • BS in Finance, Accounting, or related field (Business, Operations, Data Science).
  • Minimum 2-5 years’ experience in related roles including Financial Analysis, FP&A, Accounting, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, Consulting, Auditing.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word skills.
  • Expertise with Power BI, Power Query preferred; other data modeling, dashboarding, automation, and business intelligence (BI) technology encouraged.
  • Exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI) prompting, research, task automation, and agent creation.
  • Strong systems skills: SAP, BPC, ECC, BW preferred; other ERP and EPM tools such as Oracle, OneStream, Tagetik, encouraged.

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

  • Graduate degree in business (MBA) Finance (MS) Accounting (MAcc) or other related fields (Data Science, Business Analytics).
  • CPA or other recognized certification (CFA, CMA).
  • Experience in Big 4 or national accounting, consulting firms, or investment banks.
  • Exposure to Corporate FP&A, partnership with Corporate Functions or Division Finance.
  • Clear, concise, written and verbal business communications skills.
  • High aptitude for problem-solving and customer service.
  • High comfort level with ambiguity. Ability to be adaptable and prioritize high volumes of tasks, requests, and data.
  • Ability to manage confidential financial information appropriately.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally and work flexible hours as needed.

  • Order entry on new projects including entering schedules and resources
  • Issue Purchase Orders and track deliveries of equipment
  • Ensure invoices are issued per project billing schedules
  • Reviewing project deadlines and finances
  • Data analysis and metrics tracking

This job might be for you if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a project controller or similar role.

  • Have the ability to understand technical deliverables in an engineering services organization.
  • Have high attention to detail and critical thinking skills.
  • Insist on quality work and on time deliverables.
  • Possess strong written & verbal communication including on technical subjects.
  • Enjoy problem solving and driving improvements.
  • Are open minded with a desire to learn and grow.
  • Having experience with Deltek Vision software is a plus.

Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.

People are at the core of our company and we hire employee-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees.

  • We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options.
  • We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
  • We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay.
  • We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs.
  • Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits.

title: Profee Multispecialty Hospitalist Coding Specialist
description:
About Us:


Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.


We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

Coding Specialists are an important part of the Team at CorroHealth. The Coding Team Member will provide CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-CM coding a minimum of 1-4 specialties. Will be Coding Professional Fee, Facility, or HCC. Professional Fee Specialties could include UR, Podiatry, Plastics, Pediatrics, OB, Pain Management, Ortho, Addiction, General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Urgent Care, Pulmonary, or ED. Facility Chart types could include OT, PT, Urgent Care, ED, or a variety of other specialties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

  • Team Member must be able to work from home and be independent in their coding skills.
  • Provide various components of coding services to support our clients.
  • Calculate ProFee E/M levels by using an algorithm created by our company
  • Recognize critical care cases by patient acuity.
  • Experience with GI and/or Hospitalist Coding
  • Apply ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes to the highest level of specificity available.
  • Accurately apply diagnosis and procedure codes utilizing ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT®, and HCPCS
  • Interpret coding guidelines for accurate code assignment
  • Identify the importance of documentation on code assignment and the subsequent reimbursement impact.

  • Comply with all internal policies and procedures.
  • Actively participate in Company provided training and education.
  • All Coders must maintain at least one credential through either AAPC or AHIMA.
  • Ensure individual compliance with all privacy and security rules and regulations and commit to the protection of all Company confidential information, including but not limited to, Personal Health Information

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • All coders MUST be certified through either the AAPC (CPC or COC) or AHIMA (CCS or CCS-P).
  • Must have at least a minimum of 6 months of on the job experience.
  • Regular, predictable, and punctual attendance is required.
  • Must have working knowledge and experience with systems such as EMR, Billing, etc
  • Must have a phone, reliable internet connection and current coding materials such as CPT and ICD-10-CM coding references.
  • Will be required to maintain an ongoing productivity level and accuracy rate of 95% or higher
  • Will be required to maintain a quality score of 95% or higher
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft programs like Excel and Outlook. Examples include:
  • Excel you should be able to open and add to a spreadsheet, perform basic formulas like adding or multiplying.
  • Outlooks you should be able to manage emails and schedule and attend meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally both verbally and written.
  • Ability to coordinate, analyze, observe, make decisions, and meet deadlines
  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned by Leadership Team Member.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

title: Audit - Public Sector - Graduate - Manchester - September 2027
description:
Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future.

See how businesses really work and make an impact from day one.
Audit is about more than numbers. It's about understanding organisations, building trust in financial information, and helping businesses, investors and communities make informed decisions. You'll work with a diverse range of clients, gain insight into different industries, and develop skills that will benefit you throughout your career.
At Forvis Mazars, you'll work towards a professional qualification, learn from experienced professionals, and gain hands-on experience using the latest technology and data-driven tools. With real responsibility, continuous learning, and exposure to a variety of businesses, Audit offers an exciting foundation for a successful career.
Ready to challenge yourself, accelerate your development, and discover how businesses really work? Start your career in Audit with Forvis Mazars and make a difference from day one.

About our team:
Join our Public Sector Audit team, working with a diverse range of organisations across central government, local authorities, police and fire services, and the NHS. You'll help deliver high-quality audit services that support transparency and accountability, while developing valuable technical, analytical and sector-specific expertise.

Hear from our school leaver apprentice, Jo:
"The Partner I work with was really keen to share her knowledge with me, and I felt I could ask her questions from the first day”.
#LI-DNP

To apply for our Graduate Programme, you’ll need:

  • GCSE Maths and English Language at Grade 4/C (or equivalent qualifications).
  • Achieved a minimum of 112 UCAS tariff points from your top three A Levels, BTECs, Scottish Highers/Advanced Highers, or other recognised Level 3 qualifications.
  • Achieved or predicted a 2:1 degree classification (or equivalent).


We know everyone’s circumstances are different. If exceptional circumstances have affected your academic results, we’ll consider the context you provide as part of your application.

Does this sound like you?

Enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and spotting trends.
Curious about business, financial performance and risk.
A clear communicator who builds strong relationships.
Interested in technology, data analytics and AI in audit.
Adaptable, motivated and eager to learn.
Ready to study towards a professional qualification alongside your role.


What you'll work on:
Support audit engagements by testing financial information and reviewing evidence to help ensure financial statements are accurate and compliant.
Analyse financial data to understand how businesses operate, identify risks and highlight key findings.
Use audit technology, AI-powered tools and data analytics to interpret large volumes of data, identify trends, enhance insights and improve audit quality.
Research accounting and auditing standards and help apply them to client situations in a practical way.
Work closely with clients and colleagues, gathering information, responding to queries and contributing to meetings and reports.
Collaborate with specialists across Audit, Tax and Advisory teams to gain a broader understanding of client challenges and solutions.
Take on increasing responsibility as you develop, building technical expertise, managing your workload and strengthening client relationships.

Your development and benefits:
You don't need prior audit experience before you join. We'll help you build your knowledge through professional study, hands-on client work and ongoing support from your team.

Develop your technical expertise through funded ACA study, structured training and dedicated study leave.
Build digital skills by learning how technology, data analytics and automation are transforming the audit profession.
Learn in a supportive environment with access to a buddy, mentor and experienced colleagues who will help you succeed.
Apply your learning to real client work, gaining practical experience from day one and seeing the impact of your contribution.
Benefit from a balanced approach to study and client work, with regular check-ins, coaching and guidance throughout your programme.

If you're curious, analytical and ready to keep learning, Audit offers the opportunity to develop sought-after skills, work with a diverse range of clients and build your confidence in a career that helps businesses grow, manage risk and maintain trust in financial reporting.

At Forvis Mazars diversity, equity and inclusion are central to our values. We value our people's unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experience, and know this diversity create better outcomes for our clients. We seek to attract, develop, and retain the best talent, inclusive of sex, ethnicity, disability, socio-economic background, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, and faith. We select candidates based on skills, knowledge, qualifications, and experience and aim to support all our team members to reach their potential. At Forvis Mazars, we promote an environment in which you can grow your skills, belong to a team that values your ideas, and make an impact that matters.

title: Relational Foundation Model Intern, Modern Data Stack – 2027
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join us!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Collaborate with researchers/engineers to enhance our Transformer and GNN-based models to operate seamlessly over any relational schema and heterogeneous graph.
  • Gain hands-on experience with high-impact use cases such as forecasting, entity matching, customer retention and fraud detection – all built on top of a single, extensible foundation model.
  • Apply your knowledge in ML and AI to address real challenges while contributing to scalable and adaptable solutions that push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Work may span the full lifecycle of modern ML systems: from architecture design/training to post-training optimization and inference acceleration.

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or equivalent program area
  • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch
  • Coursework or research experience in crafting ML algorithm solutions

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Familiarity with graph-based machine learning; publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, or similar

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

title: Wait Staff - PT15
description:
Shift: 11:00am - 3:00pm, Monday - Friday (20 hours/week)

Employees are an important part of life at The GreenFields! Not only do they help our residents to achieve their goals, but they also help them to maintain an optimal quality of life. We're looking for caring, compassionate employees to join our team and to help us fulfill our mission to deliver the area's BEST senior care!

Position Summary:

At GreenFields, the Wait Staff position plays an important role in creating a welcoming, safe, and positive dining experience for residents. The role requires a strong understanding of meal service, including taking and accurately fulfilling resident meal selections, describing menu offerings, plating and delivering meals promptly, and providing friendly, respectful customer service. Wait Staff are also expected to maintain high standards of cleanliness, organization, sanitation, and presentation throughout the dining and food service areas.

Success in this position requires reliability, teamwork, attention to detail, and a consistent commitment to resident safety and well-being. Staff are responsible for maintaining clean and hazard-free work areas, properly washing and storing dishes and utensils, preparing dining areas and place settings, following dress code, attendance, and safety policies, and assisting coworkers as needed. The position requires employees to work efficiently, follow established departmental procedures, and demonstrate professionalism and care in every interaction with residents and team members.

We strive to be an employer of choice:

  • Competitive wages, pay based on experience
  • Paid Weekly
  • Referral Bonus Plan & other types of Incentives
  • Paid Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, based on FT/PT status
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401K with employer match
  • Premier Third Party Child Daycare Onsite
  • Free Access to Employee Wellness Center/Gym
  • Free Parking
  • Eligibility for certain benefits aligns with employment status

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve meals that are appetizing in appearance and meet established serving etiquette and departmental standards.
  • Take and accurately fulfill resident meal selections while maintaining knowledge of menu offerings and ingredients.
  • Provide residents with friendly, courteous, and responsive customer service.
  • Deliver meals to residents promptly and accurately as ordered.
  • Plate and prepare resident meals, including soup, bread, salad, dessert, and beverages.
  • Set up tables, carts, dining rooms, and place settings according to departmental standards.
  • Distribute and collect menus and assist with verifying the accuracy of menu selections and meal preparation.
  • Assist with daily cleaning schedules and maintain dining rooms, serving pantries, food preparation areas, dish rooms, and other assigned workspaces.
  • Sweep, vacuum, and mop as directed while keeping work areas clean, dry, organized, and free of hazards.
  • Perform dishwashing and sanitation procedures for dishes, pots, pans, utensils, and other food service equipment.
  • Transport soiled utensils and dishes to the appropriate wash area and return clean items to their proper storage locations.
  • Maintain adequate supplies of dishes, pots, pans, utensils, and other necessary items for each meal and the following meal service.
  • Remove garbage and trash promptly and maintain a safe and sanitary work environment.
  • Assist other staff members as needed or directed to support efficient meal service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Consistently adhere to the facility's dress code and time and attendance policies.
  • Practice safe work habits and follow all facility safety procedures.
  • Consistently support and protect the safety, security, dignity, and well-being of residents.

title: Director - IT Product Management
description:
Company:

Marsh

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Client Technology team, part of our Marsh Risk business at Marsh. This role will be based in Phoenix, Austin and New York. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.


At Marsh we are dedicated to driving product success through innovation and collaboration. We are seeking a Senior Lead Technical Product Manager (TPM) to join our team, playing a critical role in enhancing product functionality and delivering to the portfolio commitments.


What can you expect?


As a Senior Technical Product Manager supporting Marsh’s Client Management Value Stream, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering the technology capabilities that underpin the end-to-end client lifecycle — from onboarding and agreement management to anniversary reviews, client data updates, and operational efficiency.

You’ll work closely with business leaders, operations teams, engineers, and delivery partners to translate strategy into action, ensuring products and platforms are aligned to Marsh’s ambition to become the Risk Advisor of the Future. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to bring diverse stakeholders together around a shared vision.

You can expect to:

  • Lead delivery of high-impact technology initiatives that improve client servicing, streamline workflows, and enable better data quality and automation
  • Partner with the business to understand priorities, define outcomes, and turn needs into clear product direction and delivery plans
  • Collaborate across multiple teams to deliver solutions that support global scale, operational consistency, and improved client experience
  • Help drive modernization across core client management capabilities, including onboarding, agreements, client profiles, and servicing processes
  • Work in a fast-paced environment with significant visibility, where your contribution directly supports commercial outcomes and business growth
  • Influence how Marsh uses technology, data, and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and create a more connected client experience

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys leading through influence, building trusted relationships, and making a tangible impact across a strategic business value stream.

We Will Count on You to:

  • Partner with business leaders to create and executing a multi-year vision for their portfolio of applications. This vision includes a point-of-view on the future role of technology for that business or functional area (new technology requirements), application disposition, build versus buy, sequence in which new functionality will be developed (macro), modernization approach, application retirement, portfolio ROI planning etc.
  • Clearly articulate product features with clarity and precision to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead product roadshows to showcase key functionalities and gather feedback, ensuring alignment across teams and customers. Create comprehensive documentation that clearly outlines product features and their value propositions, enabling effective communication and driving adoption.
  • Manage portfolio budget and driving responsible development defined as on-time and on-budget development of new capabilities aligned to enterprise standards as well as appropriate ongoing management of those applications in partnership with MMC shared service leaders. Balancing CTB and RTB spend across the portfolio including planning around application lifecycle. e.g. when does an application move into ‘maintenance’.
  • Proactively identify new technologies available in the marketplace to address specific business needs within their area of ownership so that technology can better serve as a strategic partner to the business. For instance, a TPM for placement at Marsh would be responsible for proactively identifying opportunities to add new features to existing solutions and bring those to the business.
  • Create a single point of accountability for customizations or variations needed by geography, business line, or department with the goal of avoiding custom solutions that create excess complexity and increase MMC’s cost burden.

What You Need to Have:


  • Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of product development and data strategy. Proven experience delivering technology initiatives successfully.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on continuous improvement and efficiency.

What Makes You Stand Out:


  • Experience in developing and executing multi-year technology visions and portfolio ROI planning.
  • Background in the insurance or financial services industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in cross-functional teams.

Why join our team:


  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $133,900 to $267,700.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. title: Tax - Tax Reporting School Leaver Apprenticeship - Sutton - September 2027
description:
Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future.

Kickstart your career by helping businesses understand, calculate and report their Tax responsibilities accurately. As a School Leaver Apprentice, you’ll learn how Tax connects to financial performance, regulation and business decisions, while working with a diverse range of clients, studying towards a fully funded professional qualification and building the confidence to make a real impact from day one.

About your Team
Join our Corporate Tax Reporting team, supporting a diverse range of businesses from ambitious owner-managed companies to large multinational organisations. You'll help clients navigate complex tax requirements, changing legislation and an evolving business environment while developing valuable technical and commercial skills.


Hear from our trainee, Harvey: 'My journey as a school leaver apprentice has been eye-opening and an experience at Forvis Mazars that has enabled me to learn and grow confidently and gain invaluable knowledge within Corporate Tax. The combination of on the job learning, as well as studying for both an accounting and tax qualification, has led to my development increasing faster than I could of ever imagined when I first joined.' #LI-DNP’


Does this sound like you?
• Enjoy working with numbers, analysing data, spotting patterns and solving problems with accuracy and attention to detail.
• Are curious about how businesses operate and how tax influences financial performance, reporting and decision-making.
• Can communicate clearly, build strong relationships and explain complex information in a practical, easy-to-understand way.
• Are interested in how technology is changing tax, including data analytics, automation, digital reporting and AI-powered tools.
• Are adaptable, motivated to learn and ready to study towards a professional qualification alongside your day-to-day role.

To apply for our School Leaver Apprenticeship, you’ll need
• GCSE Maths and English Language at Grade 4/C (or equivalent qualifications).

• Achieved or predicted a minimum of 112 UCAS tariff points from your top three A Levels, BTECs, Scottish Highers/Advanced Highers, or other recognised Level 3 qualifications.


We know everyone’s circumstances are different. If exceptional circumstances have affected your academic results, we’ll consider the context you provide as part of your application.

What you'll work on
• You’ll work on Tax Reporting, helping businesses understand, calculate and report their tax obligations accurately, meet tax requirements and clearly report tax in their financial statements.
• Prepare corporation tax computations, tax returns and supporting schedules using client financial information.
• Analyse accounts, financial statements and tax data to understand how a client’s business operates and identify key tax reporting requirements.
• Use tax software, spreadsheets and digital tools to organise data, check accuracy, spot issues and support efficient reporting processes.
• Research changes in UK tax legislation and help summarise what they mean for clients in a clear, practical and commercially focused way.
• Support client communications by gathering information, responding to queries and contributing to reports, emails and meeting preparation.
• Work with specialists across tax, audit and advisory teams to understand wider client issues and contribute to joined-up solutions.
• Take on increasing responsibility as you progress, moving from supporting compliance work to managing tasks, building client relationships and contributing to advisory projects.

Your development and benefits
You do not need to be a tax expert before you join. We’ll help you build your knowledge through professional study, practical client work and day-to-day support from your team.

Develop technical knowledge through funded ACA/CTA study, structured training and study leave. Build digital confidence by learning how tax technology, data and automation support modern client work.

Learn in a supportive team, with access to a buddy, mentor and colleagues who will help you settle in. Put your learning into practice through real client work and see how your contribution supports clear and valuable outcomes. You will benefit from balanced study and client work with structured support, regular check-ins and practical guidance.


If you’re curious, analytical and ready to keep learning, Tax Reporting gives you the chance to build specialist skills, work with real clients and grow your confidence in a career shaped by data, technology and change.

This individual will partner with key accounts, diagnostic laboratories, and cross-functional Sanofi teams to support disease education, testing adoption, and account-level execution aligned to business and patient needs.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

  • 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology, or related life sciences industries and in diagnostics or precision medicine

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and planning skills with the ability to work effectively in a field-based, cross-functional environment.

  • Experience engaging external healthcare stakeholders and account decision-makers in complex clinical or laboratory environments.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.​​
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.​​
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.​​

description:

We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Job Summary

Job Details


Join the Cleveland Clinic Martin Health team down in sunny Florida where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and provide patient-first healthcare. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

Echocardiograph (Echo) Technicians are an extremely specific kind of diagnostic medical sonographer dealing with the heart. Echo Technicians use ultrasound devices and other imaging tools that use sound waves to create images of the heart. They inspect the chambers and walls of the heart as well as the valves. An echocardiogram can be administered externally on a patient's chest but can also be conducted by placing a tube down a patient's esophagus to get closer to the heart internally. By joining the Martin Health team as a Registered Echo Technician, you will perform a range of echo exams in various settings, including diagnostic facilities, outpatient centers, and patient
rooms, requiring flexibility and adaptability. An Echo Technician in this role must be comfortable with portable work as you will rotate through various locations. This is a great opportunity for experienced techs to expand their capabilities and gain skills, while acting as a steppingstone to other careers within the field at Cleveland Clinic.

A caregiver in this position works days from 8:30AM – 5:00PM, with on-call and rotating weekend and holiday requirements. Flexibility with start and end times is needed.

This caregiver will float between St. Lucie West, Stuart Family Health Center, Martin North Hospital, Martin South Hospital and Tradition Hospital for training purposes and as needed after training.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Perform echocardiograms, stress tests, stress echoes and Dobutamine stress echo.
  • Assist cardiologist with transesophageal echocardiograms.
  • Consult with cardiologists for interpretation of test results.
  • Maintain records of testing documentation.
  • Provide daily account of patient's charge requisition with appropriate ICD9 codes.
  • Provide training and acts as a resource for echocardiogram students, residents and physicians.
  • Provide testing for add-on emergency patients.
  • Always maintain complete and up-to-date documentation and files, including products and service quotes.

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Graduate from a two-year Cardiovascular Technologist program
  • Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) registry status from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography (ARDMS) OR Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) from the Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI)
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross
  • Strong interpersonal skills to interact effectively with patients, families, physicians and other caregivers
  • Ability to empathize with patients and families

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Five years of experience in echo and vascular ultrasound

Physical Requirements:

  • Interact with patients, families, physicians and other health care workers.
  • Good hand coordination for positioning of probe and equipment.
  • Good vision to analyze computer screens and VCR recordings to diagnose test results.
  • Use good judgment in stressful emergency situations.
  • Adequate mathematics skills to maintain accurate record and report.
  • Physical Duties: Moderate lifting and positioning of patients.
  • Moderate pushing and pulling of equipment.
  • Working Conditions: 100% air-conditioned.
  • Moderate risk of exposure to blood or air-borne pathogens

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows Standard Precautions using personal protective equipment as required for procedures.

title: Director, Trade Strategy (1 of 2)
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

As the Director of Trade Strategy within Gilead’s US Market Access, you will be the subject matter expert and serve as point-of-contact for internal stakeholders, including Brand, Managed Markets, Government Affairs, Finance, Legal and executive leadership, on all business questions related to Gilead’s channel strategies and distribution networks, impacting in-line and pipeline assets.


This pivotal role demands both strategic vision and hands-on execution. You will be driving recommendations with senior leadership and following through on implementation of those recommendations with Trade Account and Operations Teams.


This role reports to the Sr. Director, Trade and Market Access, Market Access Strategy Team. We are hiring 2 positions.


As the Director, Trade Strategy you will:


  • Serve as an internal point-of-contact and trade strategy subject matter expert for Senior Leadership and key internal partners/stakeholders

  • Stay abreast of key new trends, including identification of market disruptors (e.g., Alternate Site of Care, Telehealth, Home Health, Direct-To -Patient) and new channel segment needs/capabilities, and keep key internal partners and stakeholders informed accordingly

  • Spearhead new product channel & distribution strategies, and modifications based on ongoing market dynamics and evolving access paradigms; leadRFP development and vendor selection process for new service needs and deliver recommendations to Senior Leadership

  • Identify appropriate portfolio and product specific service metrics and KPIs in alignment with Trade Account Teams to monitor and measure the performance of Gilead’s ongoing and new distribution networks and agreements, including Wholesalers, Specialty Distributors, and Retail/SpecialtyPharmacies, and Digital Health/Telehealth partners

  • Develop Mature Product channel strategy and work with Trade Account, Contracts, Operations and Regulatory for new and discontinued NDC management

  • Lead strategic insights generation via primary research and data analytics to inform long-term strategic plans and support Trade Account teams in thenegotiation and execution of channel contracts within the approved strategy guidelines and terms

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners/ stakeholders (e.g., TA Managed Markets Leads, Trade Account Team, Trade Operations, GovernmentPricing, Finance, Government Affairs and Legal) to ensure key channel/distribution trends and needs are incorporated into 3-year strategic planning, and scalable for multiple in-line and pipeline brands

  • Attend outside meetings or conferences, as appropriate, to monitor competitive landscape and distribution trends, including new and existing tradingpartners that may impact channel strategies

  • Work closely with Auditing, Regulatory, Legal and other partners/stakeholders to ensure fully compliant practices, policies & procedures

  • Leverage appropriate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain order management parameters as defined by internal policy and agreements.Includes updating SOPs as required and quarterly auditing to ensure consistency with documented procedures.

Leadership, Influence and Communication:


  • Leads and mentors Direct Reports and or junior colleagues/team members

  • Collaborates with a diverse group of stakeholders, including VPs, Executive Directors, Brand, Marketing, Finance, Market Access, Global, Competitive Intelligence, and IT.

  • Earns the respect of internal customers by consistently demonstrating a deep understanding of their business needs and providing insightful advice.

  • Recognized as a subject matter expert, sought after for guidance on decisions impacting business operations.

  • Fosters strong relationships within Account Management, Marketing, and Commercial operations, ensuring smooth collaboration.

  • Expertly navigates organizational intricacies with professionalism and diplomacy. Guide without explicit authority, confidently advocating for the methodologies shaping the forecast and articulating their unique perspective, even if it diverges from the consensus.

  • Manages external consulting resources effectively to ensure successful project delivery.

  • Demonstrate strong Gilead core values – Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, Teamwork, and Inclusion

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree and Ten Years’ Experience

OR

Masters' Degree and Eight Years’ Experience

OR

PhD and Two Years’ Experience


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 12 years’ relevant experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry (a minimum of 10 years’ experience with aMaster’s, or at least 8 years with a Doctoral degree)

  • 6+ years of experience in Market Access, specifically in the development of distribution networks and channel segments, including Wholesalers, Specialty Distributors, Retail and Specialty Pharmacies, Hospitals and Integrated Delivery Networks (e.g. flow of product and dollars across the distribution chain, government pricing regulations, typical contracting terms and approaches) as well as key healthcare related datasets (e.g. 867, 852)

  • Experience developing and operationalizing traditional and non-traditional (e.g., home health, direct-to-patient, digital health) channel strategies, and supporting product distribution dispensing and administration to a multitude of health care delivery sites

  • 2+ years of management experience

  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills with an emphasis on project management and issue resolution

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Tableau

People Leader Accountabilities


  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modelling inclusion and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.

  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop, and realize their purpose.

  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, organizational objectives and holding to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem

title: Technical Specialist, Strategic Resolution Group
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$85,600.00 - $141,200.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Technical Specialist, SRG, you will be responsible for managing and investigating complex claims such as latent injury/toxic tort, environmental, oil and gas, construction, general liability, property, public sector, excess, or abuse and molestation including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, litigation management, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments. In this technical role, you will leverage your expertise in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely and fair resolution. You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders on claims that may involve significant litigation or span extended periods. You may provide mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution.
  • Typically, claim volume commensurate with experience and appropriate oversight and coaching.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with management guidance. Leverage internal resources, as appropriate.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, counsel, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Actively negotiate with multiple parties (e.g., claimants, attorneys, contractors, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Assist in coordinating with Counsel to support litigation management strategies.
  • Maintain accurate records of all claim activities, communications, and decisions.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers’ requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • May require travel, including overnight stays, to attend mediations, trials, arbitration, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Three years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable related experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to comprehend, synthesize, and clearly articulate complex information to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgement, and make effective decisions independently.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims, negotiate settlements, and manage litigation.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Thorough understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations, fair claims practices, and legal requirements applicable to claim handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret, apply, and clearly articulate complex policy language, endorsements, exclusions to assess coverage and claim eligibility.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Two years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit .
