title: Fleet Coordinator
description:
Fleet Coordinator

Coordinate Operations. Support Drivers. Keep Transportation Moving.

At zTrip, successful transportation begins with strong coordination behind the scenes. We're looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Fleet Coordinator to help manage daily transportation operations, support drivers, and ensure service runs efficiently from start to finish.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys multitasking, solving problems, and working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. As a Fleet Coordinator, you'll help keep drivers informed, vehicles utilized effectively, and transportation services operating smoothly.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive Pay
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Ongoing Training and Development
  • Stable, Year-Round Employment
  • Supportive and Team-Oriented Workplace

Schedule

Monday-Friday8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

About the Role

As a Fleet Coordinator, you will play a key role in managing daily transportation operations by coordinating drivers, monitoring service activity, and ensuring resources are utilized efficiently. You'll communicate with drivers, assist with service coverage, track fleet activity, and help resolve operational issues as they arise.

Success in this role requires excellent communication, strong organizational skills, and the ability to stay focused in a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities of a Fleet Coordinator:

Fleet & Driver Coordination

  • Assign transportation requests and service coverage based on operational needs.
  • Monitor driver activity and vehicle utilization throughout the day.
  • Coordinate schedule changes and service adjustments.
  • Maintain communication with drivers regarding assignments and operational updates.
  • Ensure adequate coverage to meet customer demand.

Driver Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for drivers during their shifts.
  • Provide assistance with route information, service updates, and operational questions.
  • Communicate important information quickly and clearly.
  • Help resolve driver concerns and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Support drivers in maintaining productive and efficient service.

Service Monitoring

  • Track ongoing trips and operational performance.
  • Respond to delays, scheduling conflicts, and service interruptions.
  • Assist in maintaining on-time service and operational efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow and resource allocation.
  • Support daily transportation goals and service standards.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate records of fleet activity and driver assignments.
  • Update operational information within company systems.
  • Assist with reporting, documentation, and recordkeeping.
  • Monitor schedules, service levels, and operational data.
  • Ensure records are complete, organized, and accurate.

Problem Solving & Operations Support

  • Quickly address unexpected operational challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions for service disruptions and coverage issues.
  • Work closely with operations and leadership teams.
  • Support process improvements that enhance efficiency and customer service.
  • Assist with special projects and additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications of a Fleet Coordinator:

Required

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organization and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Reliable attendance and professional work ethic.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in transportation, logistics, fleet operations, scheduling, customer service, or administrative support.
  • Experience using GPS systems, fleet software, or scheduling platforms.
  • Familiarity with driver coordination and transportation operations.
  • Knowledge of passenger transportation services is a plus.

What Success Looks Like as a Fleet Coordinator:

As a Fleet Coordinator, you will:

  • Keep drivers informed and supported throughout the day.
  • Maintain efficient fleet utilization and service coverage.
  • Resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
  • Ensure accurate scheduling and documentation.
  • Support a positive experience for drivers and passengers.
  • Contribute to smooth and efficient daily operations.
  • Help the organization meet performance and service goals.

Why Join zTrip?

At zTrip, our Fleet Coordinators play a vital role in keeping operations organized and efficient. Your work will directly support drivers, improve service reliability, and contribute to the overall success of our transportation network.

If you enjoy problem-solving, working with people, and helping coordinate fast-moving operations, this is a great opportunity to build a rewarding career with a growing transportation company.

Apply Today

Join zTrip as a Fleet Coordinator and help keep our drivers supported, our fleet organized, and our operations running smoothly. If you're ready to make an impact in a dynamic transportation environment, apply today.

title: Aerator I
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Aerator is responsible, according to process and procedure, for handling and monitoring quality of material that will be converted into finished product; finished product; packaging materials; and related scrap that results from converting and other associated processes.

The Aerator operates the sheet aerating equipment. Aerator uses control panel to move pallets of sheets into position. Aerator may manually push stacked sheets at the aerator to position sheets. Aerator uses manual pallet jack to move empty and full pallets. Aerator labels loads and uses banding equipment or hand wraps loads. (Reference Grade 3 Position Description)

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/ DUTIES

  • Handle and move (e.g. pack, feed, palletize, aerate, bale) process specific material/product consistent with the assigned position, the machine speed, and customer and quality specifications.
  • Ensure that all materials associated with the converting process and consistent with the assigned position are available in the correct quantities and in the correct location for order being run.
    (e.g. RSCs, dividers, bags, film, blanks, etc.)
  • Perform process and product specific quality inspections, complete Quality Control documentation, and communicate any quality issues to the Operator and Supervisor
  • Record data on specified forms and complete required documentation
  • Use RF scanner for process specific requirements to scan transactions to the Warehouse Management and to generate load tags
  • Prepare, unwrap, wrap loads using hand wrapper/ stretch wrapper/banding equipment following the wrapping/banding requirements for the process specific product/material and for assigned position
  • Use manual/ electric pallet jack consistent with assigned position to stage pallets/product/materials in designated area
  • Dispose of process specific waste material following all safety requirements and waste disposal procedures for assigned position to move waste to the baler and for operation of the baler
  • Assist the machine operator and perform equipment and process specific tasks such as filling glue containers or cleaning glue tips.
  • Remove jams at machine position and restart machine as required by position
  • Communicate any machine or product issues to the Operator or Supervisor
  • Perform general housekeeping in the work area and assist others as required during machine down time
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures including GMP, PPE, HACCP, LOTO, and JSA regulations
  • Responsible for ensuring, where applicable, the product safety, quality, regulatory compliance and legality of all products produced and sold

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education:Less than high school diploma, but some previous work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is usually needed.
  • Experience:Equivalent experience or experience multi-tasking in a fast-paced work environment
  • Certification/ Licenses:
  • Other Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

OTHER: Ability to use RF scanner for WMS transactions as required for position. Ability to operate a manual pallet jack and/or an electric pallet jack as required for position. Ability to use material handling devices such as a hoist and a pneumatic lift assist handling device as required for position.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand and comprehend documents such as safety rules, internal quality procedures, and machine operating procedures. Ability to communicate production issues to supervisors and others in work area.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Basic mathematics (i.e. counting).

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Working Environment:Safety glasses with side shields, hearing protection, and steel-toed shoes are required. In addition, task specific PPE may be required.
  • Physical Demands

The following is a general overview and is used in conjunction with the process specific Physical Requirements document.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Performing the duties of this job requires the ability to quickly move hands, move hands together with arms, and use two hands to grasp and position product or materials. The employee may continuously remain in a stationary position, bend/stoop/twist and use hands and fingers to grasp and position, and use arms to reach and move. The employee may frequently move about the work area. The employee may occasionally ascend/descend stairs, push and pull, and communicate.

The employee may occasionally move and position up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job may include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Data Reviewer - Cell Lab
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

Job Description

Data Reviewer- Remote, Cell Lab

At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services.

Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.


Location/Division Specific Information

Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.


Discover Impactful Work:

The role of Data Reviewer is to support our Cell Laboratory teams in ensuring the integrity and quality of laboratory and chromatographic data and reports. Ensures analyses are following validated or experimental analytical procedures, and compare results to methodology, protocol and product specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) acceptance criteria, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Reviews data entered into databases and reports and monitors the quality of the laboratory data. This is the perfect job for someone who has strong review experience and is looking to move away from hands on lab duties.


A day in the Life

  • Ensures the quality of laboratory data and reports.
  • Reviews chromatographic data, related notebooks and sample results for scientific soundness, completeness, accurate representation of the data, and final reported results.
  • Evaluates data to ensure compliance with analytical methods, client criteria, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Delivers review findings noting deficiencies within the analytical data or reports in a clear and concise manner
  • Communicates with laboratory staff to proactively address the quality of laboratory documentation.
  • Prepares QC statements noting deficiencies with the analytical data set or notebooks.
  • Reports deficiencies to the project leader for correction.
  • Facilitates in conversations with lab staff on best documentation practices and addressing quality findings.
  • Advocates for quality and review process changes.
  • Identifies and supports process improvement initiatives.

Education and Experience

  • BSc in Science or related field required
  • 2+ years of QA/QC analytical experience is essential (gaining thorough knowledge of cell based assays and including experience in reviewing analytical data/results)
  • Thorough knowledge of SOPs and Federal Regulations to include GLP and GMP
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong technical knowledge including an understanding of laboratory procedures, methodology and standards
  • Ability to independently review laboratory reports and analytical methods
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to provide clear and concise feedback and/or documentation of results

Work Environment

Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
  • Able to work upright and stationary and/or standing for typical working hours.
  • Able to lift and move objects up to 25 pounds.
  • Able to work in non-traditional work environments.
  • Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
  • May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements, including infectious agents, typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.
  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.


Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today!

40

title: Tax - Tax Reporting School Leaver Apprenticeship - London - September 2027
description:
Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future.

Kickstart your career by helping businesses understand, calculate and report their Tax responsibilities accurately. As a School Leaver Apprentice, you’ll learn how Tax connects to financial performance, regulation and business decisions, while working with a diverse range of clients, studying towards a fully funded professional qualification and building the confidence to make a real impact from day one.

About your Team
Join our Corporate Tax Reporting team, supporting a diverse range of businesses from ambitious owner-managed companies to large multinational organisations. You'll help clients navigate complex tax requirements, changing legislation and an evolving business environment while developing valuable technical and commercial skills.


Hear from our trainee, Harvey: 'My journey as a school leaver apprentice has been eye-opening and an experience at Forvis Mazars that has enabled me to learn and grow confidently and gain invaluable knowledge within Corporate Tax. The combination of on the job learning, as well as studying for both an accounting and tax qualification, has led to my development increasing faster than I could of ever imagined when I first joined.' #LI-DNI’


Does this sound like you?
• Enjoy working with numbers, analysing data, spotting patterns and solving problems with accuracy and attention to detail.
• Are curious about how businesses operate and how tax influences financial performance, reporting and decision-making.
• Can communicate clearly, build strong relationships and explain complex information in a practical, easy-to-understand way.
• Are interested in how technology is changing tax, including data analytics, automation, digital reporting and AI-powered tools.
• Are adaptable, motivated to learn and ready to study towards a professional qualification alongside your day-to-day role.

To apply for our School Leaver Apprenticeship, you’ll need
• GCSE Maths and English Language at Grade 4/C (or equivalent qualifications).

• Achieved or predicted a minimum of 112 UCAS tariff points from your top three A Levels, BTECs, Scottish Highers/Advanced Highers, or other recognised Level 3 qualifications.


We know everyone’s circumstances are different. If exceptional circumstances have affected your academic results, we’ll consider the context you provide as part of your application.

What you'll work on
• You’ll work on Tax Reporting, helping businesses understand, calculate and report their tax obligations accurately, meet tax requirements and clearly report tax in their financial statements.
• Prepare corporation tax computations, tax returns and supporting schedules using client financial information.
• Analyse accounts, financial statements and tax data to understand how a client’s business operates and identify key tax reporting requirements.
• Use tax software, spreadsheets and digital tools to organise data, check accuracy, spot issues and support efficient reporting processes.
• Research changes in UK tax legislation and help summarise what they mean for clients in a clear, practical and commercially focused way.
• Support client communications by gathering information, responding to queries and contributing to reports, emails and meeting preparation.
• Work with specialists across tax, audit and advisory teams to understand wider client issues and contribute to joined-up solutions.
• Take on increasing responsibility as you progress, moving from supporting compliance work to managing tasks, building client relationships and contributing to advisory projects.

Your development and benefits
You do not need to be a tax expert before you join. We’ll help you build your knowledge through professional study, practical client work and day-to-day support from your team.

Develop technical knowledge through funded ACA/CTA study, structured training and study leave. Build digital confidence by learning how tax technology, data and automation support modern client work.

Learn in a supportive team, with access to a buddy, mentor and colleagues who will help you settle in. Put your learning into practice through real client work and see how your contribution supports clear and valuable outcomes. You will benefit from balanced study and client work with structured support, regular check-ins and practical guidance.


If you’re curious, analytical and ready to keep learning, Tax Reporting gives you the chance to build specialist skills, work with real clients and grow your confidence in a career shaped by data, technology and change.

At Forvis Mazars diversity, equity and inclusion are central to our values. We value our people's unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experience, and know this diversity create better outcomes for our clients. We seek to attract, develop, and retain the best talent, inclusive of sex, ethnicity, disability, socio-economic background, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, and faith. We select candidates based on skills, knowledge, qualifications, and experience and aim to support all our team members to reach their potential. At Forvis Mazars, we promote an environment in which you can grow your skills, belong to a team that values your ideas, and make an impact that matters.

title: Field Applications Specialist-Core Lab- Chicago, IL
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.


Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.


As a Field Applications Specialist, you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Chicago, IL area for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle.


The Opportunity:


  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.
  • Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.
  • Deliver and, in some cases, develop comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.
  • Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.
  • Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.
  • Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.
  • Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols and procedures. Maintain accurate and timely records of all service activities, customer interactions, and technical issues using Roche’s CRM system. Complete all administrative duties, such as travel and expense reporting, as required.
  • Overnight travel within a designated territory, which can range from a specific state to a larger region.
  • This is a field-based role - the territory will cover the Chicago, IL area. 50% travel is expected for this position. The ideal candidate for this role will reside in the Chicago, IL area

Who you are:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Medical Technology, Clinical Laboratory, and/or relevant experience.
  • 3 years of previous experience in a clinical laboratory or IT in a clinical lab environment (including internships, college, certification time, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Medical Laboratory Technologist/Scientist (ASCP/AMT) or equivalent clinical laboratory experience in a clinical environment.
  • Experience working in a clinical environment with a demonstrated knowledge of clinical chemistry and immunoassay.
  • Ability to learn Roche solutions for applicable franchises (i.e. chemistry, immunology, life sciences, IT solutions), and stay current with industry trends.
  • Diagnose and solve technical problems efficiently and effectively.
  • Experience implementing new instrumentation or methodologies in a clinical or research laboratory environment
  • Effective written/verbal communication skills as well as project and stakeholder management experience.
  • Effective customer consultative skills which includes advanced scientific knowledge and analysis, training, exceptional customer engagement, and fostering of strong customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor junior staff and lead by example.
  • Ability to work as a field based individual contributor with independence and autonomy.

Additional Information:


  • This is a remote, field-based position. Overnight travel is expected > 50% of the time, with variations based on business and customer support requirements.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

The Global Supply Chain Supply Planning Consultant will be responsible for day to day operational success and overall analytics for the collateral planning team. Specific functions include identifying replenishment indicators, network balancing, demand forecasting, KPI tracking, master data maintenance, order testing, and ad hoc reporting. This role will work very closely with Operations and Marketing to ensure the right materials are in the right place at the right time in an efficient and effective manner.


You will be asked to identify areas of opportunity, as well as create and implement solutions that drive benefits to Verizon while leveraging AI tools.


  • Reviewing inventory position and usage to identify stock out risks and propose mitigation tactics.
  • Analyzing usage reports to develop future forecasts to efficiently plan inventory purchases.
  • Maintaining master data for inventory items as well as forecasting attributes.
  • Creating and managing the monthly inventory overstock and obsolescence reporting.
  • Performance managing 3PL & Supply partners on timely receipts, shipments, and reporting.
  • Supporting the technical mapping of products to orders to ensure the correct materials are utilized.
  • Performing weekly inventory valuation and projections to help manage working capital and provide guidance to the financial planning process.
  • Performing scenario analysis on an adhoc basis per leadership request to help drive decision making.
  • Maintaining historical reporting onSupply Chain operational & financial KPIs to be used for supplier finding validations, compliance reporting and analysis.
  • Supporting the requirements gathering, testing, and maintenance of the SAP IBP planning tool build out.

What we’re looking for…


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or six or more years of work experience.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Experience with AI tools & Workflow Automation to modernize traditional workflows.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets capabilities (data modeling, macros, complex queries).

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Data Analytics, or a related business field.
  • Strong continuous improvement mindset with a track record of challenging existing processes and driving measurable efficiency gains.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external 3PL vendors.
  • 3PL vendor management or Warehouse Management System (WMS) operational experience.
  • Experience in high-volume consumer technology, device launching, or retail fulfillment environments.

title: Child Activity Center Leader (5065)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, The Child Activity Center Leader creates positive, nurturing relationships with children while building cooperative relationships with parents/caregivers and staff.     • Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism

  • Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs

    • Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, & Inclusion

  • Leading Operations: Ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community

• Engaging Community

title: Depot Repair Technician II
description:
JOB PURPOSE

The Depot Repair Technician will diagnose, repair, test, and refurbish printer units returned from the field so they can be placed back into service or available inventory. This bench-based role primarily supports Fujifilm CX3240, P6000 Wide Format, and DL650 printers. The technician also supports customer “hot swap” replacements, maintains accurate equipment and repair records, and repairs other assigned field-replaceable equipment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical issues in returned printers, scanners, and other assigned equipment using service manuals, schematics, test instruments, and repair tools.
  • Disassemble, repair, and reassemble units to manufacturer specifications. Replace defective components, including print heads, rollers, sensors, motors, and cabling.
  • Perform post-repair testing to confirm that units function properly and meet quality standards before returning them to available inventory.
  • Prepare replacement units for customer hot swaps and update equipment records to reflect unit exchanges accurately.
  • Record diagnostic findings, failure codes, repair work, labor, and parts used in Salesforce and other required systems.
  • Maintain an orderly workbench and bench stock; identify and request needed parts and supplies.
  • Communicate product issues and recurring failures to management. Provide repair information to service staff and, when needed, assist customers by phone with basic troubleshooting.
  • Follow established safety, equipment-handling, and tool-use procedures

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Grade: AVP

Reports to: Head DWH Reporting & Analytics

Department: Digital Financial Services

Location: Head Office, Islamabad

Job Purpose

To build and maintain Mobilink Bank's Medallion Architecture (Raw → Curated → Semantic) on a MinIO-based Delta Lake, enabling reliable, well-governed and high-performance data for analytics, Business Intelligence and Machine Learning. The role will design and deliver scalable batch and streaming data pipelines, integrate data across multiple source systems, and ensure that data is discoverable, trusted and ready for downstream consumption.

The position carries end-to-end accountability for the design, implementation, performance and quality of the Bank's data lake zones and the pipelines that feed them, in line with the Bank's data governance, security and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Platform Architecture and Medallion Design

  • Design, build and maintain the Raw, Curated and Semantic Zones of the Data Lake in line with the Medallion Architecture.
  • Own the Delta Lake on MinIO storage layer, ensuring scalable, reliable and cost-effective object storage.
  • Define zone-level standards for data structure, partitioning, retention and promotion from Raw to Curated to Semantic.
  • Integrate multi-system data into a unified, analytics-ready platform that supports BI, analytics and ML use cases.
  • Ensure the platform design supports structured and federated querying across data zones.

2. Data Pipelines, Ingestion and Processing

  • Develop and manage end-to-end data pipelines covering ingestion (Kafka, Sqoop, Trino), transformation (Spark) and enrichment (Delta Lake on MinIO).
  • Enable scalable processing and curation using Apache Spark, covering both batch and Structured Streaming workloads.
  • Automate ETL processes using Python and R, replacing manual and repetitive data handling with reliable, scheduled workflows.
  • Support structured and federated queries across data zones using Trino.
  • Monitor pipeline health and resolve failures, latency and data-delivery issues promptly to protect downstream consumers.

3. Data Modelling, Analytics and BI Enablement

  • Implement data models in OLAP columnar formats, such as Parquet, to optimise BI query performance.
  • Design and maintain the Semantic Zone so that business users and analysts can consume trusted, consistent and well-defined datasets.
  • Partner with Analytics, BI and Data Science teams to deliver datasets that support dashboards, reporting and machine-learning models.
  • Enable reporting and data visualisation in Tableau through performant, well-structured data sources.
  • Apply data warehousing and data lake principles to keep models scalable, reusable and easy to maintain.

4. Data Governance, Quality and Lineage

  • Collaborate with governance teams to ensure data is discoverable, high-quality and catalogued through OpenMetadata.
  • Contribute to data quality frameworks, including validation rules, monitoring and issue resolution across all zones.
  • Establish and maintain data lineage tracking from source systems through to consumption.
  • Apply data security, access control and compliance standards across the data lake and its pipelines.
  • Ensure data integrity and traceability so that downstream analytics and ML outputs can be trusted and audited.

5. Performance, Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Drive performance tuning across Spark jobs, SQL queries, storage layouts and Trino federated queries.
  • Optimise databases and queries across Oracle 19c, PostgreSQL and MySQL source systems to support efficient ingestion.
  • Work closely with Technology, Data, Analytics, BI, Risk and Compliance teams to deliver data solutions within agreed timelines and quality standards.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging Big Data and cloud storage technologies that improve scalability, reliability and cost-efficiency.
  • Operate effectively in an agile, fast-paced environment, contributing to documentation, knowledge sharing and engineering best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, ETL development or related fields.
  • Strong experience in SQL development and database optimisation across Oracle 19c, PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Proven hands-on experience building batch and streaming pipelines with Apache Spark (PySpark) or Trino.
  • Working knowledge of object stores (MinIO, S3) and Delta Lake architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing the Medallion Data Architecture (Raw → Curated → Semantic).
  • Practical experience with Trino, Sqoop, Delta Lake and MinIO for data processing and storage.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and R for data manipulation and ETL automation.
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualisation and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, data lakes and cloud storage solutions.
  • Knowledge of data governance, security and compliance standards.

Key Skills and Competencies

  • Medallion Data Architecture (Raw → Curated → Semantic)
  • Apache Spark (PySpark), batch and Structured Streaming
  • Trino / Presto and data federation
  • Delta Lake and object storage (MinIO, S3)
  • Data modelling and columnar OLAP stores (Parquet)
  • SQL development and database optimisation
  • Data ingestion (Kafka, Sqoop)
  • Python and R for ETL automation
  • Big Data and distributed computing
  • Data warehousing, data lakes and cloud storage
  • Data governance, security and compliance
  • Data quality, lineage and metadata management (OpenMetadata)
  • Tableau reporting and visualisation
  • Problem-solving in an agile, fast-paced environment
  • Collaboration and cross-functional communication

About Mobilink Bank

Mobilink Bank is providing banking services to over 64.22 million registered users including 21 million monthly active customers across Pakistan. With a hybrid model that combines traditional microfinance with mobile/digital banking technologies, the bank now operates with over 132 branches and 324,000 branchless banking agents and provides a USSD (GSM) based digital channel offering savings, micro enterprise (MSME) loans, small housing loans, remittances, collection (utility bills and loan instalments), mobile wallets, insurance, G2P, B2B & B2P payments; thus, playing a leading role in the promotion of financial inclusion. Mobilink Bank is committed to fostering a positive and productive workplace, and our core values reflect this focus. These values include promoting innovation and entrepreneurship, encouraging teamwork and collaboration, and prioritizing a customer-centric approach in all aspects of our business.

Why Join Mobilink Bank?

This is an opportunity for someone who is passionate about making a difference and playing a key role in driving transformative change. Our team is committed to empowering millions with the tools necessary to succeed in the digital age, and we're looking for a talented individual to join us in this endeavour.

title: Senior Front-End and Agentic-UI Engineer
description:
Your Future Evolves Here

That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Software Engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role builds high-performance React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and works closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

This individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

• Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in React and Next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.

• Build Server and Client Components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.

• Implement backend-for-frontend (BFF) endpoints and integrate with .NET (C#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication.

• Build data-heavy screens, including large grids, PDF and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as KendoReact or MUI.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

Agentic User Experience

• Build streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG-UI protocol.

• Implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including Pydantic AI tool-approval interrupts.

• Implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.

• Contribute to the AG-UI event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

Engineering Excellence

• Conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.

• Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

• Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.

• Write component and end-to-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.

• Identify and implement improvements to CI/CD pipelines, supply-chain controls, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

AI-Enabled Delivery

• Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.

• Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.

• Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

• Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

Governance and Compliance

• Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.

• Handle patient data safely under HIPAA, keeping PHI out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.

• Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.

• Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

• Hands-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server-side rendering, and streaming.

• Experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.

• Experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI.

• Experience integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.

• Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect.

• Strong knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, with experience building accessible applications.

• Experience with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and Git-based workflows, including pull requests.

• Strong, daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with agentic UI frameworks and protocols such as AG-UI, CopilotKit, assistant-ui, or the Vercel AI SDK.

• Experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval and override workflows.

• Familiarity with Python and Pydantic AI.

• Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.

• Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers.

• Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry.

• Experience with C# and .NET.

• Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications.

• Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: LCS - Partner Engagement Coordinator (R20)
description:
Are you passionate about building meaningful relationships and inviting others to be part of God’s transforming work? Union Gospel Mission is seeking a Partner Engagement Coordinator who is eager to combine faith, compassion, and strong communication skills to connect individuals, businesses, and community organizations with opportunities to support life-changing ministry. In this role, you will help partners experience the impact of their generosity while serving alongside a Christ-centered team committed to sharing the Gospel and bringing hope to people experiencing homelessness and hardship.

UGM considers every position one of ministry and a vital and valued part of our team. Therefore, it is essential that all employees of UGM have a personal relationship with Jesus Christ and subscribe to our Statement of Faith and Core Values. Additionally, employees must be willing to lead and/or participate in Bible study, prayer, devotions and sharing the Gospel.

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

The Partner Engagement Coordinator connects with ministry partners, potential businesses, and organizations to increase engagement and raise funds to support UGM’s annual fundraising goals. Through transferring the cause of the ministry, they invite the community into volunteer opportunities, events, and tours to experience the ministry and understand the impact of their partnership.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate and work well as a member of the Development Department, engaging the overall work of Development.
  • Coordinate with the Development Department team members to provide meaningful partner engagement.
  • Collaborate with the Development Department Team members, participating in assigned community events.

Key Result Area #2: Ministry Advancement

  • Follow-up and engage with all potential investor leads - individual, business, and other organizations thru visits, tours, and general stewardship as assigned.
  • Engage with existing ministry partners - look for deeper engagement opportunities to grow and steward the relationship.
  • Engage in effective visit predisposition and strategy efforts with Director of Ministry Advancement to increase effectiveness with portfolio and prospects.
  • Conduct visits with ministry prospects to engage and increase funding resources - demonstrate the ability to communicate and transfer the cause and the increased impact they can have in the lives of UGM guests/residents.
  • Involve other UGM personnel when needed to increase relationship building effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Ministry Advancement Director on tracking activities for the department.
  • Maintain accurate and essential donor information in donor perfect (Virtuous).
  • Follow through on assigned ministry gift receipt delivery.
  • Manage and steward a portfolio of financial partners.

Key Result Area #3: Volunteers

  • Effectively train, manage, and utilize volunteers in the department, allocating adequate time and resources.
  • See that each volunteer has a current job description with duties designed to contribute to the objectives of Ministry Advancement.

Key Result Area #4: UGM Staff Expectations and Activities

  • Submit all UGM credit card receipts and invoices in a timely manner.
  • Adhere to all HR and organizational policies and procedures.
  • Ensure email correspondence occurs within 24 hours.
  • Identify and achieve SMART Goals.
  • Complete other duties as assigned.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Committed Christian, able, and willing to model servant-leadership and interested in being part of a ministry for the poor, homeless, drug addicted and mentally ill. Grounded in the Christian faith as a mature, active member of the body of Christ. In accordance with Union Gospel Mission Statement of Purpose, Statement of Vision and Statement of Faith.
  • Strong interpersonal skills - exercise compassion and discernment while modeling the teachings of Jesus Christ.
  • As a unified team member, will honor the leadership, chain of command, and standards and ministry objectives of Union Gospel Mission.
  • Follows UGM policy regarding addressing and resolving conflict amongst team members, volunteers, & residents.
  • Ability to embrace and communicate UGM’s cultural Core Values and their indicators. The Core Values are applied and observed.

  • Excellent communication skills in written, verbal, and instructional work.
  • Must have a teachable spirit and the ability manage multiple emotional and task related variables, listen, and make sound decisions in alignment with UGM’s purpose.
  • Minimum three (3) years of sobriety, if in recovery.

  • At least five (5) years' clean driving record and insurable by our standards, including a minimum age of 25 years – required.

Occasionally = 1%-33%; Frequently = 34%-66%; Continuously = 67%-100%

3UGMUKG

title: Mammography Superintendent
description:
Role: Mammography Superintendent

Location: Lister Hospital Breast Services at The Chelsea Outpatient Centre and Chiswick Medical Centre

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Shifts: 7.5-hour shifts between 8am and 8pm (weekend participation required; on-call desirable but not essential)

Salary: Competitive, dependent on skills and experience, plus a comprehensive benefits package including private healthcare and the ability to buy and sell annual leave.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Mammography Superintendent to lead our Breast Imaging Services across the Lister Hospital Campus, including The Chelsea Outpatient Centre and Chiswick Medical Centre rated "outstanding" by the CQC.

The Lister Hospital and its outpatient centres are located in the heart of Chelsea, and have consistently provided care and treatment in London for over 30 years. We offer access to leading consultants from London's top teaching hospitals and contemporary treatment, with several highly specialised units including fertility, gastroenterology medicine and orthopaedics and surgery. With 60 beds across three floors, we offer a specialised service, bespoke to our patient’s needs. Our six-bed critical care unit provides dedicated specialised care to seriously ill patients with a range of surgical or medical conditions. In addition to this we have a 13 bedded acute medical unit.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Mammographer looking to take the next step in their leadership career within one of the UK's leading private healthcare providers. As Mammography Superintendent, you will oversee the delivery of a high-quality, patient-focused breast imaging service, ensuring exceptional clinical standards, operational efficiency and an outstanding patient experience.

Working closely with the Imaging leadership team, you will lead the day-to-day running of the Breast Imaging Unit, supporting and developing a team of Mammographers while fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement. You will play a key role in maintaining high levels of clinical governance, ensuring staff competencies are upheld and that the service remains aligned with best practice and regulatory requirements.

As a senior member of the wider Radiology team, you will contribute to the ongoing development and strategic direction of the breast imaging service. From supporting service improvements and workforce development initiatives to helping shape future growth plans, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both patient care and service delivery.

At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.

· Diploma of the Society of Radiographers (or higher qualification).

· Certificate of Competence in Mammography.

· Extensive post-qualification experience within Mammography and Breast Screening.

· Proven leadership or supervisory experience within a mammography service.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

· A passion for delivering outstanding patient care and service excellence.

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

We believe that by caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Mammography Superintendent you’ll be eligible for:


  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

title: Software Verification Engineer
description:
We are building the next generation of verification infrastructure for complex networking and distributed systems. We are looking for a software engineer with strong hands-on experience in test automation and system verification, combined with practical experience applying AI to engineering workflows.

This is a hands-on verification role. You will validate product features, develop automated tests, maintain CI and regression coverage, and build deep domain expertise in networking and telemetry. In parallel, you will build agentic workflows that understand product changes, plan coverage, generate and execute tests, analyze failures, and provide engineers with trustworthy, actionable results.


What you'll be doing

  • Own the end-to-end verification of product features, including requirements analysis, risk assessment, test planning, system-level validation, automated test development, execution, and release readiness.
  • Build and maintain Python-based test infrastructure, CI pipelines, and regression suites, continuously improving coverage, reliability, execution time, and the quality of engineering feedback.
  • Develop deep domain expertise in networking, telemetry, and distributed systems, and use it to investigate complex failures across the product, test automation, and lab environment.
  • Design and build agentic verification workflows that analyze product and code changes, plan test coverage, select or generate tests, execute them, observe results, and perform controlled diagnosis and correction loops.
  • Turn expert verification practices into repeatable and measurable workflows, integrating agents with source control, requirements, CI/CD, issue tracking, lab orchestration, and observability systems while defining test oracles, guardrails, human approval points, evaluation, and tracing.

What we need to see

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with significant hands-on work in test automation, system verification, test infrastructure, or related areas.
  • Deep, production-grade Python expertise, including type-safe data modeling, clear APIs and tool contracts, automated testing, static analysis, performance-aware implementation, and mechanisms for validating and monitoring AI-generated code.
  • Experience testing complex product features and building production-quality automation, CI pipelines, and regression environments, together with strong debugging skills and knowledge of Linux, Git, APIs, containers, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Hands-on experience building reliable LLM-based or agentic workflows beyond the prototype stage, including tool integration, code generation or modification, execution and feedback loops, controlled corrective actions, evaluation, guardrails, observability, context management, and prompt or model versioning.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

  • Experience with networking, telemetry, distributed systems, data center infrastructure, or hardware and software integration.
  • Experience building system-level verification frameworks, large regression environments, test labs, topology orchestration, or traffic-generation systems.
  • Experience validating high-scale data ingestion, observability pipelines, metrics, logs, traces, or other telemetry-intensive systems.
  • Experience with agent-driven change-impact analysis, test selection, failure clustering, root-cause analysis, automated debugging, or flaky-test management.
  • A track record of turning engineering or AI prototypes into reliable capabilities adopted by multiple engineers or teams, combined with a strong systems mindset and a practical approach to establishing correctness.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you are passionate about building mission-critical systems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

title: Director, Strategic Site Partnerships – Cell Therapy
description:
As Director, Strategic Site Partnerships – Cell Therapy, you will serve as the accountable leader for AstraZeneca’s end-to-end relationship with a defined portfolio of priority cell therapy sites. You will combine strategic alliance leadership with clinical and operational expertise to translate enterprise priorities into integrated site strategies, coordinated action, stronger portfolio execution, and lasting partnerships spanning scientific collaboration, early clinical development, and launch readiness.


As AstraZeneca’s strategic point of contact for select Cell Therapy Strategic Partnership Sites, you will align the Alliance Joint Steering Committee (JSC), investigators, site leadership, and AstraZeneca’s cross-functional partnership team around shared priorities, clear accountabilities, and measurable outcomes. You will help remove barriers across the patient and site journey, enable high-quality clinical trial delivery, and ensure site insights inform decisions across the broader cell therapy portfolio.


Why This Role

This is an opportunity to shape high-impact partnerships at the forefront of cell therapy and oncology. You will represent the breadth of AstraZeneca’s cell therapy portfolio at the site level, strengthen collaboration with leading treatment centers, and help improve activation timelines, enrollment, protocol adherence, patient access, and site experience.

By creating a continuous feedback loop between strategic sites and global teams, you will identify recurring barriers early and help convert site-level insights into scalable solutions. Your leadership will support clinical development today while preparing strategic sites for future programs, new indications, and clinical-to-commercial transitions.


Accountabilities

Strategic Site Ownership and Governance

  • Serve as Alliance Manager for the Cell Therapy Strategic Partnership Joint Steering Committee.
  • Act as the primary AstraZeneca relationship owner and enterprise-level escalation point for assigned strategic sites across the cell therapy portfolio.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Cell Therapy Partnership and Strategy and the Strategic Partnership Joint Steering Committee to develop and maintain a multi-year site partnership plan.
  • Integrate clinical development priorities, site capabilities, mutual value, risks, and readiness for future programs into a cohesive site strategy.
  • Lead joint governance and executive-level partnership reviews with clear agendas, decisions, actions, owners, and follow-through.
  • Ensure required internal governance approvals are obtained.
  • Build trusted relationships with site leadership, investigators, cell therapy program leaders, research operations, pharmacy, apheresis, inpatient and outpatient care teams, and administrative stakeholders.
  • Maintain a comprehensive view of AstraZeneca’s portfolio and engagement at each site.
  • Coordinate the timing and sequencing of site interactions to reduce duplication, conflicting requests, and relationship fatigue.
  • Lead the cross-functional site partnership team, mobilize the appropriate AstraZeneca expertise, clarify accountabilities, and drive coordinated execution.

Portfolio Execution and Performance

  • Establish an integrated site performance plan across active and planned studies, with clear priorities, performance measures, and proposed mitigations.
  • Support improvements in site activation, enrollment, patient flow, retention, protocol adherence, patient access, site experience, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Clinical Development, Study Management, Site Management and Monitoring, Patient Operations, Supply and Logistics, Country Operations, and other functions to identify root causes and accelerate the resolution of cross-study barriers.
  • Use performance data and site intelligence to identify emerging risks, distinguish local challenges from systemic patterns, and focus resources where intervention can have the greatest portfolio impact.
  • Track commitments, risks, actions, and outcomes through a consolidated partnership dashboard.
  • Provide concise, decision-oriented updates to AstraZeneca and site senior leaders.
  • Inform feasibility and site selection through an enterprise view of site capacity, competing clinical trials, patient access, investigator interest, and operational readiness.

Clinical Field Leadership and Protocol Enablement

  • Maintain deep working knowledge of AstraZeneca’s cell therapy portfolio, protocols, patient populations, treatment pathways, and site delivery requirements.
  • Partner with assigned sites and AstraZeneca’s cross-functional teams to assess protocol and educational needs.
  • Coordinate targeted, compliant education with the appropriate study, clinical, and medical experts.
  • Help sites translate complex eligibility criteria, safety requirements, care pathways, and operational procedures into practical workflows that support appropriate patient identification and high-quality execution.
  • Identify drivers of screen failure, protocol deviation, patient attrition, and treatment delays.
  • Facilitate cross-functional root-cause analysis and the development of sustainable corrective actions.
  • Escalate medical, safety, or protocol interpretation questions through established channels and help ensure sites receive coordinated and timely responses.

Enterprise Insights and Continuous Improvement

  • Capture structured insights related to referral pathways, patient access, site capacity, protocol feasibility, operational burden, and the end-to-end patient journey.
  • Synthesize themes across sites and studies, quantify their impact where possible, and recommend portfolio-level improvements to protocols, processes, tools, and resource deployment.
  • Share site best practices across the strategic site network.
  • Partner with global teams to scale solutions that improve speed, quality, and consistency across the cell therapy portfolio.
  • Bring an external perspective on the evolving cell therapy landscape, competitive clinical trial activity, and site operating models while maintaining compliant scientific exchange.
  • Create a continuous feedback loop between strategic sites and global teams so recurring barriers are identified early and translated into scalable portfolio-level solutions.

Long-Term Partnership and Launch Readiness

  • Partner with Medical, Commercial, Development, Manufacturing, Market Access, and Patient Services to assess strategic-site readiness for future indications and potential launches while maintaining appropriate role boundaries.
  • Support strategically aligned and appropriately governed initiatives involving referral-network development, workforce and capacity planning, clinical-to-commercial continuity, data collaborations, education, and innovation.
  • Represent AstraZeneca at selected scientific meetings, investigator forums, and partnership events to strengthen engagement and advance agreed site objectives.
  • Help strategic sites prepare for upcoming programs, new indications, and clinical-to-commercial transition milestones.

Role Accountability and Functional Partnership

The Director is accountable for:

  • Site relationship: The integrated site strategy, relationship health, governance, stakeholder map, engagement sequencing, and enterprise-level escalation.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Convening the site partnership team, clarifying owners and timelines, and driving closure of issues that cross studies or functions.
  • Performance insight: Maintaining a portfolio-level view of site performance and translating data and field intelligence into prioritized actions.
  • Partnership execution: Maintaining one current strategy, one governance rhythm, and one consolidated view of commitments and risks for each assigned site.

Functional ownership for medical judgment, safety reporting, protocol interpretation, monitoring, data management, regulatory decisions, contracting, and study-specific execution remains with the designated accountable functions.


Essential Skills/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in health sciences, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience or professional qualification.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Clinical care involving direct patient interaction
    • Clinical research within an academic setting
    • Clinical development
    • Clinical operations
    • Medical affairs
    • Field clinical practice
    • Strategic alliances
    • Site partnership management
  • Relevant experience within cell therapy, oncology, hematology, advanced therapies, or another complex treatment environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with investigators, advanced practice providers, scientists, site leadership, and multidisciplinary clinical and operational teams.
  • Success leading senior external relationships and complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial conduct, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol execution, site operations, and applicable regulations and codes of practice.
  • Ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and protocol information into clear, practical actions for investigators and site teams.
  • Ability to interpret performance data, identify root causes, prioritize enterprise-level risks, and translate insights into actionable plans.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to move effectively between strategic discussions and detailed problem-solving.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally based on site and portfolio needs, anticipated to be up to 50%.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree or equivalent professional qualification, such as NP, PA, PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc, or equivalent.
  • Experience within an apheresis, cellular therapy, stem cell transplant, or complex specialty-care program.
  • Direct experience with cell therapy or another operationally complex advanced therapy.
  • Strong understanding of the cell therapy patient journey and multidisciplinary site delivery model.
  • Previous experience as an alliance manager, field clinical advisor, clinical development leader, or in a comparable site-facing strategic role.
  • Experience with strategic research agreements, master clinical trial agreements, shared investment models, or joint governance.
  • Experience supporting the transition from clinical development to commercial launch in cell therapy or another complex treatment model.
  • Experience working across countries or regions.
  • Additional language capability.

What You'll Bring

You are a strategic, collaborative leader who can build trusted relationships across complex scientific, clinical, and operational environments. You understand the realities of delivering cell therapy clinical trials and can translate scientific, protocol, patient-journey, and operational insights into practical actions.

You bring sound judgment, executive presence, and the ability to influence without direct authority. You are equally comfortable leading senior-level strategic discussions, analyzing performance data, and working with multidisciplinary site teams to solve detailed operational challenges.


Why AstraZeneca

Here, courage, curiosity, and collaboration fuel a relentless focus on transforming cancer outcomes, powered by a pipeline that fuses cutting-edge science with advanced technology. You will work in an environment where unexpected teams come together to spark bold ideas, backed by meaningful investment and a clear path from discovery to impact. We value kindness alongside ambition, and we empower leaders at every level to ask sharp questions, take smart risks, and turn data into decisions that help patients sooner.


Compensation & Benefits

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $203,709.60 - $305,564.40. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.


Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Patient Service Representative
description:
Job Description:

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) serves as the first connection between Intermountain and patients. This role embodies Intermountain values and focuses on establishing collaborative relationships with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction. The PSR ensures a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care, which may include greeting and checking-in/out patients, as well as verifying information supplied by patients.

Essential Functions.

  • Provides courteous and professional connections with patients over the phone, in person or via secure messaging. Resolves patient needs skills to ensure a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care.
  • Documents all phone calls accurately and completely in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Schedules patient appointments for visits, procedures, diagnostic tests, referrals, and/or consultations.
  • Registers patients over the phone or in person by confirming, entering, and/or updating all required demographic data on patient and guarantor on the registration system. Follows procedures when identifying patients.
  • Obtains copies of insurance cards, forms of ID, and signatures on all required forms. May verify information on appropriate accounts to determine insurance coordination of benefits, may include pre-certification/prior authorization .
  • Assists patients in completing necessary forms to meet regulatory and billing needs prior to receiving clinical care. Scans necessary paperwork and educates patient on financial assistance. Proactively requests payments from patients on current and past medical services. Receives and processes those payments following appropriate procedures for handling payments.
  • Stays current on role/responsibilities, updates etc. which may include reviewing monthly email/newsletter, ambulatory epic dashboard, patient access, work ques, attend clinic/service line meetings, review emails each shift, etc. to ensure the highest standard of performance is achieved.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Six months of customer service experience involving interactions with customers.
  • Demonstrated basic computer skills involving word processing and data entry.
  • Professional manner and strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction.
  • Ability to protect privacy, confidentiality, and Protected Health Information (PHI) of patients, members, and caregivers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One year of customer service experience involving interactions with customers in person and by phone.
  • Billing and collections experience.
  • Computer literacy in using electronic medical records (EMR) systems and other relevant software.
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Multilingual

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for caregivers to see and read information, labels, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
  • Frequent interactions with providers, colleagues, customers, patients/clients and visitors require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate supplies and equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use for typing, accessing needed information, etc.
  • Position may require standing for long periods of time, lifting supplies
  • May assist patients into/out of the clinic.

As a Superintendent Radiographer within Cath Lab and Interventional Radiology Imaging, you'll provide both clinical and operational leadership across a busy, specialist service. At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.


What you’ll do:

Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. We believe that by caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients.
