  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

title: Commercial Construction Superintendent
description:
About the Job

Job Title: Superintendent
Location: Indianapolis, IN
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary/Compensation: Depending on Experience (DOE)

Key Skills: Commercial Construction, Site Supervision, Renovation, Restoration, Subcontractor Coordination, Construction Scheduling, Jobsite Safety, Quality Control, Blueprint Reading, Three-Week Look-Ahead Scheduling, Daily Reporting, Punch Lists, Occupied-Building Construction

About the Company

A commercial construction company specializing in new construction, renovations, and restoration projects. The company works across a variety of commercial environments, including occupied and historic buildings, and emphasizes jobsite safety, quality workmanship, and effective project coordination.

Position Summary

The Superintendent oversees daily field operations for commercial construction projects, including new construction, renovations, and restoration work. This role is responsible for jobsite safety, construction scheduling, subcontractor coordination, quality control, and field productivity while working closely with the Project Manager to keep projects on schedule and within established requirements.

The ideal candidate has hands-on commercial general contracting experience, particularly with renovation, restoration, or occupied-building projects, and can coordinate multiple trades while maintaining safe and organized jobsites.

Responsibilities

Jobsite Operations and Leadership

  • Manage daily construction site operations, including scheduling, crew coordination, housekeeping, and productivity.
  • Coordinate subcontractors and self-performed crews to ensure work progresses efficiently.
  • Monitor daily field activities and address issues that could affect project schedules or quality.
  • Maintain an organized jobsite and ensure work is performed according to project plans and specifications.
  • Communicate field progress, challenges, and schedule concerns to the Project Manager.

Scheduling and Coordination

  • Develop, maintain, and execute the three-week look-ahead schedule in coordination with the Project Manager.
  • Coordinate trade sequencing, material availability, inspections, and site access.
  • Monitor progress against project milestones and identify potential delays.
  • Work with subcontractors to resolve scheduling conflicts and maintain workflow.
  • Coordinate project phasing and access requirements with the owner's facility staff.

Safety and Quality Control

  • Enforce jobsite safety procedures and maintain a safe working environment.
  • Monitor housekeeping and ensure work areas remain clean and organized.
  • Inspect subcontractor work for compliance with plans, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Identify deficiencies and coordinate timely corrective action.
  • Support required inspections and ensure issues are resolved before project closeout.

Renovation and Occupied-Building Management

  • Coordinate construction activities in occupied buildings while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
  • Protect existing structures, finishes, equipment, and occupied areas during renovation or restoration work.
  • Manage work sequencing, barriers, access restrictions, and phased construction activities.
  • Communicate schedule changes, access requirements, and potential disruptions to facility representatives.

Documentation and Project Reporting

  • Prepare accurate daily construction reports and maintain field records.
  • Track subcontractor progress, site conditions, inspections, and outstanding issues.
  • Coordinate punch-list activities and monitor completion of corrective work.
  • Keep the Project Manager and owner informed about project progress, site conditions, and upcoming activities.


Work Environment

  • Full-time, field-based position in the Indianapolis area.
  • Requires regular presence on active commercial construction sites.
  • May involve work in occupied buildings, historic properties, and facilities requiring phased construction.
  • Requires walking jobsites, inspecting work, navigating uneven surfaces, and working in varying site and weather conditions.




Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Superintendent or Lead Foreman for a commercial general contractor.
  • Experience with commercial renovations, restoration, or construction in occupied buildings.
  • OSHA 30 certification or willingness to obtain it.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans, and specifications.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors, construction crews, inspections, and field schedules.
  • Familiarity with look-ahead scheduling, daily reporting, and construction management tools.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing field priorities while maintaining safety and quality standards.
  • Must live within commuting distance of Indianapolis, Indiana.




Benefits

Why Join Us?

  • Lead field operations on diverse commercial construction and renovation projects.
  • Work closely with Project Managers, subcontractors, and client facility teams.
  • Take ownership of jobsite safety, scheduling, quality, and daily execution.
  • Gain experience with projects involving occupied facilities and existing structures.

title: Commercial Construction Superintendent
description:
About the Job

Job Title: Superintendent
Location: Philadelphia, PA
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary/Compensation: Depending on Experience (DOE)
Key Skills: Commercial Construction, Site Supervision, Field Coordination, Construction Scheduling, Subcontractor Management, Quality Control, Jobsite Safety, Construction Documentation, Minor Carpentry, Site Protection, Project Coordination

About the Company

An established commercial construction and construction management firm specializing in commercial interiors, renovations, and specialized construction projects. The company emphasizes proactive communication, detailed planning, quality execution, and effective coordination among owners, designers, subcontractors, and field teams.

Position Summary

The Superintendent is responsible for coordinating daily field activities and supporting the successful execution of commercial construction and renovation projects. This role balances computer-based project documentation and coordination with regular field oversight and hands-on site work.

The Superintendent works closely with Project Managers, subcontractors, clients, and other project stakeholders to maintain schedules, ensure quality, promote jobsite safety, and resolve construction issues. Healthcare construction experience is a plus, particularly for projects requiring careful coordination, site protection, and attention to facility operations.

Responsibilities

Field Operations and Coordination

  • Coordinate daily construction activities and monitor project progress on site.
  • Work with Project Managers, subcontractors, vendors, and other trades to maintain project schedules and resolve field issues.
  • Monitor workmanship and ensure construction activities follow project plans, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate site access, material deliveries, work sequencing, and subcontractor activities.
  • Identify potential delays, deficiencies, and coordination issues and communicate them to the project team.
  • Support punch-list completion and project closeout activities.

Project Documentation and Computer-Based Work

  • Prepare and maintain project reports, progress updates, photographs, and other construction documentation.
  • Review construction drawings, project specifications, and relevant project information.
  • Track outstanding work, schedule updates, and coordination items.
  • Communicate project status and field issues to the Project Manager and other stakeholders.
  • Use computer-based tools for project coordination, documentation, scheduling, and reporting.

Hands-On Site Work

  • Assist with temporary site protection and maintain clean, organized work areas.
  • Perform minor carpentry and basic repair tasks as needed, such as patching and installing restroom accessories or hardware.
  • Help address minor field deficiencies and coordinate corrective work.
  • Support site readiness and ensure completed or occupied areas are protected during construction.

Safety and Quality Control

  • Promote and follow jobsite safety procedures.
  • Monitor site conditions and report unsafe practices or potential hazards.
  • Help ensure subcontractor work meets project quality expectations.
  • Protect existing finishes, equipment, and occupied areas during renovation work.
  • Coordinate with project teams to resolve quality concerns and complete outstanding items.

Serving the needs of Garfield Heights and the Southeast communities of Cuyahoga County, Marymount Hospital is an acute care, faith-based hospital. Here, caregivers are guided by the Christian values of service, compassion, dignity and respect and live by the mission of providing world-class healthcare. As a part of our team, you will build a rewarding, lifelong career in a diverse and welcoming environment.

Marymount Hospital’s Intensive Care Unit (ICU) consists of 28 beds in two connected 14-bed pods and was designed for high acuity patients who need critical care and are being treated for serious medical conditions. Some of the most common procedures in this unit include bronchoscopy, endoscopy, emergent intubation, central line placement, continuous renal replacement therapy, pronation, and therapeutic hypothermia. As a Clinical Technician, you will assist with basic patient care, maintain room cleanliness and demonstrate empathy and compassion in all activities and interactions. Your work plays a direct role in our mission to continuously provide patients with the best healthcare experience possible.

This is a regular PRN position, with caregiver working a day/evening rotation between 7:00 a.m. – 7:30 p.m. and 3:00 p.m. -- 11:30 p.m. with weekend and holiday requirements.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Provide or assist with patient care under the supervision of an RN, such as taking vital signs and weight, assisting patients with personal care, point of care testing, dressing changes, applying external monitoring devices and removing urinary Foley Catheters.
  • Report abnormal findings or changes in physical, mental and emotional conditions to an RN.
  • Assist with keeping patients’ rooms clean and orderly.

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • High School Diploma/GED
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification through the American Heart Association (AHA) within new hire period (Nursing Student req to have prior to hire)
  • One year of recent, full-time patient care experience
  • Additional education/training may substitute for some/all the stated experience
  • Nursing students who have recently completed a minimum of one clinical rotation as part of an accredited nursing school program may substitute the clinical rotation for the required experience
  • Military experience as a Hospital Corpsman (HM), Combat Medic (68W) or Medical Service Technician (4N0X1) will be considered

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires full body motion to move and lift patients, manual finger dexterity with good eye-hand coordination; involves extensive standing and walking.
  • Medium Work - Exerting 50 to 100 pounds of force rarely, and/or 0 to 50 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.
  • Physical Demand requirements are in excess of those for Medium Work.

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

Cleveland Clinic Health System administers an influenza prevention program. You will be required to comply with this program, which will include obtaining an influenza vaccination on an annual basis or obtaining an approved exemption.

title: Master Data Management Analyst
description:

The Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas Internship Program is a prestigious, cohort-based experience that attracts top talent from across the country for paid, full-time summer internships spanning majors and functional areas – from economic research and finance to Cash Services, IT, and beyond. While interns take on a specific functional role for the summer with meaningful work and opportunities to grow, the program offers much more than a single assignment. title: Prod Tech 2
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Job Summary:**

The Prod Tech 2 at Lumentum Operations LLC is responsible for performing a variety of technical and hands-on tasks related to the manufacturing, testing, and troubleshooting of optical components and systems. This role ensures products meet quality standards and production schedules within a cleanroom environment.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Operate and monitor manufacturing equipment, including but not limited to, optical alignment systems, laser welders, and test stations.
* Perform in-process inspections and quality checks to ensure adherence to specifications and identify defects.
* Conduct basic troubleshooting of equipment and product issues, escalating complex problems to higher-level technicians or engineers.
* Perform routine maintenance and calibration of production equipment as per established procedures.
* Accurately record production data, test results, and any observed anomalies.
* Assemble and disassemble optical components, sub-assemblies, and final products following detailed work instructions.
* Work within a cleanroom environment, adhering to all established protocols and procedures.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas for process optimization and efficiency gains.
* Train and mentor less experienced production technicians as needed.
* Maintain a clean and organized workspace, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Job Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; Associate's degree in a technical field (e.g., Electronics, Optics, Manufacturing Technology) is preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing or production environment, preferably in optics, photonics, or a related high-tech industry.
* Demonstrated ability to follow detailed work instructions and standard operating procedures.
* Proficiency in using basic hand tools and precision measurement equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers).
* Basic understanding of optical principles and concepts is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to perform repetitive tasks with accuracy.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Familiarity with cleanroom protocols and procedures is desirable.
* Basic computer skills, including data entry and navigation of manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand for extended periods.
